spell.name: Sphere Purity
spell.description: Pure element combinations (two spheres of the same element) deal 1d6 additional damage of that element. When you roll 3+ spheres of one element in a single turn, gain 1 temporary mana.
spell.flavorText: A clause written twice is a clause that holds.

rankUpgrades.description: Pure element combinations deal 2d6 additional damage. Rolling 3+ of one element grants 2 temporary mana.
Pure element combinations deal 3d6 additional damage. Rolling 3+ of one element grants 3 temporary mana and briefly reduces that element's cooldowns by 1 round.

spell.name: Elemental Commitment
spell.description: At the start of combat, declare a Focused Element. Your Focused Element deals +10 points damage and you reroll any sphere of that element that shows lower than a 3 (reroll once, keep result).
spell.flavorText: The Canopy-Ledger permits amendments. With teeth.

rankUpgrades.description: Focused Element deals +20 points damage. You reroll any rolled sphere of that element that shows lower than a 5 (once, keep result).
Focused Element deals +30 points damage. You may choose the exact value (not just reroll) of one Focused Element sphere you roll each turn.

spell.name: Reroll Mastery
spell.description: You may reroll up to 2 spheres per turn. The first reroll each turn costs 1 mana; additional rerolls cost 2 mana each.
spell.flavorText: The audit found an appeals process.

rankUpgrades.description: Reroll up to 3 spheres per turn. The first two rerolls each turn are free; additional rerolls cost 1 mana.

spell.name: Crystal Focus
spell.description: Declare your Focused Element and spend 2 mana: for this turn, spells using your Focused Element deal 2d6 additional damage and score crits on a 17+. Cannot be used if you have no spheres of the Focused Element banked.
spell.flavorText: Exclusion is also a specification.

rankUpgrades.description: Declare Focused Element and spend 2 mana: this turn, Focused Element spells deal 3d6 additional damage and crit on 16+. Cooldown drops to 1 round.
Declare Focused Element for free: this turn, Focused Element spells deal 4d6 additional damage, crit on 15+, and pierce resistance by 15 points.

spell.name: Sphere Hunting
spell.description: When you reroll a sphere, you may choose it to be your Focused Element instead of rolling randomly (once per turn).
spell.flavorText: The hunt ends in acquisition.

rankUpgrades.description: When you reroll a sphere, you may choose it to be your Focused Element — up to twice per turn.
When you reroll a sphere, you always choose its element unconditionally (the reroll is now a selection).

spell.name: Resonance Chord
spell.description: When you have 3 or more banked spheres of the same element, spend 1 of them: deal 2d8 damage of that element to all enemies within 20 feet and impose -2 to their saves against that element for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The pipes hum in agreement. The agreement detonates.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 1 matching sphere: 3d8 AoE damage within 25 feet. Victims save at -3 against that element for 1 round.
Spend 1 matching sphere: 4d8 AoE damage within 30 feet. Victims save at -4 against that element for 2 rounds, and the element's next Crystal Focus is free.

spell.name: Prismatic Burst
spell.description: Consume 2 spheres of the same element: release a 30-foot cone dealing 3d8 damage of that element per sphere consumed. If both spheres are your Focused Element, victims are slowed (half move) for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: One element. One very wide signature.

rankUpgrades.description: Consume 2 same-element spheres: 40-foot cone deals 4d8 per sphere. Focused Element burst also staggers (enemies lose 1 action next turn).
Consume 2–3 same-element spheres: 40-foot cone deals 5d8 per sphere, crits on 17+. Focused Element burst staggers and leaves a 10-foot elemental hazard zone for 1 round.

spell.name: Elemental Dominion
spell.description: You gain resistance to your Focused Element. When you take damage of your Focused Element, you instead absorb it: gain 1 temporary mana per 4 damage absorbed.
spell.flavorText: Sign enough contracts in one ink and the ink signs back.

rankUpgrades.description: When you take damage of your Focused Element, you absorb it: gain 1 temporary mana per 2 damage absorbed, and gain +1 to hit with that element for 1 round.
Immunity to your Focused Element. Focused Element damage you absorb grants 1 temporary mana per 2 damage, and half the absorbed damage is re-dealt to the nearest enemy.

spell.name: Refraction Strike
spell.description: Spend 1 Focused Element sphere: launch a piercing bolt of that element. It travels in a 60-foot line, passing through all creatures, dealing 3d10 damage to each. The bolt refocuses at each target — it does not lose power.
spell.flavorText: The clause pierces. Interference is breach of contract.

rankUpgrades.description: 80-foot piercing bolt deals 4d10 to each target. After the bolt, each target it hit takes 1d6 additional Focused Element damage at the start of their next turn.
80-foot piercing bolt deals 5d10 to each target and grants you 1 Focused Element sphere per target hit (max 3).

spell.name: Perfect Clarity
spell.description: Once per combat: instead of rolling spheres this turn, choose up to 4 spheres of any element composition (within your bank limit). The chosen spheres deal +1d6 damage when spent.
spell.flavorText: For one moment, the dice file a petition and you deny it.

rankUpgrades.description: Twice per combat: choose up to 4 spheres freely. Chosen spheres deal +2d6 damage when spent and their Crystal Focus is automatically active this turn.
Twice per combat: choose up to 5 spheres freely. Chosen spheres deal +3d6 damage when spent, activate Crystal Focus, and grant 2 temporary mana.

spell.name: Crystal Armor
spell.description: While you hold 3 or more banked spheres of the same element, gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability and resistance to your Focused Element. Losing the 3-sphere cluster removes this durability.
spell.flavorText: The bank, worn as a coat. Filed under protection.

rankUpgrades.description: While holding 2+ banked spheres of the same element, gain +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability and resistance to your Focused Element.
While holding 2+ banked spheres of the same element, gain +4 Durability Steps to equipped durability, resistance to your Focused Element, and +2 to all saves.

spell.name: Sphere Perfection
spell.description: Pure element combinations roll their damage dice at maximum. Prismatic Burst and Resonance Chord deal maximum dice when using your Focused Element.
spell.flavorText: The dice were always going to agree. Now it is binding.

spell.name: Prism Battery
spell.description: Your sphere bank maximum increases by 2, and at the start of combat you begin with 2 spheres of your Focused Element already banked.
spell.flavorText: Pig iron, chambered and willing.

rankUpgrades.description: Sphere bank maximum +4; begin combat with 4 Focused Element spheres banked. Your Focused Element's first Crystal Focus this combat is free.

spell.name: Resonant Feedback
spell.description: After casting Resonance Chord or Prismatic Burst with your Focused Element, your next Crystal Focus this turn costs 0 mana.
spell.flavorText: The pipes hum louder. The meter loves it.

rankUpgrades.description: After Resonance Chord or Prismatic Burst with Focused Element, your next Crystal Focus is free AND grants +1 Focused Element sphere.
After Resonance Chord or Prismatic Burst with Focused Element, your next Crystal Focus is free, grants +1 sphere, and restores 2 mana.

spell.name: Prismatic Cataclysm
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Consume 4–6 spheres of your Focused Element. A 50-foot radius erupts for 4d12 damage of that element per sphere consumed (up to 24d12). Victims are made vulnerable to your Focused Element for 1 minute. You are anchored in place for 1 round after.
spell.flavorText: Appendix F: termination of all other parties.

spell.name: Pure Doctrine
spell.description: The First Contract rewards consistency. All damage dealt by pure element combinations and your Focused Element signature spells (Crystal Focus, Prismatic Burst, Resonance Chord, Refraction Strike) is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: Redundancy, weaponized.

rankUpgrades.description: Focused Element signature spell damage increased by +1d8 damage.
Focused Element signature spell damage increased by +1d8 damage, and pure element combinations bank 1 additional Focused Element sphere.
Focused Element signature spell damage increased by +2d8 damage.
Focused Element signature spell damage increased by +2d8 damage, and Prismatic Cataclysm's anchor is removed.

spell.name: Dominant Clause
spell.description: Once per turn, one sphere you roll automatically converts to your Focused Element.
spell.flavorText: The majority element holds the seat.

rankUpgrades.description: Up to 2 rolled spheres per turn automatically convert to your Focused Element.
Up to 3 rolled spheres convert to Focused Element per turn. Prismatic Burst and Resonance Chord cost 1 fewer sphere when all consumed spheres are your Focused Element.

spell.name: Fex Resonator
spell.description: Spells that use only your Focused Element (all spheres consumed match) restore 2 mana after casting.
spell.flavorText: Steam-will, recycled. The pipes approve.

rankUpgrades.description: Pure Focused Element spells restore 4 mana. Crystal Focus also reduces Refraction Strike's cooldown by 1 round.
Pure Focused Element spells restore 6 mana. Crystal Focus also reduces Refraction Strike's cooldown by 1 round and Perfect Clarity charges recharge 10 rounds faster.

spell.name: Chaos Generation
spell.description: Roll 5d8 for sphere generation instead of 4d8. Any wyrd sphere you roll has a 20 points chance to immediately trigger a minor Wild Magic Surge (GM rolls; you choose its target).
spell.flavorText: The Canopy-Ledger frowned on this. You filed it anyway.

rankUpgrades.description: Roll 5d8 for spheres. Wyrd spheres you roll have a 35 points chance to trigger a minor surge (your target choice).
Roll 5d8 for spheres. Wyrd spheres have a 50 points chance to trigger a minor surge (your target choice), and wyrd spheres rolled this way deal +1d6 damage when spent.

spell.name: Wild Magic Attunement
spell.description: You are attuned to the Wild Magic Surge table. Whenever a surge occurs within 60 feet (yours or anyone else's), you may choose to absorb it: the surge's damage targets the enemy nearest you instead of its original target. Once per turn.
spell.flavorText: Clause: unknown. Outcome: negotiable.

rankUpgrades.description: Absorb any surge within 60 feet once per turn. When you absorb a surge, you also gain 1 wyrd sphere.
Absorb any surge within 60 feet twice per turn. Absorbed surges deal +1d6 bonus damage when redirected to their new target.

spell.name: Chaos Amplification
spell.description: All wyrd element combinations deal 1d6 additional wyrd damage. When a surge you direct deals damage, you gain 2 mana.
spell.flavorText: Amplify what cannot be predicted. Bill the amplification.

rankUpgrades.description: Wyrd combinations deal 2d6 additional wyrd damage. Directed surges restore 4 mana and grant +5 points crit chance to your next spell.

spell.name: Surge Injection
spell.description: Spend 1 wyrd sphere and 3 mana: the next spell cast this turn (yours or an ally's) also triggers a Wild Magic Surge. You choose whether the surge's effect is beneficial (targets an ally) or harmful (targets an enemy within range of the spell).
spell.flavorText: All contracts become chaos contracts under sufficient pressure.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 1 wyrd sphere and 2 mana: next spell triggers a surge, polarity your choice. If harmful, the surge deals +15 points damage. Cooldown drops to 1 round.
Free once per turn: next spell triggers a surge, polarity your choice. Harmful surges deal +1d6 bonus damage. You may inject twice per turn (second injection costs 2 mana).

spell.name: Entropy Field
spell.description: Open a 20-foot Entropy Field within 60 feet for 1 minute: every spell cast inside (by anyone) triggers a Wild Magic Surge. You choose all surge polarities for surges inside the field.
spell.flavorText: Probability thins here. On purpose.

rankUpgrades.description: 30-foot Entropy Field: all spells inside trigger surges (your polarity choices) and enemies inside save against surges with disadvantage.
40-foot Entropy Field: all spells trigger surges, enemies save at disadvantage, and enemies who surge inside take 2d6 wyrd damage from the field itself.

spell.name: Unstable Sphere
spell.description: Your wyrd spheres are volatile: when spent, roll 1d6. On 1–2: surge triggers immediately (you choose polarity). On 3–4: deals +2d6 bonus wyrd damage. On 5–6: refunds 2 mana.
spell.flavorText: Schroedinger filed this one personally.

rankUpgrades.description: Wyrd sphere spent: 1–2 surge (your polarity), 3–4 deals +3d6 wyrd damage, 5–6 refunds 3 mana. Any result grants +5 points crit chance this turn.
Wyrd sphere spent: 1–2 surge (+15 points damage, your polarity), 3–4 deals +3d6 wyrd damage, 5–6 refunds 4 mana AND grants a free Surge Injection.

spell.name: Chaos Nova
spell.description: Consume 1 wyrd sphere: detonate wyrd energy in a 30-foot radius, dealing 3d8 wyrd damage plus 1d8 for each additional wyrd sphere in your bank. Each enemy hit triggers a wild surge (you choose: all harmful or all beneficial).
spell.flavorText: The clause detonates. Everyone is within jurisdiction.

rankUpgrades.description: Consume 1 wyrd sphere: 30-foot nova deals 4d8 + 1d8 per banked wyrd sphere. Each hit triggers a surge (your polarity per target). Cooldown drops to 2 rounds.
Consume 2 wyrd spheres: 40-foot nova deals 5d8 + 2d8 per banked wyrd sphere. Each hit triggers a surge (individual polarity choice). You gain 1 wyrd sphere for every 3 enemies hit.

spell.name: Reality Fracture
spell.description: Beneficial Wild Magic Surges you direct also apply to one ally of your choice within 30 feet (they receive the same beneficial effect). You may choose surges' polarity per-target rather than all-at-once.
spell.flavorText: The crack in the contract lets the light in — and out.

rankUpgrades.description: Beneficial surges you direct copy to two allies within 30 feet. Per-target polarity control applies to all your surges. Beneficial surges on allies are 50 points stronger.

spell.name: Borrowed Fate
spell.description: Reaction: when an enemy within 60 feet would trigger a Wild Magic Surge, spend 3 mana to intercept it. The surge is yours to direct — choose a new target and polarity. The original caster loses the surge entirely.
spell.flavorText: Their chaos, escrowed. Yours now.

rankUpgrades.description: Reaction: intercept any surge within 60 feet for free (once per round). Redirect it to any target you choose at +25 points damage or +25 points healing strength.

spell.name: Catastrophic Surge
spell.description: Harmful surges you direct deal maximum damage. You may voluntarily trigger a harmful surge targeting any enemy within 60 feet once per turn for 4 mana — no spell required.
spell.flavorText: Voluntary catastrophe. The paperwork is immaculate.

rankUpgrades.description: Harmful surges deal max damage at +25 points. Voluntary surges cost 2 mana and can be triggered twice per turn.
Harmful surges deal max damage at +25 points. Voluntary surges cost 2 mana twice per turn, and surge kills generate 1 wyrd sphere.

spell.name: Void Rift
spell.description: Tear a 15-foot Void Rift within 40 feet that lasts 1 minute. At the start of each round, the rift spits one automatic harmful surge targeting the nearest enemy inside (or any enemy if none are inside). You choose all its surge targets and effects.
spell.flavorText: Chaos, scheduled. It arrives at the agreed-upon time.

rankUpgrades.description: 20-foot Void Rift within 40 feet. Spits 2 automatic surges per round (your targets and effects each). Enemies inside take 1d6 wyrd damage per round. Cooldown drops to 8 rounds.

spell.name: Chaos Armor
spell.description: While you hold any wyrd spheres in your bank, gain +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability per wyrd sphere and resistance to wyrd damage. Beneficial surges targeting you also shield you for 1d6 health.
spell.flavorText: The chaos defends its landlord.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability per banked wyrd sphere and resistance to wyrd damage. Beneficial surges targeting you shield you for 2d6 health.

spell.name: Entropic Residue
spell.description: When a surge you directed deals damage to an enemy, that enemy takes 1d6 wyrd damage at the start of their next 2 turns (residue burns). Stacks once per surge source.
spell.flavorText: Even chaos leaves a paper trail.

rankUpgrades.description: Directed surges leave 1d6 wyrd residue per turn for 3 turns. Residue stacks twice.

spell.name: Entropy Weaving
spell.description: Your wyrd damage ignores 4 Damage Reduction. Surge Injection and Borrowed Fate no longer consume spheres — only mana.
spell.flavorText: The weave holds, even when the pattern shifts.

rankUpgrades.description: Wyrd damage ignores 6 Damage Reduction. Surge Injection and Borrowed Fate cost 0 mana as well (once per turn each).

spell.name: Volatile Power
spell.description: Wyrd spells chain to a nearby enemy within 10 feet for half damage; each chain triggers its own harmful surge (your target).
spell.flavorText: Chaos, forwarded to interested parties.

rankUpgrades.description: Wyrd spells chain to 2 enemies within 20 feet for full damage; each chain triggers a surge (your target).
Wyrd spells chain to 3 enemies within 20 feet for full damage; each chain surges (your target per chain) and chain kills generate wyrd spheres.

spell.name: Apocalypse
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Consume up to 6 wyrd spheres. A 60-foot eruption deals 5d12 wyrd damage per sphere consumed. Every enemy hit triggers a harmful surge — you choose each one's effect individually. Allies in the area receive a beneficial surge of your choice.
spell.flavorText: Final clause. All parties terminated. Chaos retains its copy.

spell.name: Entropy Doctrine
spell.description: Chaos, consistently applied. All wyrd damage you deal is increased by +1d6 damage. Directed surges deal +1d6 bonus damage or provide 10 points stronger healing.
spell.flavorText: A doctrine of disorder, held with terrifying consistency.

rankUpgrades.description: Wyrd damage +20 points. Directed surges deal +1d8 bonus damage or provide +20 points stronger healing.
Wyrd damage +35 points. Directed surges +35 points. Void Rift's automatic surges deal maximum damage.
Wyrd damage +50 points. Directed surges +50 points. Void Rift spits 3 surges per round.
Wyrd damage +70 points. Directed surges +70 points. Chaos Nova and Apocalypse cooldowns reduced by 20 points.

spell.name: Chain Reaction Engine
spell.description: Volatile Power chains deal full damage (not half). Each chain that kills an enemy also triggers an additional harmful surge targeting an enemy of your choice.
spell.flavorText: First bounce, full price. Second bounce, free surge.

rankUpgrades.description: Chains deal full damage. Kill chains surge. Kill chains also refund 1 wyrd sphere.
Chains deal 130 points damage. Kill chains surge AND generate a wyrd sphere. Chaos Nova's cooldown refreshes on any kill during its detonation.

spell.name: Probabilistic Existence
spell.description: Attacks against you have a 15 points chance to miss outright — the attacker must reroll with disadvantage. This probability rises by 5 points for each wyrd sphere in your bank.
spell.flavorText: You were never quite there. Neither was the arrow.

rankUpgrades.description: Attacks against you have a 20 points base miss chance (+5 points per wyrd sphere banked). Spells targeting you also have a 10 points miss chance.
25 points base miss chance (+5 points per wyrd sphere). Spells 15 points miss. When an attack misses this way, you steal the attacker's luck: gain +5% crit chance for 1 round.

spell.name: Runic Precision
spell.description: 3-sphere spells cost 2 less mana. When you cast a spell through an active Runic Matrix, your next sphere roll is made with 5d8 instead of 4d8 (take highest 4).
spell.flavorText: Precision is cheaper than correction.

rankUpgrades.description: 3-sphere spells cost 3 less mana. Casting through a Runic Matrix gives 5d8 sphere roll (take highest 4) and also refunds 1 mana.
3-sphere spells cost 4 less mana. Casting through a Runic Matrix gives 5d8 sphere roll (take highest 4), refunds 2 mana, and lets you immediately swap 1 banked sphere for free.

spell.name: Sphere Manipulation
spell.description: Spend 3 mana: swap up to 2 banked spheres for any elements of your choice. The swapped spheres deal +1d4 damage when next spent.
spell.flavorText: The spheres do not mind. They are not consulted.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 2 mana: swap up to 3 banked spheres to chosen elements. Swapped spheres deal +1d6 when next spent. Cooldown drops to 1 round.
Spend 1 mana: swap any number of banked spheres to chosen elements. Swapped spheres deal +1d8 when next spent. Cooldown drops to 1 round.

spell.name: Efficient Banking
spell.description: Banked spheres persist between encounters (they don't reset between fights). Your sphere bank maximum increases by 2.
spell.flavorText: Savings, elemental. Interest, none. The Athien checked.

rankUpgrades.description: Banked spheres persist between encounters; bank maximum +4. After a short rest, roll your bank composition once and keep or replace up to 2 spheres.

spell.name: Mana Crystal
spell.description: Store up to 10 mana in a Mana Crystal over any number of turns (1 mana per Action Point spent). Shatter the crystal (instant, 1 Action Point): recover all stored mana. You can only hold 1 crystal at a time.
spell.flavorText: The Athien keep everything in writing. Including reserves.

rankUpgrades.description: Store up to 20 mana in a crystal. Shattering also grants 1 sphere of your choice and a bonus Action Point (use it only to cast). Cooldown drops to 1 round.
Store up to 30 mana in a crystal. In combat, crystals passively accrue 1 mana per round. Shattering grants 2 chosen spheres and a bonus Action Point.

spell.name: Sphere Lock
spell.description: At the end of your turn, declare one element locked: that element is guaranteed to appear in your next sphere roll. Locked spheres deal +1d6 damage when spent.
spell.flavorText: The reservation is non-transferable.

rankUpgrades.description: Lock one element; it appears guaranteed in next roll. Locked spheres deal +2d6 when spent.
Lock two elements simultaneously; both guaranteed in next roll. Locked spheres deal +2d6 when spent and cost 1 less mana to use.

spell.name: Precision Casting
spell.description: Spells cast through an active Runic Matrix gain +2 to hit and cannot be counterspelled. Additionally, 2-sphere spells cost 1 less mana.
spell.flavorText: The clause names its target. The target attends.

rankUpgrades.description: Spells through a Runic Matrix gain +3 to hit, cannot be interrupted, ignore half cover, and 2-sphere spells cost 2 less mana.

spell.name: Runic Matrix
spell.description: Inscribe a Runic Matrix centered on a point within 30 feet (10-foot radius). It lasts 1 minute. Spells cast through the matrix cost 2 less mana and deal +1d8 damage. You may have 1 active Runic Matrix at a time.
spell.flavorText: Pre-printed clauses. Just add violence.

rankUpgrades.description: 15-foot Runic Matrix within 30 feet (1 minute). Spells through it cost 3 less mana and deal +2d8 damage. Cooldown drops to 3 rounds.

spell.name: Sphere Synthesis
spell.description: Spend 4 mana: combine 2 spheres of different elements in your bank into 1 sphere of any element you choose. The synthesized sphere deals +1d6 damage when spent.
spell.flavorText: Two clauses, one signature. Legal in three provinces.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 2 mana: synthesize 2 different spheres into 1 chosen sphere. Synthesized sphere deals +2d6 when spent. Cooldown drops to 1 round.
Free synthesis once per turn: combine 2 different spheres into 1 chosen sphere. Synthesized sphere deals +2d6 when spent and counts as a pure pair for purity bonuses.

spell.name: Sphere Network
spell.description: While your Runic Matrix is active, single-target spells cast through it also strike 1 additional target within 30 feet of the primary target at 50 points damage.
spell.flavorText: Networking. The spheres hate it. It works.

rankUpgrades.description: Matrix-amplified single-target spells strike 2 additional targets within 30 feet at 50 points damage each.
Matrix-amplified single-target spells strike 3 additional targets within 45 feet at 50 points damage each.

spell.name: Perfect Control
spell.description: As a free action at the start of your turn, rearrange your entire sphere bank in any order. Spells gain +1 to attack rolls for each element currently represented in your bank.
spell.flavorText: Total command, filed in triplicate.

rankUpgrades.description: Rearrange bank freely each turn. Spells gain +2 to attack rolls per element represented and ignore half cover. You may Sphere Manipulate as a free action (once per turn).

spell.name: Runic Ascendancy
spell.description: You may maintain 2 Runic Matrices simultaneously. Damage dice of spells cast through any matrix are maximized.
spell.flavorText: The architecture now outranks the architect.

spell.name: Crystal Bastion
spell.description: Shatter your Mana Crystal defensively (instant reaction): gain a damage shield absorbing 3d6 per 5 mana stored in the crystal. The stored mana is lost but so is the incoming damage.
spell.flavorText: The savings account becomes the wall.

rankUpgrades.description: Crystal Bastion absorbs 4d6 per 5 stored mana. After the shield breaks, it detonates for 2d6 arcane damage to all adjacent enemies.

spell.name: Scheduled Withdrawal
spell.description: At the start of your turn, if you cast no spell the previous turn, gain 2 banked spheres of your choice. This represents deliberate preparation — holding back to set up the perfect turn.
spell.flavorText: Patience compounds. The bank pays in ammunition.

spell.name: Arcane Efficiency
spell.description: 4-sphere spells cost 3 less mana. While both Runic Matrices are active simultaneously, your sphere bank rolls an additional die (5d8, take highest 4).
spell.flavorText: Silence, contractually guaranteed.

rankUpgrades.description: 4-sphere spells cost 5 less mana. Both matrices active: 5d8 sphere roll (take highest 4). Sphere Manipulation costs 0 mana.

spell.name: Rune Optimization
spell.description: Each Runic Matrix gains 1 additional charge (can empower 1 more spell before needing recast). Deploying a Runic Matrix now costs 1 fewer sphere.
spell.flavorText: The inscriptions align with the weave.

rankUpgrades.description: Each matrix gains 2 additional charges. Deploying costs 0 spheres.
Matrices are permanent until replaced (no duration). Deploying costs 0 spheres. You may Sphere Synthesize through a matrix for free once per matrix per turn.

spell.name: Elemental Convergence
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 8 mana and 1–6 spheres of any elements to draft a custom spell effect: you describe the damage type, range, area, target, and riders. The number of spheres spent determines the power (1 sphere: minor effect; 6 spheres: legendary effect). The Canopy-Ledger audits the spell after the fact.
spell.flavorText: Valerius wrote the First Contract this way. You are holding the pen now.

spell.name: Ledger Mastery
spell.description: Every line item audited. All spell costs are reduced by 1 mana. Spells cast through an active Runic Matrix always have their mana cost reduced to 0 after all other reductions.
spell.flavorText: The audit found savings everywhere.

rankUpgrades.description: All spell costs reduced by 2 mana. Matrix spells free after reductions.
All spell costs reduced by 3 mana. Matrix spells free. Sphere Synthesis and Sphere Manipulation are always free.
All spell costs reduced by 4 mana. Matrix spells free. Synthesis and Manipulation free. Your Mana Crystal accrues 2 mana per round.
All spell costs reduced by 5 mana. Matrix spells free. Synthesis and Manipulation free. Crystal accrues 2 mana/round. Elemental Convergence's cooldown is halved.

spell.name: Deep Vault
spell.description: Your sphere bank maximum increases by 2. At the start of combat, your bank contains any spheres you had at the end of your last encounter (Efficient Banking carried them).
spell.flavorText: Structural reinforcement, morally approved.

rankUpgrades.description: Bank maximum +4. All spheres persist between encounters. Once per combat, draw 2 additional spheres of your choice as a free action.
Bank maximum +6. Spheres persist. Free sphere draw twice per combat. Sphere Locked elements persist between rounds automatically.

spell.name: Matrix Lattice
spell.description: While any Runic Matrix is active: gain +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability and 2 Damage Reduction to all damage per active matrix. When a matrix expires or is replaced, it detonates for 1d8 arcane damage to all enemies within its area.
spell.flavorText: The architecture defends its tenant. And evicts its guests.

rankUpgrades.description: +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability and 2 Damage Reduction per active matrix. Expiring matrices detonate for 2d8 arcane to enemies within.
+3 Durability Steps to equipped durability and 4 Damage Reduction per active matrix. Expiring matrices detonate for 3d8. Crystal Bastion's shield absorbs 25% more damage.

spell.name: First Contract's Heir
spell.description: Elemental Convergence costs 1 fewer sphere (minimum 1) and its cooldown is reduced by 5 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Valerius left room in the will. For exactly you.

rankUpgrades.description: Elemental Convergence costs 2 fewer spheres, cooldown -10 rounds, and its cast time is halved.
Elemental Convergence costs 3 fewer spheres, cooldown -15 rounds, instant cast, and may be signed twice per combat.

spell.name: Hunger Pact Ignition
spell.description: Passive: Your ancestral starvation flares. Generate +50% more Rage from all attacks, and taking damage generates 1 Rage per 3 damage suffered.
spell.flavorText: The copper taste of kin-blood in the marrow.

rankUpgrades.description: Generate +75% more Rage from all attacks; melee strikes deal +1d4 slicing bonus damage.
Generate +100% more Rage; critical hits grant an immediate +15 Rage and deal +1d8 slicing.

spell.name: Reckless Abandon
spell.description: Spend 1 AP & 5 HP: Split your own flesh to generate 20 Rage and strike with wild fury for 1d10 slicing + 1d6 smashing damage.
spell.flavorText: Pain is merely kinetic momentum waiting for direction.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 2d8 slicing + 1d8 smashing; generates 25 Rage.
Damage increases to 2d10 slicing + 2d6 smashing; critical hits cost no HP and refund 1 AP.

spell.name: Boiling Momentum
spell.description: Passive: Gain +5 ft movement speed. While at high Rage (50+), you gain Advantage on checks to avoid or break grapples and difficult terrain costs no extra movement.
spell.flavorText: He runs like the blizzard is at his throat.

rankUpgrades.description: Movement speed bonus increases to +10 ft; at 75+ Rage you can charge through enemy squares freely.

spell.name: Hemorrhagic Cleave
spell.description: Spend 2 AP & 20 Rage: Cleave in a 10 ft cone dealing 2d8 slicing damage and applying a 1d6 Bleed for 2 rounds to all foes struck.
spell.flavorText: Open the veins. Let Nordhalla's snow turn red.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 3d8 slicing and Bleed increases to 2d6 per round.
Damage increases to 4d8 slicing; enemies bleeding from this attack take +20% damage from your single-target attacks.

spell.name: Sundering Hack
spell.description: Passive: Spending 25+ Rage shreds 3 Passive DR from the target for 2 rounds, stacking up to 2 times.
spell.flavorText: Hacking bone until armor falls off the frame.

rankUpgrades.description: Armor shred increases to -5 Passive DR per stack, stacking up to 3 times.
At maximum stacks, the target takes 2d8 slicing damage whenever it attempts an attack.

spell.name: Unbridled Adrenaline
spell.description: Passive: When your health drops below 30%, your strikes completely bypass enemy physical resistances and deal +25% bonus critical damage.
spell.flavorText: The brink of death is where the Savage truly awakens.

rankUpgrades.description: Threshold expands to below 40% health, and critical damage bonus increases to +40%.
Threshold expands to below 50% health; while below 30% health, your attacks cannot miss.

spell.name: Red Mist Surge
spell.description: Spend 1 AP & 10 HP: Instantly jump to 75 Rage. For 2 rounds, gain +1 extra attack per round.
spell.flavorText: A red veil descends. Thinking stops; butchery commences.

rankUpgrades.description: HP cost reduced to 5, and gain +2d6 bonus slicing damage on all strikes during the surge.
Bonus slicing damage increases to +4d6; the surge lasts 3 rounds, and each kill during it extends the duration by 1 round (maximum 5).

spell.name: Decapitating Strike
spell.description: Spend 2 AP & 40 Rage: Overhead executioner blow dealing 4d10 slicing damage. Against targets below 30% HP, damage is doubled.
spell.flavorText: Sever the neck before the scream forms.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 5d10 slicing, and execute threshold expands to below 40% HP.
Damage increases to 7d10 slicing; killing a foe instantly resets this ability's cooldown and refunds 40 Rage.

spell.name: Flesh Feast
spell.description: Passive: Whenever you kill a creature or score a critical strike with a slicing attack, heal for 15% of the damage dealt.
spell.flavorText: The Skald feast never ends. Every corpse feeds the march.

rankUpgrades.description: Healing increases to 30% of the damage dealt and also restores 15 Rage.

spell.name: Caldera Eruption
spell.description: Passive: While at 80+ Rage, all your melee strikes erupt with volcanic heat: deal +2d8 ember damage and ignite enemies for 1d8 ember per round for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: The blood does not merely flow; it boils into slag.

rankUpgrades.description: Eruption damage increases to +3d8 ember and ignite deals 2d8 ember per round.
Eruption damage increases to +4d8 ember; burning enemies take +20% damage from all slicing attacks.

spell.name: Pain-Driven Fury
spell.description: Passive: You cannot be Stunned or Incapacitated while above 50 Rage. Taking critical hits grants +30 Rage.
spell.flavorText: Concussion is merely another reason to swing harder.

rankUpgrades.description: You are also immune to Fear, Charm, and Sleep while above 50 Rage; critical hits taken grant +50 Rage.

spell.name: Whirlwind of Ruin
spell.description: Spend 3 AP & 60 Rage: Spin in a 15 ft radius death cyclone dealing 6d8 slicing + 4d6 ember damage. Hits apply Hemorrhagic Cleave's Bleed to all targets.
spell.flavorText: Two axes, six corpses, zero hesitation.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 8d8 slicing + 6d6 ember, and radius extends to 20 ft.
Damage increases to 10d8 slicing + 8d6 ember; every target killed extends your current round's Action Points by +1.

spell.name: Limitless Furnace
spell.description: Passive: Maximum Rage increased to 125. Overheat / Metabolic Burnout penalties are halved.
spell.flavorText: His heart was forged to withstand a caldera.

rankUpgrades.description: Maximum Rage increased to 150, and you are completely immune to Metabolic Burnout penalties.

spell.name: Avatar of the Hunger Pact
spell.description: CAPSTONE — Spend 3 AP & 100 Rage: Surrender body entirely to the ancestral Hunger for 3 rounds. Health cannot drop below 1 HP, melee weapon range increases by 5 ft, every strike triggers an automatic Decapitating Strike execute regardless of target HP, and slicing damage dealt is converted 50% into health.
spell.flavorText: Grum Bloodhammer stands in his skin. The ancestors take the wheel.

spell.name: Relentless Massacre
spell.description: Passive: Landing a killing blow instantly grants 2 Action Points and resets the cooldown on all Savage offensive abilities.
spell.flavorText: One falls. Two more step up to die.

rankUpgrades.description: Also grants +100% critical strike chance on your next attack after scoring a kill.
Killing blows also generate 30 Rage, and every kill beyond the first each round refunds 1 additional Action Point (maximum +2 AP per round).

spell.name: Hemorrhagic Ruin
spell.description: Passive: Your Bleeds no longer close. Whenever a target suffering your Bleed is struck by you, it takes an additional 1d4 slicing damage, and your Bleeds can stack up to 3 times.
spell.flavorText: Every wound remembers the blade. Every drop remembers the debt.

rankUpgrades.description: Bleeding foes take an additional 1d6 slicing damage when struck, and your Bleeds stack up to 4 times.
Bleeding foes take an additional 1d8 slicing damage when struck; Bleeds stack up to 5 times, and a foe that dies while bleeding bursts, spreading a 1d6 Bleed for 2 rounds to all enemies within 10 ft.
Bleeding foes take an additional 2d6 slicing damage when struck; when your Bleed damage drops a foe below 20% HP, the wound ruptures for 3d8 slicing.
Bleeding foes take an additional 2d8 slicing damage when struck; ruptured foes take 4d8 slicing instead, and any enemy reduced to 0 HP by a rupture cannot be revived or healed for 3 rounds.

spell.name: Bloodprice Apotheosis
spell.description: Passive: The closer you stand to death, the harder you swing. Every 10% of maximum HP you are missing grants +1d6 slicing damage on melee strikes (maximum +3d6).
spell.flavorText: The body is a ledger. Death only collects what is owed.

rankUpgrades.description: Every 10% of maximum HP missing grants +1d8 slicing damage (maximum +5d8); while below 25% HP, critical hits execute enemies below 10% HP.
Every 10% of maximum HP missing grants +1d10 slicing damage (maximum +6d10); while below 25% HP, critical hits execute enemies below 15% HP, and slaying a foe restores 10% of your maximum HP.

spell.name: Overheat Burst
spell.description: Spend 3 AP & 50 Rage: Detonate every mote of Rage at once, erupting in a 20 ft radius for 6d8 ember + 4d8 smashing damage. Damage increases by 1d8 for every 10% of maximum HP you are missing, and struck enemies lose 5 Passive DR for 3 rounds.
spell.flavorText: There is a point past pain where the body simply becomes weather.

rankUpgrades.description: Eruption grows to 8d8 ember + 5d8 smashing; struck enemies lose 10 Passive DR for 3 rounds and burn for 2d6 ember per round for 2 rounds.
Eruption grows to 10d8 ember + 6d8 smashing; below 30% HP it automatically critically strikes, and enemies already at 0 Passive DR take an extra 3d8 smashing.

spell.name: Shattered Resilience
spell.description: Passive: Your Rage decays half as fast. Taking physical damage causes your skin to calcify into grey scar tissue, granting +2 Passive DR and a 5 HP temporary Grit shield.
spell.flavorText: Wounds do not open; they solidify into granite.

rankUpgrades.description: Passive DR increases to +4 and temporary Grit shield increases to 10 HP.
Passive DR increases to +6; at 50+ Rage, your armor penalties from high Rage are completely eliminated.

spell.name: Caldera Headbutt
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Smash your forehead into target foe for 1d8 smashing damage. Dazes the target (-2 to hit for 1 round) and generates +15 Rage.
spell.flavorText: Nordhalla ice is hard. His skull is harder.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 2d8 smashing, generates +20 Rage, and knocks target back 5 ft.
Damage increases to 3d8 smashing; target must make a CON Save or be Stunned for 1 round.

spell.name: Tectonic Mass
spell.description: Passive: You cannot be pushed, pulled, or knocked Prone while at 40+ Rage. Count as one size larger for grapple contests.
spell.flavorText: Try shoving an avalanche uphill.

rankUpgrades.description: Threshold lowers to 20+ Rage; you deal 1d8 smashing damage to anyone attempting to grapple or displace you.

spell.name: Calloused Barrier
spell.description: Spend 1 AP & 25 Rage: Instantly calcify stored Rage into a massive bone-scar shield granting 25 temporary HP and +4 Passive DR for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: The flesh remembers every hit and weaves an armor out of grief.

rankUpgrades.description: Temporary HP increases to 40 and Passive DR increases to +6.
Temporary HP increases to 60; when the barrier expires or breaks, it erupts outward dealing 3d6 piercing damage in 10 ft.

spell.name: Reactive Bone Spines
spell.description: Passive: Whenever an enemy hits you in melee, sharp calcium spines shatter outward: attacker takes 1d8 stabbing damage.
spell.flavorText: Hitting him is merely loading the spring.

rankUpgrades.description: Spine damage increases to 2d8 stabbing and applies 1d6 bleed for 2 rounds.
Spine damage increases to 3d8 stabbing; also triggers against ranged attackers within 15 ft.

spell.name: Tectonic Stomp
spell.description: Spend 2 AP & 30 Rage: Stomp the earth in a 15 ft radius. Deals 3d8 smashing damage and knocks all enemies Prone (STR save halves damage and negates Prone).
spell.flavorText: When the mountain stumbles, everything on it falls.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 4d8 smashing and radius extends to 20 ft.
Damage increases to 5d8 smashing; leaves Difficult Terrain of shattered basalt in the area for 3 rounds.

spell.name: Living Obsidian
spell.description: Passive: While above 60 Rage, convert 30% of all incoming physical and fire damage into temporary HP.
spell.flavorText: Forge-heat fuses the ash and iron into black glass.

rankUpgrades.description: Conversion percentage increases to 50%, and threshold lowers to 40+ Rage.
Conversion percentage increases to 75%, threshold lowers to 20+ Rage, and each converted hit generates +5 Rage.

spell.name: Colossus Tenacity
spell.description: Passive: Maximum Health increased by +30%. Whenever you drop below 35% health, gain 100 Rage and a 50 HP stone shield instantly.
spell.flavorText: The harder you hit the boulder, the sharper the edges become.

rankUpgrades.description: Max HP bonus increases to +50%, shield value increases to 90 HP, and while the shield holds you are immune to all crowd control.

spell.name: Spine Burst
spell.description: Spend 2 AP & 40 Rage: Shatter your protective bone carapace outward in a 15 ft radius: deals 4d8 stabbing + 2d8 smashing damage to all enemies and Impales them (movement speed reduced to 0 for 1 round).
spell.flavorText: A thousand calcium shrapnel shards leave no clean meat.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 5d8 stabbing + 3d8 smashing, and root duration extends to 2 rounds.
Damage increases to 7d8 stabbing + 4d8 smashing; immediately regenerates full bone plating after firing.

spell.name: Caldera Juggernaut Charge
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Charge up to 40 ft in a straight line, smashing through enemies: deals 3d10 smashing damage to every creature in your path and tosses them 10 ft aside.
spell.flavorText: Nothing diverts the charge. Doors, barricades, and bodies all fold.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 4d10 smashing; grants 20 temporary HP for each enemy trampled.
Damage increases to 6d10 smashing; enemies trampled are Stunned for 1 round.

spell.name: Heart of Caldera Basalt
spell.description: Passive: You take 25% reduced damage from critical hits and your Active Soak die can never roll lower than half its maximum value.
spell.flavorText: Soft organs have been replaced with hardened magma.

rankUpgrades.description: You are completely immune to bonus damage from critical hits, and your Active Soak die always rolls its maximum possible value.

spell.name: Mountain Breaker
spell.description: Spend 3 AP & 60 Rage: Strike with apocalyptic force in a 20 ft cone: 7d10 smashing damage, permanently destroying enemy physical armor (-10 Passive DR) and creating an impassable stone crater.
spell.flavorText: He hit the earth so hard the horizon flinched.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 9d10 smashing, and cone extends to 25 ft.
Damage increases to 12d10 smashing; enemies struck take double damage from all sources for 1 round.

spell.name: Vow of the Monolith
spell.description: Passive: All temporary Grit shields granted by your abilities are increased by 50% in magnitude and do not decay over time.
spell.flavorText: Once the stone forms, it stays until shattered.

rankUpgrades.description: Shield magnitudes increased by 100%, and while any Grit shield holds, you deal +3d6 smashing bonus damage on all melee attacks.

spell.name: Avatar of Caldera Iron
spell.description: CAPSTONE — Spend 3 AP & 100 Rage: Transform completely into living basalt and volcanic iron for 3 rounds. Gain +10 Passive DR, 100 temporary HP, complete immunity to all displacement and mental conditions, and any enemy that strikes you takes 4d8 piercing damage from bone spines and is knocked Prone.
spell.flavorText: He is no longer a warrior. He is a piece of Nordhalla that decided to walk.

spell.name: Living Fortress of the Waste
spell.description: Passive: Whenever you are attacked, redirect 25% of any damage taken by allies within 20 ft into your own Grit shields, and your size category increases permanently by 1.
spell.flavorText: Stand behind the Juggernaut. Nordhalla itself cannot pierce his bulk.

rankUpgrades.description: Redirect increases to 50% of damage taken by allies, and you grant +4 Passive DR to all companions within 20 ft.
Redirect increases to 75%; companions within 20 ft gain +8 Passive DR, and damage you redirect is reduced by 50% before it reaches your Grit shields.

spell.name: Calcified Apotheosis
spell.description: Passive: Trauma Calcification perfected. Every 20 damage you take from a single hit calcifies a scar layer, granting +2 Passive DR and 10 Grit shield (stacks up to +10 DR and 50 Grit). Layers persist for 3 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Every wound writes another plate of armor onto the same hide.

rankUpgrades.description: Each scar layer now grants +3 Passive DR and 15 Grit shield, stacking up to +12 Passive DR and 75 Grit.
Each scar layer now grants +3 Passive DR and 20 Grit shield, stacking up to +15 Passive DR and 100 Grit; scar layers persist until shattered.
Scar layers trigger on hits of 15+ damage and grant +4 Passive DR and 25 Grit shield each, stacking up to +16 Passive DR and 125 Grit.
Scar layers cap at +20 Passive DR and 150 Grit; whenever a layer is added you gain 50 temporary HP, and at maximum stacks you are immune to critical hits.

spell.name: Reactive Spine Mantle
spell.description: Passive: Your reactive bone spines fuse into a permanent mantle. Whenever a creature within 10 ft hits you in melee, it takes 2d8 stabbing damage and starts Bleeding (1d6 per round for 2 rounds).
spell.flavorText: Strike the mountain and the mountain's teeth answer first.

rankUpgrades.description: Retaliation reaches 20 ft and spine damage increases to 4d8 stabbing; each trigger also grants you 10 Grit shield.
Spine damage increases to 6d8 stabbing; each trigger grants 15 Grit shield and erupts for 3d8 stabbing damage to all enemies within 10 ft of the attacker.

spell.name: Geothermal Ironhide
spell.description: Passive: Caldera heat soaks into iron-hard skin. You take 50% less fire and ember damage, and whenever you take such damage you convert the prevented damage into a Grit shield (up to 15 Grit per hit).
spell.flavorText: The forge is not a place he visits. It is a place he carries.

rankUpgrades.description: Fire and ember damage reduction increases to 75%, and the Grit shield gained from a prevented hit increases to 25.
You are immune to fire and ember damage and convert all prevented damage into Grit shields (up to 40 per hit); while any Grit shield holds, your melee attacks deal +2d8 ember bonus damage.

spell.name: Sanguine Dictator
spell.description: Passive: Your war cries affect all targets within 30 ft. Whenever you take self-damage from your abilities, your nearby allies are galvanized, gaining +1d4 bonus damage on their next strike.
spell.flavorText: His blood hits the snow; their blades strike twice as deep.

rankUpgrades.description: Galvanized allies gain +1d8 bonus slicing damage on their next strike, and radius extends to 40 ft.
Galvanized allies gain +2d6 bonus slicing damage and +10 ft movement speed; you gain +5 Rage per ally galvanized.

spell.name: Tyrant's Command
spell.description: Spend 1 AP & 15 Rage: Let loose a deafening roar across 30 ft: enemies must succeed on a Will save or be Intimidated (-2 to hit for 1 round), while allies gain +2 to hit on their next attack.
spell.flavorText: Command does not ask. Command tears through eardrums.

rankUpgrades.description: Intimidate penalty increases to -3 to hit, and allies gain +3 to hit and +1d6 slicing damage on their next strike.
Intimidate penalty increases to -4 to hit; failed saves leave enemies Frightened for 1 round.

spell.name: Kin-Blood Resonance
spell.description: Passive: Whenever an ally within 30 ft lands a critical hit, gain +10 Rage. Whenever an ally falls below 50% health, your war cry ranges are doubled.
spell.flavorText: The Skald marrow connects all who bleed in the same circle.

rankUpgrades.description: Ally critical hits grant +20 Rage, and you heal for 10% of damage dealt by ally critical hits.

spell.name: Dirge of Battle
spell.description: Spend 2 AP & 30 Rage: A blood-spraying roar that whips nearby allies in 30 ft into a combat frenzy for 2 rounds: grants +15% attack speed and +1d8 slicing damage to all ally weapon strikes.
spell.flavorText: A funeral song sung before the enemy is dead.

rankUpgrades.description: Frenzy grants +25% attack speed and +2d8 slicing damage.
Frenzy grants +35% attack speed; allies in frenzy gain 10% lifesteal on all weapon attacks.

spell.name: Gut-Wrenching Bellow
spell.description: Spend 1 AP & 20 Rage: Unleash a concussive shout in a 15 ft cone: deals 2d8 sonic/smashing damage and shreds 3 Passive DR from all enemies for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: The air vibrates violently enough to split plate seams.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 3d8 smashing, cone extends to 20 ft, and armor shred increases to -5 Passive DR.
Damage increases to 4d8 smashing; enemies struck are Deafened and cannot communicate or cast vocal spells for 1 round.

spell.name: Aura of the Blood Feeder
spell.description: Passive: You and all allies within 30 ft heal for 10% of physical damage dealt to bleeding or wounded enemies.
spell.flavorText: The pack feeds together. The meat belongs to all.

rankUpgrades.description: Lifesteal increases to 18% of physical damage dealt.
Lifesteal increases to 25%; killing blows scored by allies under the aura refund 10 Rage to you and heal the entire party for 15 HP.

spell.name: Dictator's Focus
spell.description: Spend 1 AP & 15 Rage: Mark an enemy priority target for 2 rounds. All party members gain +3 to hit and +20% critical damage against the marked target.
spell.flavorText: Kill that one first. Then we discuss the rest.

rankUpgrades.description: Party bonus increases to +5 to hit and +35% critical damage; when the marked target dies, all allies gain 1 free Action Point.
Party bonus increases to +7 to hit and +50% critical damage, and the mark lasts 3 rounds; when the marked target dies, all allies gain 1 free Action Point and +20 temporary HP.

spell.name: Blood Tithe Command
spell.description: Spend 2 AP & 40 Rage: Siphon a portion of blood from all enemies in 30 ft: deals 3d8 necrotic/slicing damage to each enemy and pools the total damage into a healing wave for your entire party.
spell.flavorText: Taxes are paid in iron or blood. Nordhalla accepts only blood.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 4d8 slicing, and healing pool is doubled.
Damage increases to 6d8 slicing; enemies struck have their damage dealt reduced by 25% for 2 rounds.

spell.name: Rallying Execution
spell.description: Spend 2 AP & 35 Rage: Execute a wounded foe in melee for 4d10 slicing damage. If this strike kills the target, all allies within 40 ft immediately gain 1 bonus Action Point.
spell.flavorText: Nothing accelerates an army like seeing the enemy leader fall in halves.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 7d10 slicing; on kill, grants allies +25 temporary HP and resets the cooldown on all ally abilities with cooldowns of 2 rounds or less.

spell.name: Shared Metabolic Surge
spell.description: Passive: While you are at 75+ Rage, all party members share your heat benefits: they gain +2d6 ember bonus damage on attacks and ignore difficult terrain.
spell.flavorText: When the leader burns, the entire line turns white-hot.

rankUpgrades.description: Threshold lowers to 50+ Rage, and bonus damage increases to +3d6 ember.
Threshold lowers to 40+ Rage; allies also gain Advantage on all physical saving throws.

spell.name: Voice of the Caldera Lord
spell.description: Passive: All your shout and war cry abilities cost 1 less AP (minimum 0) and cannot be interrupted or silenced.
spell.flavorText: No magic can choke the roar of the warlord.

rankUpgrades.description: Shouts also grant you 10 Rage on use and knock adjacent enemies back 5 ft.

spell.name: Total Mobilization Roar
spell.description: Spend 3 AP & 60 Rage: Command your entire team to strike simultaneously across 40 ft: every ally can immediately use a free Reaction to make a basic melee or ranged weapon attack dealing +3d8 bonus slicing damage.
spell.flavorText: EVERY BLADE. NOW.

rankUpgrades.description: Bonus damage increases to +4d8 slicing, and allies gain +15 ft movement speed for the attack.
Bonus damage increases to +6d8 slicing; critical hits scored during this mobilization stun struck enemies for 1 round.

spell.name: Throne of Scars
spell.description: Passive: For every enemy slain within your aura, all allies gain +2% permanent damage bonus for the remainder of the combat encounter (up to +30%).
spell.flavorText: Every victory builds the dais higher.

rankUpgrades.description: Cap increases to +50% damage bonus, and each stack also grants +1 Passive DR to all party members.

spell.name: Avatar of the Sanguine Sovereign
spell.description: CAPSTONE — Spend 3 AP & 100 Rage: Crown yourself the Absolute Sovereign of the Pack for 3 rounds. All allies within 50 ft become immune to Fear, Charm, and death (cannot drop below 1 HP), gain 50% lifesteal on all damage dealt, and your war cries trigger every turn automatically without spending AP.
spell.flavorText: While the Sovereign stands, the pack cannot bleed out. Victory is mandatory.

spell.name: Pact of the Everlasting March
spell.description: Passive: Combat encounters begin with full party under Dirge of Battle frenzy at no resource cost. Allies rolling damage dice add your Strength modifier to every damage roll.
spell.flavorText: The ancestors march with every member of the company.

rankUpgrades.description: Adds double your Strength modifier to ally damage rolls, and party members are immune to exhaustion.
Adds triple your Strength modifier to ally damage rolls, the party is immune to exhaustion, and the opening Dirge of Battle frenzy lasts 2 additional rounds.

spell.name: Wounds Are Orders
spell.description: Passive: Every wound is a command. Whenever you take self-damage from one of your abilities, all allies within 40 ft are galvanized: their next weapon strike deals +1d6 bonus slicing damage and they regain 5 health. You generate 5 Rage.
spell.flavorText: The Sovereign bleeds, and the pack sharpens.

rankUpgrades.description: Whenever you take self-damage from an ability, allies within 40 ft are galvanized: +2d6 bonus slicing damage on their next strike and 8 health regained. You generate 8 Rage.
Whenever you take self-damage from an ability, allies within 50 ft are galvanized: +3d6 bonus slicing damage on their next strike and 12 health regained. You generate 12 Rage.
Galvanize rises to +4d6 bonus slicing damage and 18 health regained, and galvanized allies gain +10 ft movement speed until the end of their next turn. You generate 15 Rage.
Galvanize rises to +6d6 bonus slicing damage and 25 health regained; the first galvanization each round also ends one Frightened or Prone condition on every ally. You generate 20 Rage.

spell.name: Terror Is Policy
spell.description: Passive: Your roars rewrite the enemy's courage. Enemies that fail their save against any of your shouts are Intimidated for 3 rounds, and every ally's attack deals +1d6 bonus slicing damage to Intimidated enemies.
spell.flavorText: Mercy was never in the battle plan.

rankUpgrades.description: Intimidated lasts 4 rounds and the pack's bonus damage rises to +2d6 slicing; an Intimidated enemy that dies bursts for 3d6 slicing damage in a 10 ft radius.

The pack's bonus damage rises to +3d6 slicing; striking an Intimidated enemy grants the attacker 10 temporary HP, and an Intimidated enemy that dies grants every ally within 30 ft 1 free Action Point.

spell.name: Communion of Scars
spell.description: Passive: You bleed first so the pack need not. While you are below 50% health, all allies within 50 ft gain 10% lifesteal on all damage dealt and +1d6 bonus ember damage on weapon strikes.
spell.flavorText: Every scar is a ration shared with the company.

rankUpgrades.description: While you are below 60% health, allies within 50 ft gain 20% lifesteal, +2d6 bonus ember damage, and share your Dirge of Battle frenzy without needing the cast.
While you are below 75% health, allies within 50 ft gain 30% lifesteal and +3d6 bonus ember damage; whenever an ally heals from this lifesteal, you regain 5 health and 5 Rage.

spell.name: Fluid Transition
spell.description: Instantly transition into any unlocked shapeshift form without paying Body Toll: gain 2 Flux and +10ft movement speed for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The current does not ask which way. It knows.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain 3 Flux, +15ft movement speed, and your next form attack deals +2d6 bonus physical damage.
Gain 4 Flux, +20ft speed, next attack deals +3d6 damage and can be used twice per round.

spell.name: Water Dance Dodge
spell.description: Reaction (spend 1 Flux): when targeted by an attack or spell, become liquid and automatically dodge the attack, moving up to 10 feet in any direction without provoking opportunity attacks.
spell.flavorText: You are already elsewhere. You were always already elsewhere.

rankUpgrades.description: Dodge moves up to 15 feet, grants you 2 Flux, and cooldown drops to 1 round.
Dodge moves up to 20 feet, grants 3 Flux, resets Fluid Transition cooldown, and can be used on area effects.

spell.name: Momentum Reserve
spell.description: Your Flux decays 50 points slower, and you gain +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability for every 3 Flux you currently maintain.
spell.flavorText: The bridge remembers every crossing.

rankUpgrades.description: Flux does not decay outside of combat; gain +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability and +2 Damage Reduction against all-damage for every 2 Flux maintained.

spell.name: Cascading Current
spell.description: Spend 2 Flux: unleash a rapid 3-strike form combination against a target within 10 feet. Deals 2d8 slicing damage, generates 2 Flux, and transitions you into a complementary form automatically.
spell.flavorText: Two moves, one breath.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 3d8 slicing damage, generates 3 Flux, and ignores up to 4 points of enemy Armor.
Deals 4d8 slicing damage, generates 3 Flux, ignores up to 4 points of enemy Armor, and knocks target prone.

spell.name: Combo Weaving
spell.description: Whenever you transition forms in combat, your next attack within 1 round deals +2d6 bonus damage and refunds 1 Action Point (once per turn).
spell.flavorText: One sentence, three forms, no punctuation.

rankUpgrades.description: Form transitions give +3d6 bonus damage, refund 1 AP, and increase critical chance by 10 points.
Form transitions give +4d6 bonus damage, refund 1 AP twice per turn, and increase critical chance by 15 points.

spell.name: Confluence Strike
spell.description: Spend 4 Flux: blend two active forms into a single devastating hybrid attack. Deals 2d8 smashing and rime damage in a 15-foot line, knocking all enemies back 15 feet.
spell.flavorText: The rivers meet. Something pours out.

rankUpgrades.description: 25-foot line deals 3d8 smashing/rime damage, knocks enemies 20ft back, and freezes them for 1 round.
35-foot line deals 4d8 smashing/rime damage, knocks enemies 20ft back, freezes for 1 round, and can be recast immediately for 0 Flux if it hits 2+ enemies.

spell.name: Liquid Motion
spell.description: While at 4 or more Flux, your movement speed increases by +15 feet, you can move freely through enemy spaces, and difficult terrain does not hinder you.
spell.flavorText: Crowds are just slow water.

rankUpgrades.description: +20ft movement at 4+ Flux; passing through an enemy space deals 2d6 cold damage to them.
+25ft movement at 3+ Flux; passing through enemies deals 3d6 cold damage, slows them by 15ft, and grants you 1 Flux per enemy passed.

spell.name: Mist Slip
spell.description: Spend 3 Flux: dissolve into mist and teleport up to 35 feet to an unoccupied space. Reforming behind an enemy grants advantage on attacks and sunders their durability by -3 for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: The apex of fluidity is being several places at once.

rankUpgrades.description: Teleport up to 45 feet, sunder durability by -5, and deals 3d8 cold damage to all enemies around your arrival point.
Teleport up to 60 feet, sunder durability by -6, deals 4d8 cold damage, and leaves behind a decoy mist that explodes for 4d8 cold when struck.

spell.name: Toll Absorption
spell.description: Your body thrives on transformation: every form transition heals you for 2d6 health and restores 1 Action Point.
spell.flavorText: The bridge holds. The bridge has practice.

rankUpgrades.description: Form transitions heal for 4d6 health, restore 1 AP, and grant +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability (stacks up to +6).

spell.name: Torrential Barrage
spell.description: Spend 5 Flux: unleash a torrential flurry of 5 kinetic strikes against enemies within 15 feet. Deals 6d10 smashing/rime damage total, split among targets or focused on one, and knocks all targets prone.
spell.flavorText: Standing water is just a river that lost an argument.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 8d10 total damage across 6 strikes, stuns all hit targets for 1 round, and refunds 2 Flux.

spell.name: Eternal Momentum
spell.description: Your Flux cannot decay below 4 in combat. While at 6 or more Flux, all your physical damage is increased by +1d8 damage and you gain heals you for 2d6 Hit Points on hit.
spell.flavorText: Every wave adds to the permanent tide.

rankUpgrades.description: Flux cannot decay below 6; +35 points physical damage and heals you for 2d6 Hit Points on hit at 6+ Flux.
Flux cannot decay below 8; +50 points physical damage, heals you for 2d6 Hit Points on hit, and you gain 4 Damage Reduction from all sources.

spell.name: Water Ascendant
spell.description: Spend 6 Flux: transform into a living kinetic elemental for 1 minute: you take 40 points less physical and magical damage, and you can teleport 30 feet as a free action once per turn.
spell.flavorText: Try to grasp a river. The river files a complaint.

spell.name: Fluvial Reflexes
spell.description: You gain 1 additional reaction per round. Water Dance Dodge can be used without spending Flux.
spell.flavorText: Reflexes that flow faster than conscious thought.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain 2 additional reactions per round; dodging an attack immediately triggers a free retaliation strike.

spell.name: Chimeric Flow
spell.description: You may blend up to THREE forms simultaneously without penalty, gaining all passive bonuses and features of all 3 forms.
spell.flavorText: Three bodies, one sovereign consciousness.

rankUpgrades.description: Blend 3 forms freely; all form abilities deal +1d8 bonus damage and cost 1 less Flux.

spell.name: The Living Cataract
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 8 Flux: summon the torrential fury of the primordial flood for 1 minute: a 40-foot kinetic tsunami surrounds you. Deals 5d10 rime/smashing damage per round to all enemies, knocks all enemies prone each round, and whenever you transition forms, a shockwave deals 4d10 damage to all foes.
spell.flavorText: The river does not stop for mountains. It erodes them.

spell.name: Flow Master Doctrine
spell.description: The current cannot be halted. All physical, cold, and form ability damage you deal is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: Water shaped by will is sharper than steel.

rankUpgrades.description: All form and physical damage increased by +1d8 damage.
All form and physical damage increased by +1d8 damage, and each form shift grants 2 Flux.
All form and physical damage increased by +2d8 damage.
All form and physical damage increased by +2d8 damage, and Fluid Transition grants 6 Flux.

spell.name: Infinite Flux Reservoir
spell.description: Your maximum Flux increases by 5. At the start of every combat turn, you generate 3 Flux.
spell.flavorText: An ocean in a teacup, constantly spilling over.

rankUpgrades.description: Maximum Flux +8; generate 5 Flux per turn and movement speed +15ft.
Maximum Flux +12; generate 7 Flux per turn and your form ability cooldowns recover twice as fast.

spell.name: Hydrokinetic Crits
spell.description: All your attacks in animal and elemental forms score critical hits on 18+ and critical hits refund 2 Flux.
spell.flavorText: Striking where the water finds the flaw.

rankUpgrades.description: Crits on 17+; crits refund 3 Flux and deal +50 points critical bonus damage.
Crits on 16+; crits refund 4 Flux, deal double crit damage, and immediately reset Mist Slip cooldown.

spell.name: Undying Fluidity
spell.description: While at 5+ Flux, lethal damage dissolves you into vapor instead, preventing death, restoring 50 points health, and teleporting you 30 feet away (cooldown: 20 rounds).
spell.flavorText: You cannot kill what has no fixed shape.

rankUpgrades.description: Survive lethal damage, restores 45 Hit Points, teleport 45 feet, and immediately gain full Flux (cooldown: 15 rounds).
Survive lethal damage, restores 60 Hit Points, teleport 60 feet, gain full Flux, and trigger Torrential Barrage automatically for free (cooldown: 10 rounds).

spell.name: Precision Edge
spell.description: Your critical hit range increases by 1 (crit on 19-20).
spell.flavorText: The edge knows where the seams are.

rankUpgrades.description: Your critical hit range increases by 1 (19-20), and Arterial Strike form grants +1 initiative.
Crit range 19-20, Arterial Strike grants +2 initiative, and Deadened Bastion ripostes deal +1d4 damage.

spell.name: Arterial Strike
spell.description: Enter Arterial Strike form for 1 minute: your weapon attacks deal 1d6 additional slicing damage, and critical hits generate 1 Flux. Costs 2 Flux.
spell.flavorText: Anatomy, applied at speed.

rankUpgrades.description: Enter Arterial Strike form: weapon attacks deal 2d6 additional slicing damage, crits generate 1 Flux. Costs 2 Flux.
Enter Arterial Strike form: weapon attacks deal 3d6 additional slicing damage, crits generate 2 Flux. Costs 2 Flux.

spell.name: Deadened Bastion
spell.description: Enter Deadened Bastion form for 1 minute: +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability, and when an enemy misses you in melee, riposte for 1d6 slicing damage. Costs 2 Flux.
spell.flavorText: Groven ancestor-bridges calcify into something stronger.

rankUpgrades.description: Enter Deadened Bastion form: +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability, missed melee attackers take 2d6 slicing riposte. Costs 2 Flux.

spell.name: Perfect Timing
spell.description: Once per turn, spend 2 Flux to attack as a reaction when an enemy within 30 feet attacks.
spell.flavorText: Their swing starts. Yours already finished.

rankUpgrades.description: Once per turn, spend 2 Flux to react-attack when an enemy within 30 feet attacks; your reaction attack has advantage.
Twice per turn, spend 2 Flux to react-attack enemies within 45 feet with advantage.

spell.name: Defensive Stance
spell.description: Deadened Bastion grants +2 to all saves, and while in Deadened Bastion you may spend 1 Flux to reduce incoming damage by 1d8.
spell.flavorText: The bridge takes the load. That is what bridges are for.

rankUpgrades.description: Deadened Bastion grants +3 to all saves; spend 1 Flux to reduce incoming damage by 2d8.
Deadened Bastion grants +4 to all saves; spend 1 Flux to reduce damage by 3d8, and the reduction applies to your adjacent allies as well.

spell.name: Dueling Mastery
spell.description: Challenge a single enemy within 30 feet as 1 Action Point: for 1 minute, you both have advantage on attacks against each other but cannot attack anyone else.
spell.flavorText: The duel is a room with two doors. Both are locked.

rankUpgrades.description: Challenge an enemy for 1 minute: you have advantage against each other, and YOU may ignore the restriction to attack others.
Challenge an enemy for 1 minute: advantage for you, disadvantage for them within the duel, and duel-marks who break it are stunned for 1 round.

spell.name: Counter Mastery
spell.description: Deadened Bastion ripostes trigger as reactions to ANY attack (melee, ranged, or spell), and riposte damage is doubled.
spell.flavorText: Everything is melee if you counter hard enough.

rankUpgrades.description: Bastion ripostes trigger on any attack and deal 3d6 slicing damage.
Bastion ripostes trigger on any attack, deal 4d6 slicing damage, and interrupted spells fail.

spell.name: Serpent's Precision
spell.description: While in Arterial Strike, your critical hit range increases by 1, and critical hits generate 1 extra Flux.
spell.flavorText: The serpent strikes once. The strike is enough.

rankUpgrades.description: While in Arterial Strike, crit range +1 (total 18-20) and crits generate 2 extra Flux.
While in Arterial Strike, crit range +2 (total 17-20), crits generate 2 Flux, and crits ignore durability.

spell.name: Trait Harvest
spell.description: Groven ancestor-bridges calcify into something stronger. When you reduce an enemy to 0 health, harvest one passive trait it had (a resistance, movement type, or bonus) for the rest of combat. Costs 1 Body Toll per trait.
spell.flavorText: The dead do not need their tricks. You keep them in trust.

rankUpgrades.description: Harvest a trait from your kills for the rest of combat; you may hold 2 harvested traits at once (1 Body Toll each).

spell.name: Duelist's Focus
spell.description: You have advantage on attacks against enemies you damaged this turn, persisting until the start of your next turn.
spell.flavorText: Attention is a blade. You hold the point.

rankUpgrades.description: Advantage on attacks against enemies you damaged this turn, and they have disadvantage on attacks against you.
Advantage against all enemies you touched this turn, their disadvantage against you, and your first attack each turn against each such enemy deals +1d8 slicing.

spell.name: Unyielding Blade
spell.description: Groven ancestor-bridges calcify into something stronger. You cannot be disarmed, and Deadened Bastion prevents you from being moved against your will.
spell.flavorText: The hand and the steel share a skeleton now.

rankUpgrades.description: You cannot be disarmed or moved against your will, and your weapon cannot be damaged or sundered by any means.

spell.name: Blade Dance
spell.description: While in Arterial Strike or Deadened Bastion, each attack action has a 20 points chance to strike a second time against the same target or a target within 10 feet.
spell.flavorText: One dancer. Two blades. No survivors.

rankUpgrades.description: While in Arterial Strike or Deadened Bastion, each attack action has a 30 points chance to strike a second time against a target within 15 feet; the second strike deals full damage.

spell.name: Iron Skin
spell.description: The calcified bridge-armors your form. While any Shaper form is active, you gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability.
spell.flavorText: Iron is a state of mind with excellent structural properties.

rankUpgrades.description: While any form is active, gain +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability and 2 Damage Reduction to smashing, stabbing, and slicing damage.

spell.name: Grand Challenge
spell.description: Challenge all enemies within 30 feet for 1 minute: you have advantage on all attacks, and challenged enemies have disadvantage on attacks targeting anyone but you. Costs all current Flux (minimum 4) and 2 Body Toll.
spell.flavorText: Everyone is invited. Attendance is mandatory.

spell.name: Perfect Dancer
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Become the duel incarnate for 1 minute — Arterial Strike and Deadened Bastion are active simultaneously, every attack strikes twice with advantage, ripostes trigger on all attacks without cost, and enemies you challenge cannot attack anyone but you. Costs all current Flux (minimum 6) and 3 Body Toll.
spell.flavorText: The dance has one dancer left. It was always going to end this way.

spell.name: Calcified Edge
spell.description: The ancestor-bridges sharpen everything. All slicing damage you deal is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: Sharper through mineral deposits.

rankUpgrades.description: The ancestor-bridges sharpen everything. All slicing damage you deal is increased by +1d8 damage.
The ancestor-bridges sharpen everything. All slicing damage you deal is increased by +1d8 damage, and your slicing attacks ignore 5 points of enemy durability.
The ancestor-bridges sharpen everything. All slicing damage you deal is increased by +2d8 damage.
The ancestor-bridges sharpen everything. All slicing damage you deal is increased by +2d8 damage, and Arterial Strike form costs 1 Flux.

spell.name: Riposte Doctrine
spell.description: Counter Mastery ripostes also generate 1 Flux each.
spell.flavorText: Every parry refills the reservoir.

rankUpgrades.description: Counter Mastery ripostes generate 2 Flux each and heal you 2 health.
Ripostes generate 3 Flux, heal 3 health, and every third riposte is an automatic critical.

spell.name: Duelist's Resolve
spell.description: Duels sharpen conviction. While an enemy is affected by your Dueling Mastery or Grand Challenge, you gain 2 Damage Reduction from all other enemies.
spell.flavorText: The audience cannot touch the dancers.

rankUpgrades.description: While an enemy is dueling you, you gain 4 Damage Reduction from all other enemies.
While dueling, you gain 6 Damage Reduction from others and cannot be critically hit by them.

spell.name: Bridge's Bounty
spell.description: Harvested traits linger past the fight. One harvested trait per combat persists into the next short rest.
spell.flavorText: Some inheritances outlive the estate.

rankUpgrades.description: Two harvested traits persist through a short rest, and harvesting no longer costs Body Toll.
Three harvested traits persist through short rests, harvesting is free, and traits persist through long rests at half strength.

spell.name: Silence Predator
spell.description: Enter Silence Predator form for 1 minute: you may stealth even in combat, stealth attacks generate 1 additional Flux, and enemies do not hear your movement. Costs 3 Flux.
spell.flavorText: The quiet has teeth.

rankUpgrades.description: Enter Silence Predator form: combat-stealth, +2 Flux from stealth attacks, silent movement, and +10 feet stealthed movement speed. Costs 3 Flux.
Enter Silence Predator form: combat-stealth, +3 Flux from stealth attacks, silent movement, +15 feet speed, and exiting stealth with an attack grants that attack advantage. Costs 2 Flux.

spell.name: Shadow Cloak
spell.description: Wrap yourself in clinging dark as 1 Action Point: while stealthed you gain +2 to attack and damage rolls. Lasts until you attack or take damage.
spell.flavorText: The dark was using it as a coat rack anyway.

rankUpgrades.description: Wrap yourself in clinging dark: while stealthed you gain +3 to attack and damage rolls.

spell.name: Ambush Mastery
spell.description: Stealth attacks deal 2d6 additional blight damage, and attacks against unaware targets have advantage.
spell.flavorText: The first mistake is not hearing the second one.

rankUpgrades.description: Stealth attacks deal 3d6 additional blight damage; attacks against unaware targets have advantage and score critical hits on 19-20.
Stealth attacks deal 3d8 additional blight damage; attacks against unaware targets have advantage, score critical hits on 19-20, and ignore 2 points of durability.

spell.name: Phantom Step
spell.description: While in Silence Predator, you may teleport 15 feet through walls and solid objects (not into occupied spaces), and you may teleport while prone or restrained. Costs 1 Flux.
spell.flavorText: The wall and the shadow have an arrangement.

rankUpgrades.description: While in Silence Predator, teleport 25 feet through walls and objects, even while prone or restrained. Costs 1 Flux.
While in Silence Predator, teleport 40 feet through anything (including wards and barriers), and each teleport leaves a shadow decoy for 1 round. Costs 1 Flux.

spell.name: Shadow Eruption
