spell.description: When 3 or more of your Wyrd-hounds attack the same target in a round, each of those attacks deals 1d6 additional sacred damage.
spell.flavorText: Coordinated violence is still doctrine. Especially then.

rankUpgrades.description: 3+ hounds on one target: each attack deals 2d6 additional sacred damage.
3+ hounds on one target: each attack deals 3d6 additional sacred damage, and the target cannot disengage from the pack.

spell.name: Steady Rein
spell.description: Your grip holds under pressure: spend 1 Authority to restore one DD step on a bound hound.
spell.flavorText: The rein tightens. The hound remembers the contract.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 1 Authority to restore one DD step on a hound; if used on a d10 hound, it instead gains +1d6 damage this turn.
Spend 1 Authority: restore one DD step on ALL bound hounds. Twice per round.

spell.name: Silent Execution
spell.description: Stealth attacks against supernatural targets cannot be reduced; if the target is below half health, deal 2d6 additional blight damage.
spell.flavorText: The Wyrd have first names. Your blade learned them all.

rankUpgrades.description: Stealth attacks on supernatural targets: unreducible damage, +3d6 blight below half health.
Stealth attacks on supernatural targets: unreducible damage, +4d6 blight below half health, and such kills restore 2 Authority.

spell.name: Mass Restoration
spell.description: One lash fortifies the whole pack: when you restore a hound's DD, all other bound hounds gain half the restoration.
spell.flavorText: Discipline is distributable.

rankUpgrades.description: One lash fortifies all: DD restoration applies at FULL effect to every bound hound, and each restoration grants 1 Authority.
Full-effect pack restoration, 1 Authority per use, and hounds at maximum DD convert the restoration into 1d6 sacred bonus damage instead.

spell.name: Wyrd Cyclone
spell.description: Once per combat: command all bound Wyrd-hounds to strike simultaneously. Each hound degrades its DD by 1 step but deals 2d6 additional sacred damage on the attack. Costs 2 Authority.
spell.flavorText: Release the pack. Briefly. Loudly.

rankUpgrades.description: Once per combat: all hounds strike simultaneously for +3d6 sacred damage each, with NO DD degradation. Costs 2 Authority.

spell.name: Pack Alpha
spell.description: Your Wyrd-hounds no longer degrade DD on their first action each turn.
spell.flavorText: The pack has learned who feeds it.

rankUpgrades.description: Hounds skip DD degradation on their first action each turn, and while commanding 2+ hounds your stealth attacks gain +2d6 sacred damage.
Hounds skip DD degradation on first actions; with 2+ hounds bound your stealth attacks gain +3d6 sacred damage and cannot be dodged.

spell.name: Hunter's Authority
spell.description: The hunt legitimizes itself: each enemy damaged by a bound hound grants you 1 Authority (once per enemy per round).
spell.flavorText: Every wound the pack lands is a signature on your writ.

rankUpgrades.description: Each enemy damaged by a hound grants 1 Authority (once per enemy per round), and kills by the pack grant 2 Authority.

spell.name: Cold Iron Doctrine
spell.description: Your weapons and your hounds' claws are anointed in remembering iron: all your and your pack's attacks ignore wyrd resistance, and supernatural enemies hit by them cannot heal for 1 round. Costs 3 Authority to anoint for 1 minute.
spell.flavorText: The iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name also remembers how to spell it. Backwards.

spell.name: Undisputed
spell.description: You are the sole commander of the Wyrd pack: your Authority maximum increases by 2, and hounds you command cannot be banished, dominated, or turned while you hold 3+ Authority.
spell.flavorText: Contested authority is a heresy. The hounds checked.

rankUpgrades.description: Authority maximum +4; at 3+ Authority your hounds are unbanishable, undominatable, and deal +1d6 bonus damage.

spell.name: Shared Stealth
spell.description: When you enter stealth, your bound hounds vanish with you. The pack's stealth attacks from this shared stealth each gain +1d6 blight damage.
spell.flavorText: The whole purge goes quiet at once.

rankUpgrades.description: You and the pack share stealth; shared-stealth attacks deal +2d6 blight damage each and the first pack attack from stealth is an automatic crit.

spell.name: The Purging
spell.description: ULTIMATE: For 1 minute, the full doctrine unrolls: bind up to 6 Wyrd-hounds regardless of slot limits, all DD degradation pauses, every attack — yours and the pack's — deals maximum damage to supernatural targets, and each enemy the pack kills restores 2 Authority and one DD step to every surviving hound. Costs all current Authority (minimum 4).
spell.flavorText: The writ is signed. The names are written. The pack is hungry.

spell.name: Writ of Binding
spell.description: The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 1.
spell.flavorText: More signatures, more hounds.

rankUpgrades.description: The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 2.
The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 3.
The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 4.
The writ grows longer: Authority maximum +5, and Bind Wyrd-hound costs 1 Authority.

spell.name: Houndmaster General
spell.description: Bound hounds inherit your doctrine: their attacks count as yours for Silent Execution and Cold Iron Doctrine effects.
spell.flavorText: The pack carries signed copies of the writ. In their teeth.

rankUpgrades.description: Hounds inherit Silent Execution and Cold Iron Doctrine; their kills trigger your Authority gains.
Hounds inherit all doctrine effects, and when a hound lands the killing blow on a supernatural enemy it returns to full DD instead of degrading.

spell.name: First-Name Iron
spell.description: Your cold iron has finished its recollection: all your damage against supernatural creatures is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: It knows their first names. It enunciates.

rankUpgrades.description: All your damage against supernatural creatures is increased by +1d8 damage.
All your damage against supernatural creatures is increased by +2d8 damage, and critical hits against them seal their magic for 1 round.

spell.name: Quiet Writ
spell.description: The purge leaves no paperwork: enemies killed by you or your pack from stealth die silently, without alerts, and their deaths cannot be scried.
spell.flavorText: Officially, nothing happened. Unofficially, everything did.

rankUpgrades.description: Stealth kills are silent and untraceable; witnesses must pass a Perception check at disadvantage, and divination about the death fails for 1 hour.
Stealth kills are silent, untraceable, and for 1 round afterwards nearby enemies do not perceive that their ally is gone.

spell.name: Covenant of Iron
spell.description: Your singular bond yields iron control: your Wyrd-hound's DD degrades every 2 actions instead of every action, and its attacks deal 1d6 additional sacred damage.
spell.flavorText: One hound. One verdict. No appeals.

rankUpgrades.description: Your hound's DD degrades every 2 actions; its attacks deal 2d6 additional sacred damage and you gain resistance to its damage type.
DD degrades every 3 actions; hound attacks deal 3d6 additional sacred, you resist its damage type, and its critical hits restore 1 DD step.

spell.name: Spell Intercept
spell.description: As a reaction when an enemy casts a spell within 60 feet, make a ranged attack with your cold iron: on a hit the spell is countered and you gain 2 Authority.
spell.flavorText: Objection. Sustained by iron.

rankUpgrades.description: React to enemy spells within 60 feet: your cold iron strike counters the spell and deals 2d6 sacred damage; gain 2 Authority on success.
React to spells within 90 feet: the counter deals 4d6 sacred damage, grants 3 Authority, and cannot miss spells below 3rd level.

spell.name: Iron Grip
spell.description: Singular focus, stronger control: spend 2 Authority to restore your Wyrd-hound's DD to d10.
spell.flavorText: The leash is also a spine.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 2 Authority to restore your hound's DD to d10; for 1 round after, its attacks deal maximum damage.

spell.name: Mana Vortex
spell.description: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. When you counter a spell, a vortex drains 2d6 mana from the caster; targets with no mana take the drain as wyrd damage instead.
spell.flavorText: Their argument, confiscated.

rankUpgrades.description: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. Counters drain 4d6 mana; drained mana beyond their capacity becomes wyrd damage.
Counters drain 4d6 mana (overflow as wyrd damage), and half the drained mana is added to your own pool.

spell.name: Empowered Strikes
spell.description: Your Wyrd-hound's attacks deal 1d8 additional sacred damage, and its critical hits restore 1 DD step and grant you 1 Authority.
spell.flavorText: The verdict lands harder every time.

rankUpgrades.description: Hound attacks deal 2d8 additional sacred damage; crits restore 1 DD step and grant 2 Authority.
Hound attacks deal 3d8 additional sacred; crits restore a DD step, grant 2 Authority, and silence the victim for 1 round.

spell.name: Spell Nullification
spell.description: Spells you counter are sealed: the caster cannot cast that spell again for 1 minute, and you may dispel one magical effect on yourself with each counter.
spell.flavorText: The word is struck from the record. And the mouth.

rankUpgrades.description: Countered spells are sealed 1 minute AND the caster's next spell costs 3 additional mana; each counter also dispels one effect from you.
Countered spells sealed for the encounter; the caster's next spell costs 6 additional mana; counters dispel one hostile effect from you AND one ally within 30 feet.

spell.name: Dominant Wrath
spell.description: Desperation sharpens the grip: when your Wyrd-hound's DD is at d8 or lower, its attacks deal 2d8 additional sacred damage.
spell.flavorText: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. So does the hound, at the end.

rankUpgrades.description: At d8 DD or lower, hound attacks deal 3d8 additional sacred damage and gain +2 to hit.
At d8 or lower, hound attacks deal 4d8 additional sacred, gain +2 to hit, and its crit range expands to 19-20.

spell.name: Hound's Verdict
spell.description: Command your hound to deliver the verdict: it pins a spellcaster within 30 feet for 1 round — the target is restrained, cannot cast, and takes 3d8 sacred damage. Costs 3 Authority.
spell.flavorText: The court appoints teeth.

rankUpgrades.description: The hound pins a spellcaster 2 rounds: restrained, silenced, taking 5d8 sacred damage.
The hound pins 2 rounds: restrained, silenced, 6d8 sacred damage, and the pin's discharge drains 2d6 mana from the victim.

spell.name: Dispel Field
spell.description: Create a 15-foot anti-magic field within 60 feet for 1 minute: spells cast into it automatically fail, magical effects inside are suppressed, and spellcasters inside take 3d6 arcane damage per round. Costs 4 Authority.
spell.flavorText: Within the chalk line, magic is a rumor.

rankUpgrades.description: A 20-foot anti-magic field for 1 minute: spells fail, effects suppress, casters inside take 5d6 arcane per round, and teleportation out is blocked.

spell.name: Arcane Dominator
spell.description: You maintain two anti-magic effects simultaneously, and spells cast at you or allies within 30 feet are made with disadvantage.
spell.flavorText: Two verdicts at once. The docket is efficient.

rankUpgrades.description: Two anti-magic effects at once; hostile spells at you and allies within 30 feet carry disadvantage, and your hound cannot escape or be dominated while you hold over half health.

spell.name: Counter's Doctrine
spell.description: Each successful Spell Intercept grants your hound +1d6 damage for 1 round (stacking up to 3 times).
spell.flavorText: Every objection overruled feeds the court.

rankUpgrades.description: Each counter grants the hound +2d6 damage for 1 round (stacks 3).
Each counter grants +2d6 (stacks 4), and at max stacks the hound's next attack is an automatic critical.

spell.name: The Bench
spell.description: Erect the court itself: a 40-foot zone of judgment within 60 feet for 3 rounds. All enemy spells inside fail outright, all magical effects are suppressed, and each enemy caster inside takes 4d8 arcane damage at the start of their turns. Costs all current Authority (minimum 4).
spell.flavorText: Court is now in session. Magic is in contempt.

spell.name: Iron Ledger
spell.description: The court keeps accounts: every spell countered, drained, or suppressed grants 1 Authority (once per enemy per round), and your Authority decays 50 points slower.
spell.flavorText: Every confiscated spell is a line item.

rankUpgrades.description: Counters, drains, and suppressions grant 1 Authority each (once per enemy per round); decay halved; sealed spells grant 2 Authority when the seal expires.

spell.name: Verdant Null
spell.description: Your anti-magic carries a blessing: allies inside your Dispel Fields are NOT suppressed and gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability instead.
spell.flavorText: The law protects its officers. Convenient.

rankUpgrades.description: Allies inside your anti-magic fields are unharmed, unsuppressed, gain +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability, and their non-magical attacks deal +1d6 damage of their type.

spell.name: Final Verdict
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Read the sentence. A single target within 90 feet is stripped of ALL magic for 1 minute — spells fail, enchantments end, magic items go inert, and transformations revert. The condemned takes 8d10 sacred damage immediately and cannot benefit from any magical effect for the duration. Costs all current Authority (minimum 5).
spell.flavorText: The iron has heard enough. The sentence is nullification.

spell.name: Long Writ
spell.description: The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 1.
spell.flavorText: Ink is cheap. Jurisdiction is not.

rankUpgrades.description: The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 2.
The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 3.
The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 4.
The writ grows longer: Authority maximum +5, and Spell Intercept triggers twice per round.

spell.name: Contempt of Power
spell.description: Spellcasters within 30 feet feel the court's disfavor: their spell costs increase by 2 mana.
spell.flavorText: The surcharge is legal. Everything here is legal.

rankUpgrades.description: Enemy spell costs increase by 4 mana within 30 feet.
Enemy spell costs increase by 6 mana within 45 feet, and their spells cast at you have disadvantage baked in.

spell.name: Iron Sanction
spell.description: Your hound is an officer of the court: it can now hold and deliver your Spell Intercept counterspell when you are unavailable.
spell.flavorText: Delegation. The hounds asked for the responsibility.

rankUpgrades.description: The hound delivers counterspell intercepts in your stead; each hound-executed counter grants it +1 DD step.
The hound intercepts in your stead, gains a DD step per counter, and may counter two spells per round.

spell.name: The Stand
spell.description: Witnesses do not test you twice: enemies who successfully cast a spell inside your anti-magic effects take 3d8 arcane backlash and are silenced for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: Loopholes have consequences.

rankUpgrades.description: Enemies casting through your fields take 5d8 arcane backlash and are silenced 1 round.
Casting through your fields: 6d8 arcane backlash, silenced 2 rounds, and their spell still fails.

spell.name: Hollow Pursuit
spell.description: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. Gain +10 feet movement speed permanently, and track supernatural targets by scent within 60 feet.
spell.flavorText: You cannot be slowed. The thing inside won't allow it.

rankUpgrades.description: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. +10 feet speed, scent-tracking to 60 feet, and melee attacks deal +1d6 blight damage.
+10 feet speed, scent-tracking, melee attacks +2d6 blight, and you cannot be slowed or rooted while holding 3+ Authority.

spell.name: Wyrd Embrace
spell.description: Channel a Wyrd-hound within yourself: your Internal Dominance Die starts at d10, and your melee attacks deal 1d6 additional blight damage but degrade your Internal DD by 1 step.
spell.flavorText: The leash points inward now.

rankUpgrades.description: Internal DD starts at d10; melee attacks deal 2d6 additional blight but degrade Internal DD one step.
Internal DD starts at d12; melee attacks deal 3d6 additional blight and degrade Internal DD one step.

spell.name: Pursuit Mastery
spell.description: Movement speed increases by 5 feet per Authority you hold, and when a supernatural target moves away from you, use your reaction to move up to your speed toward them.
spell.flavorText: Leaving is also a confession.

rankUpgrades.description: +5 feet speed per Authority; reactive pursuit moves do not provoke opportunity attacks, and the pursuing strike gains advantage.

spell.name: Corruption Aura
spell.description: The internal hound bleeds into the world: enemies within 10 feet take 1d6 blight damage at the start of their turns.
spell.flavorText: Standing near you is inadvisable and possibly heretical.

rankUpgrades.description: Enemies within 15 feet take 2d6 blight damage at the start of their turns.
Enemies within 15 feet take 3d6 blight per turn, and enemies who remain inside for 3 rounds gain a Stage 0 rot-Seed.

spell.name: Condemn
spell.description: Spend 3 Authority: knock a target within 30 feet back 20 feet and pin them to the ground — they take 3d8 sacred damage and are stunned for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The sentence is physical.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 3 Authority: knock back 20 feet, 4d8 sacred damage, stunned 1 round, and pinned targets cannot teleport.
Spend 3 Authority: knock back 30 feet, 4d8 sacred damage, stunned 2 rounds, no teleport, and adjacent enemies are knocked prone.

spell.name: Inner Peace
spell.description: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. When your Internal DD reaches 0 and the hound takes control, you regain command after 1 turn instead of 2.
spell.flavorText: Inner peace, in this context, means winning the argument faster.

rankUpgrades.description: The Inquisitor purges with cold iron that remembers the Wyrd's first name. The hound's control turn deals +2d6 blight damage to enemies only.
Regain command same-turn; the hound's rampage deals +3d6 blight to enemies only and generates 2 Authority for you when it ends.

spell.name: Marked for Death
spell.description: Mark a supernatural target for 10 minutes: you see them through walls, they cannot become invisible, and your attacks against them deal 2d6 additional sacred damage.
spell.flavorText: The mark is not a spell. It is a verdict in progress.

rankUpgrades.description: Mark a supernatural target: seen through walls, no invisibility, your attacks deal +3d6 sacred damage to them.
The mark: seen through everything, no invisibility, +4d6 sacred from your attacks, and they cannot benefit from allies' auras.

spell.name: Rein In Fury
spell.description: You have learned to milk the possession: spend 2 Authority to restore your Internal DD by one step.
spell.flavorText: The hound respects routine. Occasionally.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 2 Authority to restore one Internal DD step; if used while the hound rampages, the rampage ends immediately.
Spend 1 Authority for an Internal DD step; ending a rampage this way grants 5 temporary health, and the restore can be used twice per round.

spell.name: Corruption Nova
spell.description: Unleash the internal hound's fury in a 20-foot burst: 3d6 blight damage to all enemies. Resets your Internal DD to d6 regardless of its level.
spell.flavorText: The hound goes out. Everything regrets it.

rankUpgrades.description: Unleash the hound in a 30-foot burst: 5d6 blight damage, and victims are frightened for 1 round. Internal DD resets to d6.

spell.name: Hound's Endurance
spell.description: The hound inside keeps you standing: your maximum health increases by 10, and while your Internal DD is d8 or higher you regenerate 1d4 health per round.
spell.flavorText: It guards the house it lives in.

rankUpgrades.description: Max health +15; at d8+ Internal DD you regenerate 2d4 health per round.
Max health +20; at d8+ regenerate 3d4 per round, and you cannot be frightened — the hound growls back.

spell.name: No Escape
spell.description: Marked targets cannot disengage, dash, or teleport away from you: if they try, your pursuit reaction triggers twice and pins them for 1 round on a hit.
spell.flavorText: Flight is evidence. Flight is also futile.

rankUpgrades.description: Marked targets fleeing trigger pursuit reactions twice; each pursuit hit deals +1d6 blight damage.

spell.name: Hollow Sovereign
spell.description: You no longer lose control at Internal DD 0. Instead, enter Ascended Form for 3 rounds: +4 to Strength and Constitution checks, your melee attacks deal 4d10 blight damage, and Corruption Aura doubles. After it ends, take 4d10 wyrd damage and Internal DD resets to d6.
spell.flavorText: The leash broke in both directions. Nobody agrees on who holds it now.

spell.name: Confession
spell.description: Pinned or marked enemies volunteer everything: enemies under your Condemn or Mark have their position broadcast to all allies and take 1d6 extra damage from everyone.
spell.flavorText: The truth wants out. You just hold the door.

rankUpgrades.description: Condemned or marked enemies take 2d6 extra damage from ALL sources and allies gain advantage on attacks against them.

spell.name: Hollow Bones
spell.description: The hound has hollowed you into something tireless: you cannot be exhausted, and you do not need to sleep — trances of 2 hours restore you fully.
spell.flavorText: The body was mostly luggage anyway.

rankUpgrades.description: You cannot be exhausted or slept magically; 2-hour trances restore fully, and during vigils your scent-tracking range increases by 30 feet.

spell.name: Saint and Hound
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Saint and hound sign a joint writ. For 1 minute: Ascended Form persists without its ending backlash, your Internal DD cannot degrade below d8, all melee attacks deal maximum damage and apply your Corruption Aura's rot directly, and each supernatural enemy that dies within 60 feet restores 1 Authority and 2d6 health to you. Costs all current Authority (minimum 4).
spell.flavorText: Two names on the writ now. The iron holds them both.

spell.name: Writ of Hunger
spell.description: The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 1.
spell.flavorText: The hound signs with its teeth.

rankUpgrades.description: The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 2.
The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 3.
The writ grows longer: your Authority maximum increases by 4.
The writ grows longer: Authority maximum +5, and Condemn costs 2 Authority.

spell.name: Tireless Pursuer
spell.description: The pursuit never rests: your movement speed increases by 10 feet, and your pursuit reactions no longer consume your reaction.
spell.flavorText: You have been chasing something for years. The legs remember.

rankUpgrades.description: +15 feet movement; pursuit reactions are free and can trigger twice per round.
+20 feet movement; unlimited pursuit reactions, and each pursuit strike slows the target 10 feet.

spell.name: Rot Crown
spell.description: Your Corruption Aura learns from the garden: enemies inside it have their healing reduced by 25 points.
spell.flavorText: The crown is invisible. The effects are not.

rankUpgrades.description: Enemies in your aura heal 25 points less and take 1d6 extra blight from your attacks.
Aura-borne enemies heal 50 points less, and allies inside your aura are immune to their healing reduction — the rot knows the household.

spell.name: Last Confession
spell.description: Condemn's verdict sharpens: condemned targets below half health take 50% more damage from you.
spell.flavorText: Everyone confesses eventually. You simply expedite the paperwork.

rankUpgrades.description: Condemned targets below half health suffer +2d6 bonus damage from you.
Condemned targets below half health take DOUBLE damage from you, and your killing blow on a condemned enemy generates 3 Authority.

spell.name: Sanguine Syphon Strike
spell.description: Strike a target within 10 feet: deals 2d8 blight damage, heals you for half of the damage dealt, and generates 1 Toll (DT).
spell.flavorText: Paid in crimson, the power of the Frozen Archive endures.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 3d8 damage, heals for 1d8, grants 2 DT, and causes bleed for 1d6 per round.
Deals 3d8 damage, heals for 2d8, grants 2 DT, bleeds for 1d6, and increases movement speed by +10ft.

spell.name: Blood-Scribe Mastery
spell.description: Your maximum Toll capacity increases by 4. All life drain effects restore 20 points more health.
spell.flavorText: The blood-scribes write life into stolen flesh.

rankUpgrades.description: Max DT +6; life drain restores 30 points more health and your attacks deal +1d6 blood damage.
Max DT +8; life drain restores 35 points more health, deals +1d6 blight damage, and +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability.

spell.name: Crimson Adrenaline
spell.description: After casting a life drain spell, gain +20ft movement speed and 15 points physical damage resistance for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Necrotic frost quickens the veins of those who drain the living.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +30ft speed, 6 Damage Reduction, and +2 to attack rolls after draining life.

spell.name: Sanguine Gore Burst
spell.description: Spend 2 DT: detonate boiling blood within an enemy within 35 feet. Deals 3d8 blight damage in a 20-foot radius, heals you for 1d6, and blinds enemies for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: Life essence erupts in a burst of frozen gore.

rankUpgrades.description: 25-foot radius deals 3d8 damage, heals for 2d6, and bleeds victims for 1d6 per round.
30-foot radius deals 4d8 damage, heals for 2d6, bleeds for 2d6, and knocks enemies prone.

spell.name: Desperate Siphon
spell.description: While below half maximum Hit Points, your life drain abilities deal +10 points increased damage and cost 1 fewer Action Point.
spell.flavorText: Desperation awakens the chill blood-magic buried in your veins.

rankUpgrades.description: below half maximum Hit Points: deal +1d6 bonus damage, cost 1 fewer AP, and heal for +25 points more.
below half maximum Hit Points: deal +1d8 bonus damage, cost 1 fewer AP, heal for +35 points more, and gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability.

spell.name: Exsanguinating Grasp
spell.description: Spend 3 DT: channel a continuous beam of blood siphon onto a target within 45 feet for 2 rounds. Deals 4d8 blight damage per round, slows the target by 15 feet, and transfers 50 points of damage dealt into your HP.
spell.flavorText: Draining the living dry in a ceaseless crimson thread.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 5d8 per round and grants 15 temporary health.
Deals 5d8 per round, grants 20 temp HP, and refunds 2 DT on target death.

spell.name: Vampiric Feast
spell.description: Whenever an enemy dies from your life drain spells, gain 3 Toll, heal for 25 points of max HP, and all your abilities deal +1d6 bonus damage for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: The Archive rewards draining the weak with sovereign vitality.

rankUpgrades.description: Kills grant 4 DT, heal for 30 points, +15 points damage, and +10ft movement speed.
Kills grant 5 DT, heal for 35 points, +20 points damage, +15ft speed, and 20 temporary health.

spell.name: Maelstrom of Frozen Blood
spell.description: Spend 4 DT: summon a 30-foot vortex of razor frozen blood within 50 feet for 3 rounds. Deals 2d6 blight/rime damage per round, slows all enemies by 15ft, and heals you and allies inside for 20 points of damage dealt.
spell.flavorText: A blizzard of crimson ice flensing flesh from bone.

rankUpgrades.description: 35-foot vortex deals 3d6 per round, heals party for 25 points, and cooldown drops to 3 rounds.
40-foot vortex deals 3d6 per round, heals for 30 points, silences enemies, and grants allies +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability.

spell.name: Coagulated Blood Shield
spell.description: Overhealing from your life drain spells converts directly into a permanent blood shield (up to 50 temporary health).
spell.flavorText: Hardened crimson crust that turns aside blades.

rankUpgrades.description: Shield caps at 100 temp HP and reflects 30 points of absorbed damage back as blood damage.

spell.name: Heart-Burst Cataclysm
spell.description: Spend 5 DT: detonate the blood supply of all enemies within 40 feet. Deals 5d8 blight damage, stuns all enemies for 1 round, and heals you and all allies for 30 points of max health.
spell.flavorText: Forcing every heart in the room to rupture simultaneously.

rankUpgrades.description: 50-foot radius deals 6d8 damage, stuns for 1 round, and cooldown drops to 4 rounds.

spell.name: Blood Sovereign Form
spell.description: While at 5+ Toll, you gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability, 4 Damage Reduction against all-damage, and all your attacks deal +1d8 bonus blight damage.
spell.flavorText: Clothed in the living blood of a thousand fallen foes.

rankUpgrades.description: At 5+ DT: gain +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability, 6 Damage Reduction, and +2d8 bonus damage.
At 4+ DT: gain +4 Durability Steps to equipped durability, 6 Damage Reduction, +2d8 bonus damage, and attacks score crits on 18+.

spell.name: Avatar of the Sanguine Lord
spell.description: Spend 6 DT: transform into the Colossal Blood Sovereign for 1 minute: continuous blood storms strike all enemies within 50 feet for 6d10 damage each round, all your attacks have heals you for 2d6 Hit Points on hit, and you gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability.
spell.flavorText: The Frozen Archive's bloodline made incarnate.

spell.name: Severing Arteries
spell.description: All blood and blight spells score critical hits on 18+ and critical hits cause the target to bleed for 3d8 blight damage over 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Arteries torn open with surgical brutality.

rankUpgrades.description: Crits on 17+; bleed deals 4d8 blight damage and reduces enemy Armor by 4.

spell.name: Crimson Immortality Shroud
spell.description: You gain 8 Damage Reduction from damage-over-time effects and bleeds, and you gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability.
spell.flavorText: Your blood is already dead; it cannot be poisoned.

spell.name: Aura of False Faith
spell.description: Emit an aura of corrupted divinity. While you hold 6 or more Madness, enemies within 10 feet cannot distinguish friend from foe — they have disadvantage on attacks against your allies.
spell.flavorText: Everyone looks equally trustworthy. That is the miracle.

rankUpgrades.description: Emit an aura of corrupted divinity. While you hold 6 or more Madness, enemies within 15 feet cannot distinguish friend from foe: disadvantage on attacks, and they must save to target anyone but the nearest creature.

spell.name: False Prophecy
spell.description: Deliver a prophecy of the silence spirit. Up to 2 creatures within 30 feet believe your lies for 3 rounds — they treat your words as absolute truth. Spend 2 Madness when cast: an affected creature also attacks its nearest ally once.
spell.flavorText: The prophecy is self-fulfilling. You filled it yourself.

rankUpgrades.description: Deliver a prophecy of the silence spirit. Up to 3 creatures within 30 feet believe your lies for 3 rounds; spend 2 Madness: an affected creature attacks its nearest ally once.
Deliver a prophecy of the silence spirit. Up to 4 creatures within 40 feet believe your lies for 1 minute; spend 2 Madness: ALL affected creatures attack their nearest allies once.

spell.name: Corrupting Whisper
spell.description: Whisper the silence spirit's truth into a mind. Charm or frighten one creature within 30 feet for 2 rounds; duration increases by 1 round per 3 Madness you hold.
spell.flavorText: Once heard, never unheard, never un-heard.

rankUpgrades.description: Whisper the silence spirit's truth into a mind. Charm or frighten one creature within 30 feet for 3 rounds; duration increases by 1 round per 3 Madness you hold.
Whisper the silence spirit's truth into a mind. Charm or frighten TWO creatures within 30 feet for 3 rounds; duration increases by 1 round per 2 Madness you hold.

spell.name: Heresy
spell.description: Declare an enemy a heretic in the silence spirit's name. For 3 rounds, the target takes wyrd damage equal to your current Madness whenever it attacks you. Generates 1d6 Madness when cast.
spell.flavorText: Blasphemy has a bounty. You set it.

rankUpgrades.description: Declare an enemy a heretic in the silence spirit's name. For 3 rounds, the target takes wyrd damage equal to TWICE your current Madness whenever it attacks anyone. Generates 1d6 Madness when cast.
Declare an enemy a heretic in the silence spirit's name. For 4 rounds, the target takes double your Madness in wyrd damage whenever it attacks, and the declaration spreads to one enemy per round.

spell.name: Congregation of Doubt
spell.description: Preach doubt to the masses. All enemies within 20 feet must save or become confused for 2 rounds; each failed save generates 1 Madness for you.
spell.flavorText: The sermon is short. The doubt is not.

rankUpgrades.description: Preach doubt to the masses. All enemies within 30 feet must save or become confused for 2 rounds; each failed save generates 1 Madness.
Preach doubt to the masses. All enemies within 30 feet save with disadvantage or are confused for 3 rounds; each failure generates 2 Madness.

spell.name: Turn the Faithful
spell.description: When you successfully charm or confuse an enemy, you may spend 1d6 Madness: that enemy attacks its strongest ally with advantage on its next turn.
spell.flavorText: Betrayal is a sacrament of the inverted church.

rankUpgrades.description: When you successfully charm or confuse an enemy, you may spend 1d6 Madness: that enemy attacks its strongest ally with advantage and cannot be stopped by its allies.
When you charm or confuse an enemy, spend 1d6 Madness: it attacks its strongest ally with advantage, AND its ally must save or also be confused. This can chain once per round.

spell.name: Storm of Lies
spell.description: Unleash a torrent of silence scripture. A 30-foot radius within 60 feet fills with damaging whispers: enemies take 3d6 wyrd damage and have disadvantage on saves against your next control spell. Generates 1d8 Madness.
spell.flavorText: A hurricane of alternative facts.

rankUpgrades.description: Unleash a torrent of silence scripture. A 40-foot radius within 60 feet: enemies take 5d6 wyrd damage and have disadvantage on saves against your next TWO control spells. Generates 1d8 Madness.

spell.name: Rewrite Truth
spell.description: Warp what your enemies perceive as reality. Teleport up to 2 creatures or objects within 60 feet to unoccupied spaces you can see. Spend 1d4 Madness per enemy moved: unwilling targets save with disadvantage. Enemies can be placed into hazardous terrain.
spell.flavorText: They were never standing there. You have witnesses.

rankUpgrades.description: Warp what your enemies perceive as reality. Teleport up to 3 creatures or objects within 90 feet; spend 1d4 Madness per enemy (save with disadvantage). Hazardous terrain placement allowed.
Warp what your enemies perceive as reality. Teleport up to 4 creatures within 90 feet (disadvantage saves); enemies dropped into hazards take 2d6 blight damage immediately.

spell.name: The Grand Lie
spell.description: Your deceptions become indistinguishable from truth. Enemies automatically fail their first save each combat against your control spells.
spell.flavorText: The lie is load-bearing now.

rankUpgrades.description: Your deceptions become indistinguishable from truth. Enemies automatically fail their first save each combat against your control spells; at 12 or more Madness, their second save fails too.

spell.name: Shatter the Faith
spell.description: Destroy everything your enemies believe. Create a 60-foot zone for 3 rounds where you control perception: enemies inside see allies as enemies. Each round, each enemy inside generates 1d4 Madness for you. Costs 2d6 Madness to cast.
spell.flavorText: The mirror was the sermon all along.

spell.name: Credible Lies
spell.description: Consistency is the last refuge of belief. Your charm and confusion effects last 1 additional round.
spell.flavorText: Stick to the story. The story sticks to them.

rankUpgrades.description: Consistency is the last refuge of belief. Your charm and confusion effects last 2 additional rounds and cost 2 less mana.

spell.name: Doubt Engine
spell.description: Failure feeds the falsehood. Each time an enemy fails a save against one of your control spells, gain 1 Madness.
spell.flavorText: Their doubt is a donation. Recurring.

rankUpgrades.description: Failure feeds the falsehood. Each time an enemy fails a save against your control spells, gain 2 Madness.

spell.name: The Great Deception
spell.description: ULTIMATE: The ultimate deception is that the silence spirit does not exist — and it does not matter, for its lies have already won. For 1 minute, enemies within 60 feet roll all saves against your spells with disadvantage, your control spells hit 2 targets each, and each control that succeeds generates 2 Madness for you.
spell.flavorText: The altar is empty. The kneeling never stops.

spell.name: Silver Tongue
spell.description: Your lies appreciate in value. All wyrd damage you deal is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: Compound interest on a falsehood.

rankUpgrades.description: Your lies appreciate in value. All wyrd damage you deal is increased by +1d8 damage.
Your lies appreciate in value. All wyrd damage you deal is increased by +1d8 damage, and striking a marked enemy generates 1 Madness.
Your lies appreciate in value. All wyrd damage you deal is increased by +2d8 damage.
Your lies appreciate in value. All wyrd damage you deal is increased by +2d8 damage, and False Witness costs no mana.

spell.name: Web of Lies
spell.description: One lie supports the next. Your Marks (False Witness, Heresy) may affect 1 additional target.
spell.flavorText: Structural dishonesty.

rankUpgrades.description: One lie supports the next. Your Marks affect 2 additional targets.
One lie supports the next. Your Marks affect 3 additional targets, and marked enemies take 1d6 extra wyrd damage from your spells.

spell.name: Perfect Credibility
spell.description: No one doubts you twice. Enemies that succeed on a save against your control spell have disadvantage on their next save against you.
spell.flavorText: They should have believed you the first time.

rankUpgrades.description: No one doubts you twice. Enemies that succeed against your control have disadvantage on their next save, and their success deals 2d6 wyrd backlash to them.
No one doubts you twice. Enemies that succeed against your control have disadvantage on their next save, take 2d6 wyrd backlash, and cannot benefit from allies' auras for 1 round.

spell.name: Deep Reservoir
spell.description: The lies need room to breathe. Your maximum Madness increases by 1.
spell.flavorText: More space. Quieter tenant.

rankUpgrades.description: The lies need room to breathe. Your maximum Madness increases by 2.
The lies need room to breathe. Your maximum Madness increases by 3, and once per short rest you may instantly generate 1d6 Madness for free.

spell.name: Profane Communion
spell.description: The first rite demands blood as proof of devotion. Sacrifice up to 5 of your own health to gain double that amount as temporary health; you generate 1d4 Madness per sacrifice.
spell.flavorText: The ledger opens early.

rankUpgrades.description: The first rite demands blood as proof of devotion. Sacrifice up to 8 health for double as temporary health; generate 1d6 Madness per sacrifice.
The first rite demands blood as proof of devotion. Sacrifice up to 10 health for TRIPLE as temporary health; generate 1d6 Madness per sacrifice.

spell.name: Curse of the Unbeliever
spell.description: Curse enemies with the silence spirit's torment. A target within 60 feet takes 1d6 blight damage at the start of its turns for 1 minute. For every 3 Madness you hold, the curse also slows it by 5 feet.
spell.flavorText: The hymn plays on a loop. In the flesh.

rankUpgrades.description: Curse enemies with the silence spirit's torment. A target within 60 feet takes 2d6 blight damage per turn for 1 minute, slowed 5 feet per 3 Madness you hold.
Curse enemies with the silence spirit's torment. A target within 60 feet takes 3d6 blight damage per turn for 1 minute, slowed 5 feet per 2 Madness you hold.

spell.name: Summon Silence Acolyte
spell.description: Summon an acolyte to perform your rites (durability 13, 1d6 blight damage). Each time the acolyte hits an enemy, you generate 1 Madness.
spell.flavorText: The help is devout and slightly translucent.

rankUpgrades.description: Summon an acolyte to perform your rites (durability 14, 2d6 blight damage); each hit generates 1 Madness and heals you 2 health.

spell.name: Blood Offering
spell.description: Offer blood to the silence spirit. Take 2d6 blight damage; all allies within 30 feet regain 3d6 health. You generate 1d6 Madness and your next curse costs no mana.
spell.flavorText: The congregation drinks. You bleed. Fair tithes.

rankUpgrades.description: Offer blood to the silence spirit. Take 2d6 blight damage; all allies within 30 feet regain 5d6 health. You generate 1d6 Madness and your next curse costs no mana.
Offer blood to the silence spirit. Take 2d6 blight; allies within 40 feet regain 6d6 health and gain 5 temporary health. You gain 1d6 Madness and free curses for 1 round.

spell.name: Pact of the Silence
spell.description: Your servants grow stronger with every descent. Your summoned creatures gain +1 damage per 3 Madness you hold, and you may spend 1d4 Madness to refresh a summon's duration.
spell.flavorText: The fine print is in a language with no word for mercy.

rankUpgrades.description: Your servants grow stronger with every descent. Summons gain +1 damage per 2 Madness and +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability; spend 1d4 Madness to refresh a summon's duration.

Your servants grow stronger with every descent. Summons gain +1 damage per 2 Madness, +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability, and their attacks cleave for half damage; spend 1d4 Madness to refresh a duration.

spell.name: Ritual Empowerment
spell.description: Your rituals draw power from your madness. While at 10 or more Madness, your spells deal 1d6 additional damage of their own type.
spell.flavorText: The music swells. So does everything else.

rankUpgrades.description: Your rituals draw power from your madness. At 10+ Madness your spells deal 2d6 additional damage; each Madness you spend heals you 1 health.
Your rituals draw power from your madness. At 8+ Madness your spells deal 3d6 additional damage; each Madness spent heals you 2 health.

spell.name: Congregation of the Silence
spell.description: The congregation swells with every broken soul. Summon 1d4 additional silence acolytes. Each acolyte that dies generates 1d4 Madness for you.
spell.flavorText: Pew space available. Soul optional.

rankUpgrades.description: The congregation swells with every broken soul. Summon 2d4 additional acolytes; each death generates 1d4 Madness.
The congregation swells with every broken soul. Summon 3d4 acolytes; each death generates 1d6 Madness, and surviving acolytes merge into a Silence Priest if more than 3 remain after combat.

spell.name: Shepherd of the Silence
spell.description: To shepherd the flock is to watch them descend. Your summoned creatures have +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability and deal +2 damage. When a target of your Curse of the Unbeliever dies, the curse spreads to 1 additional enemy.
spell.flavorText: Losing sheep is fine. The flock finds replacements.

rankUpgrades.description: To shepherd the flock is to watch them descend. Summons gain +4 Durability Steps to equipped durability and +4 damage; curses spread to 2 enemies when a cursed target dies.
To shepherd the flock is to watch them descend. Summons gain +6 Durability Steps to equipped durability and +6 damage; curses spread to ALL enemies within 15 feet of a dying cursed target.

spell.name: Silence Priest
spell.description: Summon a powerful silence priest to preach alongside you. It casts curses autonomously and generates 1d6 Madness for you each round it survives.
spell.flavorText: The management layer of the apocalypse.

rankUpgrades.description: Summon a powerful silence priest to preach alongside you. It casts curses autonomously, generates 1d6 Madness per round, and its curses count as yours for all synergies.

spell.name: Channel the Silence God
spell.description: Become a direct conduit for the silence spirit's power. Your spells ignore spell resistance, and when you trigger Insanity Convulsion, you choose the result instead of rolling.
spell.flavorText: The seizure has a stage direction now.

rankUpgrades.description: Become a direct conduit for the silence spirit's power. Spells ignore spell resistance; Convulsions are chosen, not rolled, and their cooldown drops by 1 round.
Become a direct conduit for the silence spirit's power. Spells ignore resistance and immunity; Convulsions are chosen AND deal no self-damage.

spell.name: Forbidden Scripture
spell.description: Study the hidden texts. Your Madness-spending effects are 15 points more efficient (round up), and you learn one additional curse of your choice.
spell.flavorText: Chapter one was fine. The appendix bites.

rankUpgrades.description: Study the hidden texts. Your Madness-spending effects are 30 points more efficient (round up), and you learn two additional curses of your choice.

spell.name: Unholy Bloom
spell.description: Cursed flesh flowers at the end. When an enemy dies while cursed by you, it erupts in a 10-foot bloom dealing 3d6 blight damage, and each enemy hit by the bloom becomes cursed.
spell.flavorText: The garden is self-planting.

spell.name: Tithe Collector
spell.description: The flock pays in life. Whenever one of your curses deals damage, you regain 2 health.
spell.flavorText: Ten percent, collected continuously.

rankUpgrades.description: The flock pays in life. Whenever one of your curses deals damage, you regain 4 health and 1 Madness every third tick.

spell.name: Dark Benediction
spell.description: Your acolytes are anointed in unmaking. Summoned creatures deal +1d6 bonus damage and their attacks apply your Curse of the Unbeliever at half potency (1d6 blight per turn, 1 minute).
spell.flavorText: Blessed are the weird, for they carry forms.

rankUpgrades.description: Your acolytes are anointed in unmaking. Summons deal +2d8 bonus damage and apply your Curse at FULL potency (2d6 blight per turn, 1 minute).

spell.name: Invocation of the Silence God
spell.description: ULTIMATE: The ultimate rite pulls the Emberspire itself into momentary focus. Summon an avatar of the silence spirit for 3 rounds: it deals 4d6 blight damage per turn to all enemies within 30 feet. While it stands, your Convulsions do not reset your Madness — you retain half (rounded down) instead. Costs 1d8 Madness.
spell.flavorText: Reality screams. Politely. It has met the spirit before.

spell.name: Liturgy of Depletion
spell.description: The rite refines itself with repetition. All blight damage dealt by your curses is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: Practice makes purer torment.

rankUpgrades.description: The rite refines itself with repetition. All blight damage dealt by your curses is increased by +1d8 damage.
The rite refines itself with repetition. All blight damage dealt by your curses is increased by +1d8 damage, and your curse blight damage ignores 5 points of enemy resistance.
The rite refines itself with repetition. All blight damage dealt by your curses is increased by +2d8 damage.
The rite refines itself with repetition. All curse blight damage is increased by +2d8 damage, and Curse of the Unbeliever costs no mana.

spell.name: Eternal Torment
spell.description: Curses cling past the grave and back. Your curses last 2 additional rounds.
spell.flavorText: Expiration dates are for the faithful.

rankUpgrades.description: Curses cling past the grave and back. Your curses last 4 additional rounds.
Curses cling past the grave and back. Your curses last 6 additional rounds and cannot be dispelled below 5th level.

spell.name: Flock Eternal
spell.description: The pews refill themselves. When an acolyte dies, it is resummoned at half health after 2 rounds if you still hold 8 or more Madness.
spell.flavorText: The congregation is eternal. Attendance is mandatory.

rankUpgrades.description: The pews refill themselves. Dead acolytes return at full health after 2 rounds while you hold 8+ Madness.
The pews refill themselves. Dead acolytes return instantly at full health while you hold 6+ Madness, and each return generates 1d4 Madness.

spell.name: Mad Communion
spell.description: The vessel was always going to be too small. Your maximum Madness increases by 1.
spell.flavorText: The silence appreciates elbow room.

rankUpgrades.description: The vessel was always going to be too small. Your maximum Madness increases by 2.
The vessel was always going to be too small. Your maximum Madness increases by 3, and Profane Communion's temporary health lasts twice as long.

spell.name: Calculated Nudge
spell.description: Spend 1 Fortune (FP) as a reaction: Alter any d20 roll within 60 feet by +1 or -1 after seeing the roll.
spell.flavorText: The Iceheart Sea teaches that every wave is a wager.

rankUpgrades.description: Alters roll by +2 or -2, and grants the target +1d4 psychic damage on a successful attack.
Alters roll by +2 or -2, grants +1d6 psychic damage, and refunds the FP if the modified roll succeeds.

spell.name: Balanced Ledger
spell.description: Passive: While you hold 2 or more Fortune, your weapon attacks gain +1 to hit and deal +1d4 psychic damage.
spell.flavorText: A book that always balances in the house's favor.

rankUpgrades.description: While holding 2 or more FP, gain +1 to hit and deal +1d6 psychic damage.
While holding 2 or more FP, gain +2 to hit and deal +1d6 psychic damage.

spell.name: Probability Shield
spell.description: Passive: When your FP drops to 0, immediately gain 8 temporary Hit Points and 1 Damage Reduction against all attacks for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The mathematical law of regression to the mean protects the bankrupt.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain 14 temporary Hit Points and 2 Damage Reduction for 2 rounds upon reaching 0 FP.

spell.name: Card Counter Mark
spell.description: Spend 1 FP: Mark an enemy within 50 feet for 3 rounds. Your attacks against them ignore partial cover and deal +1d6 psychic damage.
spell.flavorText: Track the deck, count the discards, predict every motion.

rankUpgrades.description: Bonus damage increases to +1d8 psychic, and Calculated Nudge targeting them costs 0 FP.
Bonus damage increases to +1d8 psychic, and allies gain +1 to hit the marked target.

spell.name: Weighted Toss
spell.description: Hurl loaded dice at an enemy within 40 feet dealing 1d8 psychic damage. If the damage roll is even, you immediately gain 1 FP and the target is Staggered for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The edges are shaved just enough to defy God.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d6 psychic damage. Even rolls grant 1 FP and Stagger the target for 1 round.
Deals 2d8 psychic damage. Even rolls grant 1 FP and Daze the target for 1 round.

spell.name: Variance Crush
spell.description: Spend 2 FP: Unleash a psychic shockwave in a 20-foot line dealing 2d8 psychic damage and pushing targets 10 feet back.
spell.flavorText: Flattening the bell curve crushes those outside the mean.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d8 psychic damage and knocks targets Prone on a failed Fortitude save.
Deals 3d8 psychic damage, knocks targets Prone, and refunds 1 FP if it hits 2 or more enemies.

spell.name: House Advantage
spell.description: Passive: Whenever an enemy rolls a natural 1 on an attack or saving throw within 30 feet, they suffer 1d6 psychic damage and you gain 1 FP.
spell.flavorText: The house never loses. It merely collects what is owed.

rankUpgrades.description: Natural 1s deal 1d8 psychic damage and grant you 1 FP.
Natural 1s deal 2d6 psychic damage, grant you 1 FP, and inflict Disadvantage on the enemy's next attack.

spell.name: Deterministic Strike
spell.description: Spend 2 FP: Deliver a calculated strike that treats your attack roll as a natural 16, dealing 2d10 psychic damage and ignoring up to 3 points of enemy Armor.
spell.flavorText: When the math is resolved, the strike has already landed.

rankUpgrades.description: Deterministic Strike gains +1d6 bonus damage and refunds 1 AP on critical hits.

spell.name: Entropy Anchor
spell.description: Spend 2 FP: Anchor a 20-foot zone of stabilized probability for 2 rounds. Enemies inside cannot gain Advantage and take 1d6 psychic damage upon entering.
spell.flavorText: Probability ceases to fluctuate when the master commands it.

rankUpgrades.description: Zone deals 1d8 psychic damage upon entering, and enemies suffer -1 to saving throws inside.
Zone deals 2d6 psychic damage upon entering, and allies inside gain Advantage on saving throws.

spell.name: Statistical Ward
spell.description: Passive: You and allies within 20 feet gain +1 to all saving throws and 2 Damage Reduction against area hazards.
spell.flavorText: Geometry and statistics make the perfect bulwark.

rankUpgrades.description: Allies within 20 feet gain +2 to saving throws and 3 Damage Reduction against area hazards.

spell.name: Law of Large Numbers
spell.description: Spend 3 FP: Force a cosmic statistical reckoning in a 25-foot radius. Deals 3d8 psychic damage to all enemies, and heals all allies in the radius for 2d6 Hit Points.
spell.flavorText: In the limit, all outcomes converge to the master's design.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 3d10 psychic damage to enemies and heals allies for 2d8 Hit Points.
Deals 4d8 psychic damage, heals allies for 3d6 Hit Points, and removes 1 negative condition from each ally.

spell.name: Deterministic Strike Resonance
spell.description: Passive: Your class abilities deal +1d4 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource when below half health.
spell.flavorText: Focus sharpens under the pressure of battle.

rankUpgrades.description: Class abilities deal +1d6 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource.
Class abilities deal +1d8 bonus damage, cost 1 less resource, and grant +1 to hit.

spell.name: Unyielding Resolve
spell.description: Passive: You gain +1 Damage Reduction against all attacks and advantage on saving throws against stun and fear.
spell.flavorText: Standing immovable against the onslaught.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +2 Damage Reduction against all attacks and immunity to fear.

spell.name: The Grand Equation
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 3 FP: Enter a transcendent state of absolute probability for 2 rounds. All your damage rolls treat values below the die average as the average, all attacks deal +1d10 psychic damage, and natural rolls of 18–20 grant 1 FP.
spell.flavorText: You do not roll the dice. You write the numbers upon their faces.

spell.name: Gambit Doctrine
spell.description: Passive: All damage and healing dealt by your Gambit abilities is increased by +1 flat magnitude.
spell.flavorText: The foundational principles of your path, mastered completely.

rankUpgrades.description: Abilities increased by +2 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +3 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +4 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +5 flat magnitude and +1d4 bonus damage on critical hits.

spell.name: Flawless Calculation
spell.description: Passive: Whenever you or an ally within 30 feet misses an attack roll by 2 or less, you may spend 1 FP as a free reaction to turn the miss into a hit.
spell.flavorText: Error margins can be erased with a single stroke.

rankUpgrades.description: Flawless Calculation rank 2: resource generation +1 and +5ft speed.
Flawless Calculation rank 3: resource generation +2 and +1 to hit.

spell.name: Asymptotic Grace
spell.description: Passive: You cannot take more than 25 damage from a single attack or spell. Excess damage beyond 25 is converted into 1 FP.
spell.flavorText: Approaching infinity, but never touching it.

rankUpgrades.description: Asymptotic Grace rank 2: +2 Damage Reduction and +10 max HP.
Asymptotic Grace rank 3: +2 Damage Reduction, +15 max HP, and immunity to prone.

spell.name: Transcendent Precision
spell.description: Passive: All critical strikes deal +1d6 bonus damage and restore 1d4 Hit Points.
spell.flavorText: Striking the exact pressure point between life and death.

rankUpgrades.description: Transcendent Precision rank 2: crits deal +1d8 bonus damage and heal for 1d6.
Transcendent Precision rank 3: crits deal +2d6 bonus damage and heal for 1d8.

spell.name: All-In Strike
spell.description: Spend 3 Hit Points: Strike a foe for 1d8 ember damage and generate 1 Fortune.
spell.flavorText: Put your own blood on the table or leave the game.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 4 HP: Deals 2d6 ember damage and generates 1 FP.
Spend 4 HP: Deals 2d8 ember damage, generates 2 FP, and gains Advantage on the attack roll if below half maximum health.

spell.name: Red-Hot Dice
spell.description: Passive: Whenever you take self-damage from an ability, your next attack deals an extra 1d4 ember damage.
spell.flavorText: Heat from the wager transfers straight into the strike.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals +1d6 ember damage after self-damage.
Deals +1d8 ember damage and grants you 3 temporary Hit Points.

spell.name: Reckless Grit
spell.description: Passive: While below half maximum health, you gain 1 Damage Reduction against all incoming damage and +1 to hit with melee attacks.
spell.flavorText: Cornered beasts fight with double fury.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain 2 Damage Reduction and +2 to hit while below half maximum health.
Reckless Grit rank 3: magnitude and efficiency increased.

spell.name: Wild Gamble
spell.description: Spend 2 FP: Unleash explosive ember magic at a target within 35 feet dealing 2d6 ember damage. Roll 1d6: On a 4–6, deal an extra +1d8 ember damage; on a 1–3, suffer 3 ember backlash.
spell.flavorText: High stakes, higher flames.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d8 ember damage. 4–6 adds +2d6 ember damage; 1–3 deals 3 self-damage.
Deals 3d6 ember damage. 4–6 adds +2d8 ember damage; on a 6 triples the bonus damage; on 1–2 deals 4 self-damage.

spell.name: Double or Nothing
spell.description: Spend 1 FP: Empower your next weapon attack this round. If it hits, it adds +1d8 ember damage; if it misses, you suffer 3 ember damage.
spell.flavorText: Double down or walk away empty handed.

rankUpgrades.description: Adds +2d6 ember damage on hit; self-damage on miss reduced to 2.

spell.name: Pyroclastic Wager
spell.description: Spend 1 FP and 5 HP: Unleash a 20-foot cone of molten slag dealing 2d6 ember damage to all enemies and inflicting Burning (1d4 ember damage per round for 2 rounds).
spell.flavorText: The ashes of ruined fortunes burn the hottest.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d8 ember damage; Burning deals 1d6 per round.
Deals 3d6 ember damage; Burning deals 1d8 per round and reduces target Armor by 2.

spell.name: Blood Ante
spell.description: Passive: Whenever you score a critical hit, restore 4 Hit Points and gain 1 FP.
spell.flavorText: Collecting the ante right out of their ribs.

rankUpgrades.description: Critical hits restore 7 Hit Points and grant 1 FP.
Critical hits restore 10 Hit Points, grant 1 FP, and your next attack deals +1d6 ember damage.

spell.name: Jackpot Eruption
spell.description: Spend 3 FP and 6 HP: Detonate a 20-foot explosion dealing 3d8 ember damage to all enemies and knocking them Prone on a failed Reflex save. If at least 2 enemies are hit, regain 6 HP.
spell.flavorText: Three sevens aligned in liquid fire.

rankUpgrades.description: Jackpot Eruption gains +1d6 bonus damage and refunds 1 AP on critical hits.

spell.name: Combustion Frenzy
spell.description: Spend 2 FP: Enter a 2-round Frenzy. Your movement speed increases by 10 feet, and your weapon strikes deal an extra 1d6 ember damage.
spell.flavorText: When the table is burning, keep rolling.

rankUpgrades.description: Movement speed +15 ft, weapon strikes deal +1d8 ember damage.
Movement speed +15 ft, weapon strikes deal +2d6 ember damage, and you gain Advantage on the first strike each round.

spell.name: Defiant Wager
spell.description: Passive: When you take damage equal to 12 or more in a single hit, gain 1 FP and your next attack deals +1d8 ember damage.
spell.flavorText: Every wound is a reason to raise the bet.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain 1 FP and your next attack deals +2d6 ember damage when hit for 12+ damage.
