spell.name: Stormscribe Doctrine
spell.description: All storm and lightning damage dealt by your spells, totems, and inscriptions is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: The sky is written in lines of blue fire.

rankUpgrades.description: All storm and inscription damage increased by +1d8 damage.
All storm and inscription damage increased by +1d8 damage, and your storm spells arc to 1 additional enemy within 15 feet.
All storm and inscription damage increased by +2d8 damage.
All storm and inscription damage increased by +2d8 damage, and Galvanic Totem costs 0 mana.

spell.name: Storm Battery Reservoir
spell.description: Your maximum Resonance increases by 6. Whenever a totem strikes an enemy, you generate 1 Resonance.
spell.flavorText: Lightning stored in runic bone.

rankUpgrades.description: Maximum Resonance +10; totem strikes generate 2 Resonance and movement speed +15ft.
Maximum Resonance +15; totem strikes generate 3 Resonance and all runic spells cast instantly.

spell.name: Supercharged Discharge
spell.description: All lightning and storm spells score critical hits on 18+ and critical hits release a 4d8 thunder burst.
spell.flavorText: Thunder follows immediately on the strike.

rankUpgrades.description: Crits on 17+ and thunder burst deals 6d8 storm damage.
Crits on 16+, thunder burst deals 8d8 storm damage, and resets Chain Lightning Inscription cooldown.

spell.name: Galvanic Reincarnation
spell.description: While you maintain at least 1 active totem, lethal damage strikes your totem instead: restores 30 Hit Points, grants 40 temporary health, and calls down lightning for 6d10 damage to all nearby foes (cooldown: 20 rounds).
spell.flavorText: The lightning reanimates the heart.

rankUpgrades.description: Survive lethal damage, restores 45 Hit Points, 60 temp HP, lightning deals 8d10 damage (cooldown: 15 rounds).
Survive lethal damage, restores 60 Hit Points, lightning deals 12d10 damage, and immediately triggers The Ancestral Convergence for free (cooldown: 10 rounds).

spell.name: Starlight Sockets
spell.description: Passive: The parasite hollows out your eyes with condensed starlight. Your ranged attacks ignore 25% of the target's DR. During Full Moon, critical hits deal +2d6 bonus wyrd damage.
spell.flavorText: He sees through bone and stone into the soft marrow beneath.

rankUpgrades.description: Ranged attacks ignore 35% of target's DR; bonus wyrd damage on crits increases to +3d6.
Ranged attacks ignore 50% of target's DR; bonus wyrd damage on crits increases to +4d6 and reveals hidden targets.

spell.name: Parasitic Starlight Bolt
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Fire a high-velocity needle of parasitic light up to 60 ft: deals 1d10 piercing + 1d6 wyrd damage. Ignores half-cover.
spell.flavorText: The parasite calculates trajectory through non-Euclidean angles.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 2d8 piercing + 1d8 wyrd, and range extends to 80 ft.
Damage increases to 2d10 piercing + 2d6 wyrd; critical hits grant an immediate free phase advance.

spell.name: Cold-Silver Vision
spell.description: Passive: Gain darkvision up to 90 ft. You can see invisible and concealed creatures within 30 ft as glowing silver outlines.
spell.flavorText: Darkness is merely starlight waiting to be catalogued.

rankUpgrades.description: True sight range extends to 60 ft; you gain Advantage on all Perception and ranged attack rolls against obscured targets.

spell.name: Hollow Mark
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Mark an enemy within 60 ft for 3 rounds. The marked creature is visible through walls and takes +1d8 wyrd/ember damage from all your attacks.
spell.flavorText: The parasite fixes its gaze. There is nowhere left to hide.

rankUpgrades.description: Bonus damage increases to +2d8 wyrd/ember, and marked targets suffer -2 to all saving throws.
Bonus damage increases to +3d8 wyrd/ember; attacks against marked targets have doubled critical threat range.

spell.name: Crescent Scalpel
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Fire a curved crescent blade of condensed gravity 60 ft down a line: deals 3d8 slashing + 2d6 arcane damage, piercing through all enemies in its path.
spell.flavorText: A curved edge of vacuum that cuts between atoms.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 4d8 slashing + 3d6 arcane, and applies a 1d8 Bleed for 2 rounds.
Damage increases to 5d10 slashing + 4d6 arcane; enemies hit have their movement speed halved for 2 rounds.

spell.name: Sanity Erosion Execution
spell.description: Passive: During Full Moon phase, your ranged critical strikes bypass 100% of physical and magical armor, dealing pure true damage.
spell.flavorText: When the moon is full, the skull is empty and the shot is absolute.

rankUpgrades.description: During Full Moon, your ranged critical strike chance is increased by +25%.
During Full Moon, your ranged critical strikes also stun the target for 1 round.

spell.name: Parasitic Phase Shift
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Teleport instantly 30 ft along moonlight lines. You leave behind a decoy starlight clone that distracts enemies for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: Fold the distance between pulses of the symbiote.

rankUpgrades.description: Teleport range extends to 45 ft; when the decoy expires or is hit, it explodes for 3d8 wyrd damage in 10 ft.
Teleport range extends to 60 ft; the decoy explosion grows to 5d8 wyrd damage in 15 ft and Blinds enemies caught in the blast for 1 round.

spell.name: Orbital Starlight Lance
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Channel for a heartbeat, then fire a blinding starlight spear up to 100 ft: deals 5d10 piercing + 3d8 wyrd damage. Automatically scores a critical hit if target has Hollow Mark.
spell.flavorText: A pinpoint needle dropped from orbit through the target's crown.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 7d10 piercing + 4d8 wyrd, and pierces through solid obstacles without losing damage.
Damage increases to 9d10 piercing + 6d8 wyrd; targets killed by the lance evaporate into starlight dust.

spell.name: Alien Geometry Angles
spell.description: Passive: Your ranged attacks can ricochet off terrain, walls, and obstacles at impossible 90-degree angles to hit targets behind full cover.
spell.flavorText: The parasite does not believe in corners.

rankUpgrades.description: Ricocheting attacks gain +3d6 bonus damage per bounce (up to 2 bounces).

spell.name: Symbiote Overclock
spell.description: Passive: Landing a ranged critical hit reduces the cooldown on all Lunarch abilities by 1 round and grants +10 ft movement speed for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The symbiote feeds on precise violence, pulsing endorphins into dead nerves.

rankUpgrades.description: Cooldown reduction increases to 2 rounds on critical hits.
Critical hits also refund 1 Action Point (once per round).

spell.name: Waning Phase Invisibility
spell.description: Passive: During Waning Moon phase, you become completely invisible while stationary and gain +50% critical strike chance on attacks breaking stealth.
spell.flavorText: When the moon wanes, the host fades into the shadow it casts.

rankUpgrades.description: Invisibility persists while moving at normal speed, and attacks breaking stealth deal +4d8 bonus wyrd damage.

spell.name: Constellation Gridlock
spell.description: Spend 3 AP: Inscribe a starlight constellation across 5 targets within 60 ft: each target takes 6d8 wyrd + 4d6 piercing damage, and silver laser tethers bind them together dealing 2d6 wyrd damage whenever any target moves.
spell.flavorText: Draw lines between stars. The target is merely one of the nodes.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 8d8 wyrd + 6d6 piercing, and tether damage increases to 3d6 wyrd.
Damage increases to 10d8 wyrd + 8d6 piercing; killing any node immediately detonates the remaining nodes for 4d8 wyrd in 15 ft.

spell.name: Forced Lunar Transition
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Manually advance or rewind the Lunar Phase by 1 step without suffering transition shock damage.
spell.flavorText: Press hand against skull. Force the parasite to look at another star.

rankUpgrades.description: Cooldown reduced to 1 round; manually entering Full Moon grants +2 AP on the current turn.

nodes.name: Avatar of the Hollow Starlight Eye

spell.name: Avatar of the Hollow Starlight Eye
spell.description: CAPSTONE — Spend 3 AP: The parasite fully colonizes vision for 3 rounds. Gain infinite range on all ranged abilities, shoot through any thickness of walls or terrain without penalty, all ranged attacks become automatic critical hits, and targets hit take +50% true damage as they glimpse the cold cosmos.
spell.flavorText: There are no walls in the cosmos. There is only target and execution.

spell.name: Cosmic Needle Collapse
spell.description: Passive: Scoring a killing blow with a ranged attack collapses the target into a gravitational singularity: pulls all enemies within 25 ft toward the corpse and deals 4d8 wyrd damage.
spell.flavorText: The wound leaves a hole in reality that the air rushes to fill.

rankUpgrades.description: Singularity radius extends to 35 ft, damage increases to 6d8 wyrd, and pulled enemies are knocked Prone.
Singularity radius extends to 45 ft, damage increases to 8d8 wyrd, and pulled enemies are knocked Prone and Silenced for 1 round.

spell.name: Starfall Excision
spell.description: Spend 3 AP: A single needle of condensed starlight crosses up to 120 ft to strike the Hollow Marked target: deals 4d10 piercing + 2d10 wyrd damage, ignores 50% of the target's DR, and consumes the mark on impact.
spell.flavorText: The parasite does not aim. It subtracts.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 5d10 piercing + 3d10 wyrd, ignores 65% of the target's DR, and if the target dies the mark leaps to the nearest enemy within 30 ft.
Deals 6d10 piercing + 4d10 wyrd and ignores 80% of the target's DR; the shot cannot be blocked by cover, shields, or intervening terrain.
Deals 8d10 piercing + 5d10 wyrd and ignores 90% of the target's DR; killing a marked target refunds 2 AP and extends the mark's duration by 2 rounds.
Deals 10d10 piercing + 6d10 wyrd and ignores 100% of the target's DR and Durability; if the target survives, it is Silenced for 2 rounds.

spell.name: Delirium Verdict
spell.description: Spend 3 AP: Usable only during Full Moon. The hollow eye dilates and fires the parasite's verdict at a target within 90 ft: deals 6d10 wyrd damage that bypasses 100% of DR and Durability, and the target cannot benefit from cover.
spell.flavorText: Sanity was the cost. This is the invoice.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 8d10 wyrd damage, automatically scores a critical hit against Hollow Marked targets, and the parasite's arousal forces a Delirium Table roll after the cast.

Deals 10d10 wyrd damage, automatically scores a critical hit against Hollow Marked targets, and the parasite's arousal forces a Delirium Table roll — made with Advantage if this cast lands a killing blow; you regain 5 mana as it feasts on the target's last memory.

spell.name: Non-Euclidean Predator
spell.description: Passive: Your ranged attacks ignore all cover, and a shot that hits a Hollow Marked target ricochets to a second marked enemy within 30 ft for 50% damage. When an enemy ends its turn within 5 ft of you, you fold through the parasite's alien geometry: teleport 15 ft to a space you can see and leave a starlight decoy behind (once per round).
spell.flavorText: Distance is a suggestion the parasite has never honored.

rankUpgrades.description: Ricochets deal 75% damage to a second marked enemy within 35 ft, and the escape fold teleports 20 ft and detonates the decoy for 4d8 wyrd damage in 10 ft.

Ricochets deal 100% damage to a second marked enemy within 40 ft, the escape fold teleports 25 ft and detonates the decoy for 4d8 wyrd damage in 10 ft, and each ricochet re-applies Hollow Mark to the enemy it strikes.

spell.name: Silence Rend
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Tear open a seam of dead-moon silence 30 ft away: deals 1d8 wyrd + 1d6 blight damage and inflicts Star Sickness (-2 to spellcasting checks and saving throws for 2 rounds).
spell.flavorText: A rip in the air where sound forgets how to travel.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 2d8 wyrd + 1d8 blight, and Star Sickness penalty increases to -3.
Damage increases to 2d10 wyrd + 2d6 blight; target is Silenced for 1 round on a failed Will save.

spell.name: Voice of the Dead Moon
spell.description: Passive: Your vocal chords vibrate with vacuum frequencies. Enemies within 15 ft suffer -2 on Concentration checks and have spell ranges reduced by 10 ft.
spell.flavorText: To hear the silence is to lose the ability to speak.

rankUpgrades.description: Aura radius extends to 20 ft and reduces enemy spell ranges by 15 ft.
Enemies attempting to cast spells within the aura take 2d6 wyrd damage automatically.

spell.name: Symbiotic Sanity Buffer
spell.description: Passive: Gain +3 on saving throws against Madness, Psychic, and Charm effects. The parasite absorbs mental attacks, converting them into +10 temporary HP.
spell.flavorText: You cannot drive a mind mad when something else is already eating it.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain complete immunity to Charm and Fear effects; mental attacks convert into +25 temporary HP.

spell.name: Star Sickness Bloom
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Detonate all active Star Sickness afflictions within 40 ft: each afflicted target takes 3d8 wyrd damage and spreads Star Sickness to all adjacent creatures.
spell.flavorText: The cosmic mold blooms from one skull to the next.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 4d8 wyrd and afflicted enemies are Slowed by 50% for 2 rounds.
Damage increases to 5d8 wyrd; targets afflicted take +25% damage from all spell sources.

spell.name: Aura of Total Silence
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Create a 20 ft dome of absolute silence lasting 2 rounds. No sound or verbal spells can be cast inside or through the dome.
spell.flavorText: Sound ceases. Magic dies at the throat.

rankUpgrades.description: Dome radius extends to 25 ft and lasts 3 rounds.
Enemies inside the dome take 2d8 wyrd damage at the start of each of their turns.

spell.name: Silence Beam
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Channel a continuous beam of void starlight 40 ft down a line: deals 4d8 wyrd damage and shreds 4 Passive DR from all enemies in the beam.
spell.flavorText: A beam of anti-matter that erases resonance.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 5d8 wyrd, and beam width widens to 10 ft.
Damage increases to 7d8 wyrd; enemies caught in the beam are Silenced for 1 round.

spell.name: Amnesiac Siphon
spell.description: Passive: During Waning Moon phase, your damaging abilities siphon memories from foes: targets lose 1 Action Point on their next turn (once per combat per enemy).
spell.flavorText: The parasite takes the memories the host lost and extracts them from the enemy instead.

rankUpgrades.description: Siphoned AP is transferred to you (gain +1 AP on your next turn).

The siphon deepens: each drained target also surrenders 2d6 wyrd damage that the parasite knits into temporary HP, and the drain triggers on every ability that hits (no longer once per combat per enemy).

spell.name: Binding Horror Tendrils
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Erupt cosmic shadow tentacles in a 20 ft radius within 45 ft: deals 3d8 wyrd + 2d8 blight damage and Restrains all enemies (STR save negates Restrain).
spell.flavorText: Black starlight cords anchor the victims to the dead star.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 4d8 wyrd + 3d8 blight, and restrains last 2 rounds.
Damage increases to 6d8 wyrd + 4d8 blight; restrained enemies take 2d8 wyrd damage whenever they attempt an action.

spell.name: Cerebral Collapse
spell.description: Passive: Whenever an enemy fails a saving throw against your abilities, their Mind defense is fractured: they take +30% psychic/wyrd damage for the next 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Cracks in the consciousness through which the cold leaks.

rankUpgrades.description: Bonus damage increases to +50%; the target suffers Disadvantage on all Will saves and takes 2d6 wyrd damage at the start of each of its turns.

spell.name: Silence Supernova
spell.description: Spend 3 AP: Vent the parasite's void pressure in a 30 ft radius: 6d8 wyrd + 4d8 blight damage to all enemies, inflicting Mass Delirium (enemies attack random nearby creatures for 1 round).
spell.flavorText: A flash of negative light that swallows color, sound, and reason.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 8d8 wyrd + 6d8 blight, and confusion lasts 2 rounds.
Damage increases to 10d8 wyrd + 8d8 blight; dispels all magical buffs from all struck enemies.

spell.name: Void Shroud
spell.description: Passive: You are shrouded in silence-light. Ranged attacks and spells targeting you from beyond 30 ft suffer Disadvantage.
spell.flavorText: To look from a distance is to see only a hole in the horizon.

rankUpgrades.description: Threshold lowers to beyond 15 ft, and you gain +4 Passive DR against magical spell damage.

spell.name: Skyhole Rifting
spell.description: Spend 3 AP: Tear open a permanent 20 ft hole to the dead moon overhead for 3 rounds. Starlight vacuum rain falls inside the zone: 8d8 wyrd damage/round and all magic within the zone is dispelled.
spell.flavorText: The sky peels open. The dead moon looks down through the hole.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 10d8 wyrd per round, and radius extends to 30 ft.
Damage increases to 12d8 wyrd per round; enemies caught in the zone cannot leave it (vacuum barrier).

spell.name: Brood-Sibling Communion
spell.description: Passive: The parasite communicates with its brood-siblings across the fallen star. Whenever an ally or enemy casts a spell, gain +5% bonus spell power on your next ability (stacks up to +50%).
spell.flavorText: Thousands of minds connected across the fog share the computation.

rankUpgrades.description: Cap increases to +100% bonus spell power, and at max stacks your next ability costs 0 Action Points.

spell.name: Avatar of Absolute Silence
spell.description: CAPSTONE — Spend 3 AP: Transfigure into the Embodiment of Void for 3 rounds. The entire battlefield (100 ft radius) falls into dead-moon silence: all enemy spells are countered instantly, enemies take 4d8 wyrd damage at the start of their turns, and every attack you make inflicts Star Sickness and removes 2 Action Points from the target.
spell.flavorText: The universe was silent before creation. For three rounds, it is silent again.

spell.name: Accord of the Fallen Star
spell.description: Passive: All wyrd and blight damage dealt by your abilities permanently reduces the target's maximum health by the damage amount for the rest of combat.
spell.flavorText: Wounds eaten by the parasite cannot heal because the tissue was never there.

rankUpgrades.description: Targets whose maximum health drops below 50% from this effect are immediately executed and dissolve into starlight.
The execution threshold rises to 65% of maximum health, and each execution feeds you 50 temporary HP as the stolen vitality is folded into the brood.

spell.name: Brood Moon Ascendant
spell.description: Passive: The parasite's hunger takes lunar shape behind your ribs. Whenever you deal wyrd or blight damage, you heal 10% of the damage dealt and bank a Brood Charge (maximum 3). Your next silence ability spends every charge to deal +1d6 bonus wyrd damage per charge.
spell.flavorText: There is a second moon now, and it is inside you, and it is always hungry.

rankUpgrades.description: Healing rises to 15% of damage dealt, and each Brood Charge adds +2d6 bonus wyrd damage (maximum 3 charges).
Healing rises to 20% of damage dealt, each Brood Charge adds +3d6 bonus wyrd damage, and charges persist until spent (maximum 4).
Healing rises to 25% of damage dealt, each Brood Charge adds +4d6 bonus wyrd damage, and at maximum charges your next silence ability also Stuns its targets for 1 round.
Healing rises to 30% of damage dealt, each Brood Charge adds +5d6 bonus wyrd damage, and spending charges refunds 1 Action Point.

spell.name: Eclipse of the Dead Moon
spell.description: Castable only during the Waning Moon. Spend 3 AP & 15 mana: Drag the dead moon across the sun and drown a 40 ft radius within 80 ft in the silence between stars: deals 6d8 wyrd + 4d8 blight damage, Silences all enemies for 1 round, and inflicts Star Sickness.
spell.flavorText: Daylight is a rumor the dead moon refuses to believe.

rankUpgrades.description: The eclipse widens to a 50 ft radius and deals 8d8 wyrd + 5d8 blight damage; enemies caught at the center are knocked Prone.
Radius reaches 60 ft, damage rises to 10d8 wyrd + 6d8 blight, Silence lasts 2 rounds, and Star Sickness spreads to enemies within 20 ft of every victim.

spell.name: Apotheosis of the Star Plague
spell.description: Passive: Your Star Sickness becomes a living plague. Whenever an afflicted enemy dies, its skull bursts: enemies within 30 ft are afflicted with Star Sickness and take 4d8 wyrd damage.
spell.flavorText: The mold does not mourn its dead. It enrolls them.

rankUpgrades.description: Burst radius extends to 40 ft, damage rises to 6d8 wyrd, and enemies already afflicted take double damage from the burst.
Burst radius extends to 50 ft, damage rises to 8d8 wyrd, a burst that kills another afflicted enemy chain-bursts from it, and this Star Sickness imposes -4 on saving throws.

spell.name: Symbiotic Carapace
spell.description: Passive: The parasite weaves starlight filaments beneath your skin. Gain +3 Passive DR against physical attacks and convert 20% of all damage taken into temporary Grit shielding.
spell.flavorText: The parasite defends its home because without the host, it starves.

rankUpgrades.description: Passive DR increases to +5 and damage conversion increases to 35%.
Passive DR increases to +7; taking physical damage heals you for 5% of max HP (once per round).

spell.name: Sanguine Transfer
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Siphon life from target within 30 ft: deals 1d8 wyrd damage to an enemy and heals yourself or an ally within 30 ft for 100% of damage dealt.
spell.flavorText: Circulate blood across moonlight threads.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage and healing increase to 2d8 wyrd.
Damage and healing increase to 3d8 wyrd; healed target also gains 10 temporary HP.

spell.name: Transition Shock Absorption
spell.description: Passive: You take 50% reduced damage from Lunar Phase shifts. Each phase shift grants you 20 temporary HP for 3 rounds.
spell.flavorText: The host's body learns the rhythm of the internal eclipse.

rankUpgrades.description: Completely eliminates self-damage from Phase shifts; temporary HP granted increases to 40 and extends to adjacent allies.

spell.name: Symbiotic Life-Tether
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Bind a silver vitality tether to an ally within 40 ft for 3 rounds. 30% of all damage they take is redirected to your protective Grit shielding instead.
spell.flavorText: Two bodies woven together by cold starlight.

rankUpgrades.description: Redirect percentage increases to 50%, and tethered ally gains +2 Passive DR.
Redirect percentage increases to 70%; whenever you heal, the tethered ally heals for the same amount.

spell.name: Parasitic Blood Well
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: sear open a seam and plant a living pool of moonlight blood in a 15 ft radius within 30 ft. Lasts 3 rounds: allies inside heal 2d6 HP per round, while enemies take 2d6 wyrd damage per round.
spell.flavorText: A pool of silver vital fluid that feeds friends and digests foes.

rankUpgrades.description: Healing and damage increase to 3d6, and radius extends to 20 ft.
Healing and damage increase to 4d8; allies inside gain Advantage on Constitution saves.

spell.name: Moonwell Aegis
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Encase yourself or an ally in a crystalline silver starlight cocoon for 2 rounds: grants a 40 HP temporary shield and complete immunity to all debuffs.
spell.flavorText: The symbiote hardens into a chrysalis of pure silver.

rankUpgrades.description: Shield value increases to 65 HP, and cleanses all existing conditions upon application.
Shield value increases to 90 HP; when the shield breaks or expires, it bursts healing all nearby allies for 3d8 HP.

spell.name: Symbiote Thorns Siphon
spell.description: Passive: Attackers that strike you in melee take 1d8 wyrd retaliation damage, and you heal for 100% of the retaliation damage dealt.
spell.flavorText: To touch the host is to feed the parasite.

rankUpgrades.description: Retaliation damage increases to 2d8 wyrd, and also triggers against ranged attackers within 20 ft.
Retaliation damage increases to 3d8 wyrd, the siphon heals you for 150% of the retaliation damage dealt, and each retaliation applies Bleeding for 2 rounds.

spell.name: Symbiotic Resurgence
spell.description: REACTION — When you or an ally with Vitality Tether would suffer a fatal blow, the parasite consumes its own reserves to prevent death: restore the target to 30% max health and gain 30 temporary HP (once per combat).
spell.flavorText: The parasite refuses to let the vessel sink.
spell.reactionTrigger: When you or an ally bound by a Vitality Tether would suffer a fatal blow

rankUpgrades.description: Health restored increases to 60% max HP, grants 60 temporary HP, and the target becomes immune to all damage for 1 round following the resurgence.

spell.name: Sanguine Shockwave
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: tear open a seam and release a 20 ft pulse of silver blood: deals 4d8 wyrd damage to all enemies and heals all allies in the radius for 3d8 HP.
spell.flavorText: A heartbeat heard outside the chest.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 6d8 wyrd and healing increases to 4d8 HP.
Damage increases to 8d8 wyrd; enemies struck are knocked back 10 ft and knocked Prone.

spell.name: Hive-Mind Vitality Mesh
spell.description: Passive: Vitality Tether can now be attached to your ENTIRE party simultaneously. All party members share a unified health buffer granting +4 Passive DR to all members.
spell.flavorText: The brood extends threads to every allied soul.

rankUpgrades.description: Passive DR increases to +6 for all party members, and healing any party member heals all others for 20% of the value.
Passive DR increases to +8; whenever any ally takes damage, all enemies within 10 ft of them take 1d8 wyrd retaliation.

spell.name: Lunar Tide Siphon
spell.description: Passive: During Waxing and Full Moon phases, your healing output is increased by 40% and all overhealing is converted into permanent shields.
spell.flavorText: The silver tide floods the wounds until they close seamlessly.

rankUpgrades.description: Healing output increased by 75%; shields granted by overhealing have no upper limit.

spell.name: Living Moonwell Sanctuary
spell.description: Spend 3 AP: Transform a 30 ft radius into a holy Moonwell for 3 rounds. All allies inside take 50% reduced damage, regenerate 5d8 HP per round, and are immune to all status conditions.
spell.flavorText: A pool of pure silver starlight that heals the body and silences pain.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage reduction inside sanctuary increases to 65%, and regeneration increases to 7d8 HP/round.
Damage reduction increases to 80%; enemies attempting to enter the sanctuary take 6d8 wyrd damage and are repelled.

spell.name: Eternal Vessel Vow
spell.description: Passive: Maximum Health increased by +35%. While at 100% health, your movement speed is increased by +15 ft and all ability costs are reduced by 1 AP (minimum 1).
spell.flavorText: When the host is pristine, the parasite gives everything freely.

rankUpgrades.description: Max HP bonus increases to +50%, and AP cost reduction applies while above 75% health.

nodes.name: Avatar of the Blood Moon Broodmother

spell.name: Avatar of the Blood Moon Broodmother
spell.description: CAPSTONE — Spend 3 AP: Fully fuse with the celestial entity for 3 rounds. All allies within 60 ft become completely immune to damage (all damage is absorbed by the infinite cosmic buffer), every allied attack deals +4d8 bonus wyrd damage and heals for 100% of damage dealt, and Sanguine Shockwave auto-casts every turn for free.
spell.flavorText: The host and the parasite are one. The brood will not allow a single life to fall.

spell.name: Sanguine Tithe
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: tear open a seam along your forearm and tithe the blood to the moon — lose 8 HP, and heal the most wounded ally within 40 ft for 2d8 HP plus an amount equal to the HP lost.
spell.flavorText: Blood given freely is the purest silver the moon will ever drink.

rankUpgrades.description: Healing increases to 3d8 HP, and the tithe also grants the ally a 10 HP shield.
Healing increases to 4d8 HP, and the tithe may be split between two allies within 40 ft.
Healing increases to 5d8 HP; if the tithed ally is below 50% health, the tithe heals them for an additional 2d8 HP.
Healing increases to 6d8 HP, and the seam closes around the wound — the HP you lose for the tithe is halved to 4.

spell.name: Bloodmoon Transfusion
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: open every seam at once and let a bloodmoon tide wash outward — lose 15 HP, and all allies within 30 ft heal 3d8 HP and gain a 15 HP shield.
spell.flavorText: Every drop he sheds becomes a roof over someone else's head.

rankUpgrades.description: Allies heal 4d8 HP and gain a 25 HP shield, and the tide cleanses one condition from each ally.
Allies heal 5d8 HP and gain a 40 HP shield; allies below 50% health gain double shields from the tide.

spell.name: Broodmother's Bargain
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: cut a living brood-node from your own flesh — lose 12 HP — and graft it onto an ally within 30 ft for 3 rounds. The graft heals that ally for 3d8 HP at the start of each of their turns, and feeding it pushes the moon onward: advance your Lunar Phase by one step.
spell.flavorText: The broodmother always collects. The warden always pays.

rankUpgrades.description: The graft heals 4d8 HP each round, and the grafted ally gains +2 Passive DR while it persists.
The graft heals 5d8 HP each round; when it ends, the brood-node detonates in a 15 ft pulse that heals all allies for 2d8 HP.

spell.name: Accord of Undying Starlight
spell.description: Passive: If you would die, the parasite dissolves and reforms your body 1 round later at 100% health and full resources at any chosen point within 60 ft (once per long rest).
spell.flavorText: Death is merely a discarded skin. The parasite weaves another.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d6 sacred damage and ignores all partial cover.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain 1 Devotion, +15 feet speed, and your next attack deals +1d6 sacred damage.
Gain 2 Devotion, +15 feet speed, and your next attack deals +1d8 sacred damage.

spell.description: Spend 1 AP and 2 Devotion: Brand an enemy within 35 feet with the symbol of Sol. Deals 2d10 sacred damage immediately, and all sacred damage dealt to the target by anyone is increased by +1d6 for 2 rounds.

rankUpgrades.description: Inquisitor's Brand gains +1d6 bonus damage and refunds 1 AP on critical hits.

rankUpgrades.description: Aura deals 4 sacred damage to enemies within 10 feet.

Solar Resurgence rank 3: +2 Damage Reduction, +15 max HP, and immunity to prone.

spell.description: Passive: Your furnace-plate runs hotter as faith deepens. While your current Devotion Level is 2+, gain +2 Damage Reduction against physical attacks.

rankUpgrades.description: Threshold lowers to Devotion Level 1+, and bonus increases to +3 DR.
Bonus becomes +4 DR at Devotion Level 3+, and you gain 1 Devotion whenever a melee attack hits you.

spell.flavorText: Panic requires an exit. He welded his shut.

rankUpgrades.description: You are immune to Fear while at Devotion Level 4+.

spell.flavorText: Boiler pressure makes for honest knuckles.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 1d10 smashing damage.
Deals 2d6 smashing damage, pushes the target 5 feet, and gains +2d6 bonus damage instead of +1d6 when wounded recently.

spell.name: Steam Vent
spell.description: Spend 1 AP and 1 Devotion: seam vents hiss open, blasting scalding steam — all creatures within 10 feet take 2d6 ember damage (Reflex halves) and suffer -2 to hit until the end of their next turn.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 3d6 ember.
Failed saves also leave enemies Blinded until the end of their next turn; the blast leaves the area Difficult Terrain for 1 round.

spell.name: Heatsink Plating
spell.description: Passive: Melee attackers take 1d6 ember damage on every hit against you while your Devotion Level is 3+.
spell.flavorText: Hitting him is agreement to be burned.

rankUpgrades.description: Thorn damage increases to 2d6 ember and triggers on ranged attacks within 10 feet.
Attackers also ignite: they take an additional 1d6 ember at the start of each of their turns while within 5 feet of you, lasting 1 round.

spell.name: Welded Bulwark
spell.description: Passive: Nothing moves a man who is already part of the wall. While your Devotion Level is 3+, you cannot be pushed, pulled, or forcibly moved.
spell.flavorText: The Groven taught him: roots first, then armor.

rankUpgrades.description: Threshold lowers to Devotion Level 2+.
You are additionally immune to being knocked Prone and count as one size larger vs shove attempts.

spell.name: Cauterizing Walk
spell.description: Passive: Enemies that start their turn adjacent to you take 1d6 ember damage while your Devotion Level is 4+ (the Ironclad Vow's furnace aura, arrived early).
spell.flavorText: Proximity is devotion's tax.

rankUpgrades.description: Threshold lowers to Devotion Level 3+ and radius extends to 10 feet for half damage if you moved this round.

spell.name: Crushing Pistons
spell.description: Passive: Servo-assisted plates flex on command. Gain advantage on checks and saves to escape grapples and restraints; escape attempts you make deal 1d8 smashing damage to whatever holds you.
spell.flavorText: Roots, chains, fingers — the answer is identical.

rankUpgrades.description: Once per round when restrained, you may break free automatically (no check) as a free action while at Devotion Level 3+.

spell.name: Overpressure Blast
spell.description: Spend 2 AP and 2 Devotion: catastrophic vent discharge — all creatures within 15 feet take 4d6 ember damage (Reflex halves) and are thrown 10 feet away from you.
spell.flavorText: The boiler has opinions about being crowded.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 5d6 ember.

rankUpgrades.description: When Molten Spine absorbs a critical hit, attackers also take 2d6 ember from the molten backspray.

spell.name: Furnace Flare

spell.flavorText: Thank you for volunteering.
spell.reactionTrigger: When hit by a melee attack while at Devotion Level 3+

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 3d8 ember.

rankUpgrades.description: Allies within 10 feet also gain +1 DR against physical attacks while your Devotion Level is 5+ — sparks and shrapnel spray off your plates onto theirs.
Radius extends to 15 feet.

spell.name: Welded in the Breach

spell.flavorText: 'There was a door here once,' observers agree. 'There still is,' says the door.

rankUpgrades.description: Enemies that fail the Might check take 1d8 ember damage from contact with the plates.

spell.name: Meltdown Protocol

For 1 round afterward your plating runs cold: lose an additional 10 feet of movement and Furnace Vow/heatsink bonuses are suspended until you regain at least 1 Devotion.
spell.flavorText: There is always one more thing to burn. Sometimes it is him.

rankUpgrades.description: Add your former Devotion Level in flat ember damage (e.g., spent at level 5: 6d6+5).
The cold-down lasts only until the end of your next turn instead of until regaining Devotion.

spell.name: Avatar of the Living Forge
spell.description: CAPSTONE: Spend 2 AP and 3 Devotion (requires Devotion Level 5): become the forge itself for 3 rounds. +6 DR against all damage, immune to Grapple/Restrain/Push/Pull/Fear, aura doubles (enemies within 10 feet take 2d6 ember at the start of your turns), Steam Vent costs no AP and requires no Reaction to place, and your Piston Fist auto-triggers against any enemy that ends its turn adjacent to you.
spell.flavorText: For three rounds, nobody asks whether he is a man or an industry. The question answers them.

spell.name: Forge Doctrine
spell.description: Passive: All I have built, I reinforce. Furnace Vow, Heatsink Plating, Cauterizing Walk, and Furnace Flare each improve by +1 damage tier (or +1 threshold where numeric).
spell.flavorText: Doctrine is a cathedral made of repeat decisions.

rankUpgrades.description: Bonus improves again (+2 tiers/thresholds total).
Steam Vent and Overpressure Blast add +2d6 ember damage.
Doctrine bonus improves to +3 damage tiers/thresholds total, and Steam Vent and Overpressure Blast add +3d6 ember damage.
Doctrine bonus improves to +4 damage tiers/thresholds total; Meltdown Protocol's nova gains +2d6 ember damage and Furnace Flare's retaliation also triggers on ranged attacks within 10 feet.

spell.name: Unquenched Core
spell.description: Passive: The fire in the plates predates the body wearing them. While at Devotion Level 3+, reduction effects against you (DR strip, resistance-pierce, ability-score drain) fail unless they exceed twice your Devotion Level, and you gain +2 to Constitution saves.
spell.flavorText: Cold approached and asked permission. It was denied.

rankUpgrades.description: The first time each combat an enemy applies Cold-slow or Storm-vulnerability effects to you, they instead take 3d6 ember backlash from the plates drinking it.

spell.name: Debt of Embers
spell.description: Passive: Whenever the same enemy damages you twice in a single round while within 30 feet, its accumulated debt settles: 3d6 ember damage erupts along its weapon-arm (once per round per enemy).
spell.flavorText: He keeps books in slag. Payments are automatic.

rankUpgrades.description: Eruption damage increases to 5d6 ember and the attacker is disarmed of weapons held in the eruption zone for 1 round on a failed Fortitude save.

spell.name: Litany of Coals
spell.description: Passive: He recites it through welded lips as plates run hot. Gain +2 to all saving throws. While at least one hostile creature stands within 10 feet, you are immune to Frightened and Despair effects — the litany has no verse for running.
spell.flavorText: Sol does not ask the coal to leap from the fire. Neither should you.

rankUpgrades.description: Saving throw bonus increases to +4, and allies within 10 feet gain half the bonus (+2) so long as you remain standing — the litany carries.

spell.name: Soothing Hymn
spell.description: Play a restorative tide-melody: heal all allies within 30 feet for 2d6 health and generate 1 Note I (Tonic) and 1 Note IV (Subdominant).
spell.flavorText: Every healing melody starts on the same shore.

rankUpgrades.description: Heals all allies within 30 feet for 3d6 health and grants +1 Note I.
Heals all allies for 4d6 health, grants +2 Note I, and overheal becomes temporary health.

spell.name: Tonic Resonance
spell.description: Whenever you generate Note I (Tonic), the lowest-health ally within 30 feet is healed for 1d4 health and gains +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The sea tends its drowned things gently.

rankUpgrades.description: Note I generation heals lowest-health ally for 2d4 and grants +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability.
Note I generation heals for 3d4, grants +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability, and cleanses 1 minor debuff.

spell.name: Slack Tide Grace
spell.description: All your healing and cadence spells cost 2 less mana (minimum 1). Movement speed +10ft while you hold at least 3 notes.
spell.flavorText: A calm performer plays longer. Usually survives longer too.

rankUpgrades.description: Spells cost 3 less mana; movement speed +15ft while holding notes, and holding 5+ notes grants +2 to all saving throws.

spell.name: Submediant Ward
spell.description: Spend 2 notes: envelop an ally within 45 feet in a resonant barrier absorbing 3d8 damage for 1 minute. When the ward breaks, it bursts, healing adjacent allies for 2d6.
spell.flavorText: The saddest note is the most protective. Ask any sailor.

rankUpgrades.description: Ward absorbs 4d8 damage, bursts for 3d8 healing on break, and cooldown drops to 1 round.
Ward absorbs 6d8 damage, bursts for 4d8 healing, and can be placed on two allies simultaneously.

spell.name: Cadence Memory
spell.description: When you resolve any cadence, retain 1 note of your choice from the consumed chord, and all allies gain 1d6 temporary health.
spell.flavorText: Nothing truly ends. Especially not the good parts.

rankUpgrades.description: Retain 2 notes of your choice from consumed cadences; allies gain 2d6 temporary health.
Retain 2 notes freely; allies gain 3d6 temporary health and 10 points movement speed for 1 round.

spell.name: Authentic Cadence
spell.description: Spend 4 notes (V to I progression): unleash an authentic resolution on an ally within 45 feet. Heals 3d8 health and grants +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability and 4 Damage Reduction against all-damage for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: The grand finale resonates deeper than any individual note.

rankUpgrades.description: Heals 4d8 health, grants +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability and 4 Damage Reduction for 2 rounds.
Heals 5d8 health, grants +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability, 4 Damage Reduction, and also heals all adjacent allies for 50 points of the amount.

spell.name: Plagal Flow
spell.description: Whenever you complete a cadence, all allies within 30 feet gain regeneration: healing 1d6 health per round for 3 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Amen, said the tide.

rankUpgrades.description: Cadences grant regeneration of 2d6 health per round for 3 rounds.
Cadences grant 3d6 health per round for 4 rounds, and regeneration ticks cannot be halted by heal-reduction effects.

spell.name: Cleansing Stanza
spell.description: Spend 2 notes: emit a wave of pure harmonic resonance. Removes ALL curses, diseases, poisons, and debuffs from all allies within 35 feet, granting them immunity to new debuffs for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: Optimism, weaponized against corruption.

rankUpgrades.description: Removes all debuffs, grants 2 rounds of immunity, and heals cleansed allies for 2d8 each.
Removes all debuffs, grants 2 rounds immunity, heals for 3d8, and refunds 1 note for every debuff removed.

spell.name: Lullaby Ward
spell.description: When an ally within 30 feet is targeted by an enemy spell, use a reaction to grant them advantage on the save and a 2d8 damage shield.
spell.flavorText: Sleep tight. The wards hold.

rankUpgrades.description: Reaction grants +4 to the saving throw, a 4d8 damage shield, and if the save succeeds, refunds 2 notes to you.

spell.name: Healing Chorus
spell.description: Spend 4 notes: channel a soaring vocal hymn for 3 rounds. All allies within 40 feet heal for 3d8 health each round and cannot be knocked down or displaced while within the song.
spell.flavorText: The sea sings bass. It is very good at it.

rankUpgrades.description: Heals 5d8 per round within 40 feet, allies gain +2 to all rolls while inside, and can be channeled while taking other actions.

spell.name: Tonic Surge
spell.description: Whenever you hold 4 or more notes, all your healing spells heal for 30 points more, and you passively heal adjacent allies for 1d6 health every round.
spell.flavorText: The tonic cannot be contained. Neither can the tide.

rankUpgrades.description: Holding 4+ notes boosts healing by 50 points and passive aura heals for 2d6 per round.
Holding 4+ notes boosts healing by 75 points, aura heals for 3d6, and you generate 1 free Note I every round.

spell.name: Death-Defying Aria
spell.description: Reaction: when an ally within 60 feet drops to 0 health, consume 4 notes to instantly revive them with 50 points maximum health and 30 temporary health. Cooldown: 15 rounds.
spell.flavorText: The encore nobody wanted to need.

spell.name: Symphonic Harmony
spell.description: When you cast a healing spell, 30 points of the healing done is duplicated to ALL other allies within 30 feet.
spell.flavorText: The melody splits cleanly, losing nothing in the translation.

rankUpgrades.description: 40 points of single-target healing is duplicated to all allies within 35 feet, and overheal grants +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability (stacks up to +3).

spell.name: Tidal Sanctum
spell.description: You and all allies within 30 feet cannot have your maximum health reduced, and gain 4 Damage Reduction from all sources.
spell.flavorText: The harbor wall holds against the open deep.

rankUpgrades.description: Party takes 25 points less damage from all sources and gains +3 to all saving throws against magical effects.

spell.name: Mereval Symphony
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 6 notes to unleash the Grand Symphony of the Mereval for 1 minute: all allies within 50 feet regenerate 4d8 health each round, cannot drop below 1 health from any single attack, and all enemy damage within the radius is reduced by 40 points.
spell.flavorText: The song the world was sung with. You are conducting it now.

spell.name: Sacred Choir Doctrine
spell.description: Every verse harmonizes. All healing you perform across all spells and cadences is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: A hundred voices, singing in one throat.

rankUpgrades.description: All healing increased by +1d8 damage.
All healing increased by +1d8 damage, and each healing cadence restores 1 additional note.
All healing increased by +2d8 damage.
All healing increased by +2d8 damage, and Soothing Hymn generates 4 notes instead of 2.

spell.name: Endless Cadence
spell.description: Whenever you complete a cadence, your next cadence within 2 rounds costs 2 fewer notes (minimum 1).
spell.flavorText: The resolution of one chord is the opening of the next.

rankUpgrades.description: Chained cadences cost 3 fewer notes, and their healing is increased by +1d8 damage.
Chained cadences cost 3 fewer notes, deal +50 points healing, and grant 1 Action Point on completion.

spell.name: Fountain of the Deep
spell.description: Whenever an ally is healed above maximum health, they gain 100 points of the excess as a temporary health barrier (up to 40 temp HP).
spell.flavorText: The tide cannot overflow; it only claims higher ground.

rankUpgrades.description: Overheal converts to temporary health up to 70 temp HP, and allies with temp HP deal +1d6 bonus damage.
Overheal converts to temporary health up to 100 temp HP; allies with temp HP deal +1d8 bonus damage and gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability.

spell.name: Immortal Cadence
spell.description: While you maintain at least 4 notes, you cannot be killed: lethal damage consumes all your notes and heals you for 5d10 health (cooldown: 20 rounds).
spell.flavorText: The song refuses to let the singer fall.

rankUpgrades.description: Lethal damage consumes notes, heals you for 7d10, and grants you 40 temporary health (cooldown: 15 rounds).
Lethal damage consumes notes, heals you for full health, casts Cleansing Stanza automatically, and resets Death-Defying Aria (cooldown: 10 rounds).

spell.name: Sonic Lance
spell.description: Cast a focused sonic lance at an enemy within 45 feet: deals 2d8 storm damage and generates 1 Note V (Dominant) and 1 Note I (Tonic).
spell.flavorText: Build tension, then strike with clean intent.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 3d8 storm damage, ignores up to 4 points of enemy Armor, and grants +2 Note V.
Deals 3d8 storm damage, ignores up to 4 points of enemy Armor, grants +2 Note V, and resets cooldown on critical hit.

spell.name: Dominant Fury
spell.description: Whenever you generate Note V (Dominant), all your weapon and spell attacks deal +1d6 additional storm damage for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The dominant demands violence. It usually gets it.

rankUpgrades.description: Note V generation grants +2d6 storm damage to attacks.
Note V grants +3d6 storm damage and your critical strike chance increases by 10 points for 1 round.

spell.name: Battle Cadence Tempo
spell.description: All allies within 30 feet gain +1 to hit and +1d4 damage on all weapon attacks while you hold at least 2 notes.
spell.flavorText: Forward motion empowers.

rankUpgrades.description: Allies within 35 feet gain +2 to hit, +1d6 damage, and +10ft movement speed.

spell.name: Battle Anthem
spell.description: Spend 2 notes: chant an invigorating war-anthem. All allies within 35 feet deal +2d8 bonus damage on their next 2 attacks and gain +15ft movement speed for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: A hundred blades strike as one beat.

rankUpgrades.description: Allies deal +3d8 bonus damage on their next 2 attacks and gain +20ft movement speed.
Allies deal +4d8 bonus damage on next 3 attacks, gain +25ft speed, and attack with advantage.

spell.name: Cadence Momentum
spell.description: After resolving any offensive cadence, your next spell costs 0 mana.
spell.flavorText: The composition never stops.

rankUpgrades.description: After offensive cadences: next spell costs 0 mana and generates 2 free notes.
After offensive cadences: your next TWO spells cost 0 mana and generate 2 notes each.

spell.name: Perfect Cadence Strike
spell.description: Spend 4 notes (V to I progression): unleash an explosive acoustic strike against a target within 45 feet. Deals 3d8 storm damage and sunders target durability by -4 for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: The perfect progression hits harder than iron.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 4d8 storm damage and sunders durability by -6 for 3 rounds.
Deals 5d8 storm damage, sunders -6 Durability Steps to target's durability, and shockwaves deal 4d10 storm damage to all enemies within 15 feet.

spell.name: Circle of Fifths
spell.description: When you cast an offensive cadence, a rotating harmonic wheel sweeps around you for 3 rounds: deals 2d8 storm damage to all enemies within 15 feet every round.
spell.flavorText: Eternal rotation of harmonious destruction.

rankUpgrades.description: Harmonic wheel deals 3d8 storm damage within 20 feet and slows enemies by 10ft.
Harmonic wheel deals 4d8 storm damage within 25 feet, slows by 15ft, and each tick grants you 1 Note V.

spell.name: Thunder Stanza
spell.description: Spend 3 notes: release a concussive shockwave in a 25-foot radius. Deals 4d8 storm damage, knocks all enemies 15 feet back, and interrupts all spellcasting.
spell.flavorText: A chord loud enough to silence thunder itself.

rankUpgrades.description: 30-foot shockwave deals 5d8 storm damage, knocks enemies 20ft back, and knocks them prone.
35-foot shockwave deals 6d8 storm damage, knocks enemies prone, and stuns them for 1 round.

spell.name: Double Time Tempo
spell.description: While you hold 4 or more notes, all your attack and spell cast times are reduced by 50 points, and you gain 1 bonus Action Point at the start of each turn.
spell.flavorText: Accelerando, but with weapons.

rankUpgrades.description: Holding 4+ notes gives instant cast times on all cadence builders and grants 2 bonus Action Points per turn.

spell.name: Crescendo Detonation
spell.description: Spend 4 notes: detonate the acoustic tension around a target within 45 feet. Deals 6d10 storm damage to the target and 3d10 to all enemies within 20 feet. Damage increases by +20 points for each Note V in your chord.
spell.flavorText: The loudest moment of the concert.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 8d10 storm to target and 4d10 to nearby foes. Note V bonus increases to +30 points per Note V.

spell.name: Overture Momentum
spell.description: Whenever an ally hits an enemy affected by your Perfect Strike or Battle Anthem, that ally deals an additional 2d6 storm damage and you gain 1 Note V.
spell.flavorText: Every strike contributes to the score.

rankUpgrades.description: Ally hits deal 3d6 bonus storm damage and grant 1 Note V.
Ally hits deal 4d6 bonus storm damage, grant 2 Note V, and extend Battle Anthem by 1 round.

spell.name: Rallying Fanfare
spell.description: Spend 5 notes: command up to 3 allies within 40 feet. Each targeted ally immediately uses a reaction to perform their strongest single-target attack with +4 to hit and double critical damage.
spell.flavorText: A single bar of music, answering a battle.

spell.name: Harmonic Fortification
spell.description: You and all allies within 30 feet gain +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability, and weapon attacks score critical hits on 18+.
spell.flavorText: Armor tuned to the pitch of battle.

rankUpgrades.description: Party gains +5 Durability Steps to equipped durability and weapon attacks crit on 17+, dealing triple critical damage.

spell.name: Tempest Cadence
spell.description: All storm damage dealt by you and your party ignores 6 Damage Reduction and has a 30 points chance to shock (interferes with enemy actions for 1 round).
spell.flavorText: The lightning hums in key.

rankUpgrades.description: Storm damage ignores 8 Damage Reduction, shock chance increases to 60 points, and shocked enemies take +20 points damage from all sources.

spell.name: Titan Anthem
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 6 notes to conduct the Titan War Anthem for 1 minute: all allies within 50 feet deal TRIPLE damage dice on all attacks and spells, gain +4 Durability Steps to equipped durability, and whenever ANY ally kills an enemy, all party cooldowns are reduced by 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: The song the mountains sing when they choose to move.

spell.name: War Conductor Doctrine
spell.description: All offensive storm damage dealt by your cadences and party battle anthems is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: The baton is mightier than the claymore.

rankUpgrades.description: Offensive storm damage increased by +1d8 damage.
Offensive storm damage increased by +1d8 damage, and offensive cadences generate 1 additional note.
Offensive storm damage increased by +2d8 damage.
Offensive storm damage increased by +2d8 damage, and Sonic Lance costs 0 mana.

spell.name: Infinite Cadence
spell.description: Whenever you land a critical strike with an offensive cadence, you immediately generate 3 Note V notes and your next cadence costs 2 fewer notes.
spell.flavorText: The thunder does not pause between strikes.

rankUpgrades.description: Crits generate 4 Note V notes and next cadence is free.
Crits generate full notes, next cadence is free and instant, and resets Crescendo Detonation.

spell.name: Storm Overture
spell.description: At the start of combat, you instantly gain 4 Note V notes and all allies within 30 feet gain +4 to their initiative rolls.
spell.flavorText: The war begins on your first beat.

rankUpgrades.description: Start combat with 6 Note V notes and party gains +6 to initiative and +15ft first-round speed.
Start combat with full notes, party acts first unconditionally, and your first Battle Anthem is cast automatically for free.

spell.name: Battlechoir Resurgence
spell.description: Whenever an ally drops below half maximum Hit Points, you automatically emit a free Battle Anthem and grant that ally a 4d8 damage shield (cooldown: 5 rounds).
spell.flavorText: When the line wavers, the chorus sings loudest.

rankUpgrades.description: Emits Battle Anthem + 6d8 damage shield, and the ally immediately makes a free retaliation strike.
Emits Battle Anthem + 8d8 shield, ally makes free retaliation strike with guaranteed critical hit, and restores 20 Hit Points.

spell.name: Dissonant Shriek
spell.description: Unleash a piercing shriek of pure acoustic discord in a 25-foot cone: deals 2d6 wyrd damage, deafens enemies for 2 rounds, and generates 1 Note VII (Leading Tone) and 1 Note II (Supertonic).
spell.flavorText: A gull of ill omen through the gathering dark.

rankUpgrades.description: 30-foot cone deals 2d6 wyrd damage, deafens for 2 rounds, and interrupts verbal spellcasting.
35-foot cone deals 2d6 wyrd damage, deafens for 3 rounds, interrupts casting, and generates 2 Note VII.

spell.name: Unsettling Discord
spell.description: Whenever you generate Note II (Supertonic) or Note VII (Leading Tone), all enemies within 15 feet take 1d6 wyrd damage and have disadvantage on their next attack roll.
spell.flavorText: The tide shivers at the discord. So does everyone else.

rankUpgrades.description: Discord aura deals 2d6 wyrd damage and reduces enemy spell DCs by -2.
Discord aura deals 3d6 wyrd damage, reduces spell DCs by -3, and enemies taking damage have a 30 points chance to be silenced for 1 round.

spell.name: Acoustic Strain
spell.description: All your crowd-control and dissonance spells have their save DCs increased by +2 and ignore 10 points of enemy magical resistances.
spell.flavorText: The mind cannot easily resist the wrong note.

rankUpgrades.description: Save DCs increased by +3, ignores 2 Damage Reduction, and enemies failing saves against you take 1d6 wyrd backlash.

spell.name: Tritone Discord
spell.description: Spend 2 notes: strike the forbidden tritone interval on a target within 45 feet. Deals 3d8 wyrd damage, confuses the target (must save or attack random adjacent creature on its turn), and lasts 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The devil's chord. Always effective.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 4d8 wyrd damage, confusion lasts 2 rounds, and target attacks its allies with advantage.
Deals 4d8 wyrd damage, confuses up to 2 targets in range, and refunds 1 note if the confused target hits its ally.

spell.name: Dissonant Resonance
spell.description: Whenever an enemy fails a saving throw against any of your spells, all enemies within 15 feet of it take 2d6 wyrd damage and are slowed by 10ft.
spell.flavorText: Contagion in the key of discord.

rankUpgrades.description: Failure ripples 3d6 wyrd damage within 20 feet and slows enemies by 15ft.
Failure ripples 4d6 wyrd damage within 25 feet, slows by 20ft, and silences victims for 1 round.

spell.name: Deceptive Cadence
spell.description: Spend 4 notes (V to VI progression): feign a resolution, only to violently subvert it. Target within 45 feet takes 3d8 wyrd damage, is stunned for 1 round, and all enemies within 15 feet take 2d8 collateral damage.
spell.flavorText: They thought it resolved. It did not.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 4d8 wyrd to primary and 3d8 to collateral. Stun duration remains 1 round.
Deals 5d8 wyrd to primary and 4d8 to collateral. Stuns for 1 round and forces primary target to drop its weapons.

spell.name: Suspended Resonance
spell.description: Whenever you hold at least 3 notes, an oscillating acoustic barrier surrounds you: gain +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability and attackers who strike you take 2d8 wyrd damage.
spell.flavorText: The unsaid chord guards the doorway.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +5 Durability Steps to equipped durability, attackers take 3d8 wyrd damage and are pushed 10ft back.
Gain +6 Durability Steps to equipped durability, attackers take 4d8 wyrd, are pushed 15ft, and become deafened for 2 rounds.

spell.name: Sonic Feedback
spell.description: Reaction (spend 3 notes): when an enemy casts a spell targeting you or an ally within 30 feet, invert the sonic frequency. Counter the spell completely and reflect 25 points of its damage back at the caster.
spell.flavorText: Their own voice, shoved back down their throat.

rankUpgrades.description: Counters spell, reflects 25 points of damage back at caster, and silences the caster for 1 round.
Counters spell, reflects 25 points damage, silences caster for 2 rounds, and refunds 2 notes on successful reflection.

spell.name: Discordant Strain
spell.description: All wyrd and dissonance damage you deal ignores 6 Damage Reduction, and critical strikes with dissonance abilities double in damage multiplier.
spell.flavorText: Clean disharmony pierces every shield.

rankUpgrades.description: Ignores 6 Damage Reduction; critical strikes triple in damage multiplier and cause the victim to bleed psychic energy for 3d8 over 2 rounds.

spell.name: Mind Shatter
spell.description: Spend 4 notes: channel an excruciating acoustic frequency at a target within 50 feet for 3 rounds. Deals 4d8 wyrd damage per round, destroys all enemy concentration, and silences the target for the full duration.
spell.flavorText: The pitch where thoughts simply break apart.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 6d8 wyrd per round, silences target, and collateral shockwaves deal 3d8 wyrd to all adjacent enemies.

spell.name: Cacophony Engine
spell.description: Whenever an enemy takes damage from your dissonance or wrong-note abilities, you have a 40 points chance to generate 1 Note VII and 1 Note II.
spell.flavorText: Chaos generates its own raw materials.

rankUpgrades.description: 60 points chance to generate notes on dissonance damage, and Note VII attacks deal +2d6 bonus damage.
100 points chance to generate Note VII and Note II on dissonance damage; your note bank maximum increases by 3.

spell.name: Deafening Crescendo
spell.description: Spend 5 notes: detonate a massive 40-foot sonic shockwave. Deals 6d10 wyrd damage to all enemies in range, stuns all enemies for 1 round, and permanently deafens them for the encounter.
spell.flavorText: Silence, achieved through overwhelming noise.

spell.name: Permanent Discord
spell.description: Enemies deafened or confused by your abilities suffer +1d6 bonus damage from ALL party members and cannot take reactions.
spell.flavorText: They cannot coordinate in the noise.

rankUpgrades.description: Deafened/confused enemies suffer +2d6 bonus damage from all sources, lose all reactions, and their movement speed is halved.

spell.name: Psychic Resonance Bleed
spell.description: Whenever a target takes damage from your dissonance spells, they bleed 2d6 wyrd damage per round for 3 rounds. Stacks up to 3 times.
spell.flavorText: The ringing in their ears refuses to cease.

rankUpgrades.description: Bleed ticks for 3d6 wyrd per round, stacks up to 5 times, and enemies at max stacks are blinded.

spell.name: Symphony of Ruin
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 6 notes: conduct the Acoustic Apocalypse for 1 minute: a 50-foot zone of reality-tearing dissonance erupts. Deals 5d10 wyrd damage per round to all enemies inside, completely prevents all enemy spellcasting, and causes enemies inside to attack each other on their turns.
spell.flavorText: The final chord that dissolves the theater.

spell.name: Dissonance Doctrine
spell.description: The wrong note is the truest note. All wyrd damage you deal across all spells and cadences is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: Harmony was always a compromise. Discord is pure.

rankUpgrades.description: All wyrd damage increased by +1d8 damage.
All wyrd damage increased by +1d8 damage, and your dissonance effects last 1 additional round.
All wyrd damage increased by +2d8 damage.
All wyrd damage increased by +2d8 damage, and Dissonant Shriek costs 0 mana.

spell.name: Acoustic Singularity
spell.description: Whenever a target dies while under the effect of your dissonance or confusion, it implodes: pulls all enemies within 25 feet toward its corpse and deals 4d8 wyrd damage to them.
spell.flavorText: The vacuum left by silenced thoughts.

rankUpgrades.description: Implosion pulls within 30 feet, deals 6d8 wyrd damage, and knocks all pulled enemies prone.
Implosion deals 8d8 wyrd damage, stuns all pulled enemies for 1 round, and restores 3 notes to your bank.

spell.name: Master of Discord
spell.description: Sonic Feedback can be used twice per round and costs 1 fewer note.
spell.flavorText: Every counter is an opening movement.

rankUpgrades.description: Sonic Feedback costs 2 fewer notes and can be used on ranged weapon attacks as well as spells.
Sonic Feedback is FREE, can be used 3 times per round on ANY attack or spell, and reflected damage is doubled.

spell.name: Living Discord
spell.description: You are immune to silence, deafness, and all mental control effects. Whenever an enemy attempts to charm or silence you, it takes 5d8 wyrd damage in feedback.
spell.flavorText: You cannot silence what is already pure noise.

rankUpgrades.description: Immunity to mental control; feedback deals 7d8 wyrd damage and confuses the attacker for 1 round.
Immunity; feedback deals 10d8 wyrd damage, stuns the attacker for 2 rounds, and immediately gives you full notes.

spell.name: Spore Volley
spell.description: Launch a cluster of volatile spores: strikes up to 3 targets within 45 feet, dealing 2d6 blight damage and applying a Stage 1 Seed to each.
spell.flavorText: One row at a time. The whole field, eventually.

rankUpgrades.description: Strikes up to 4 targets for 2d6 blight damage each and applies Stage 1 Seeds.
Strikes up to 5 targets for 2d6 blight damage each, applies Stage 1 Seeds, and generates 2 Virulence.

spell.name: Rapid Contagion
spell.description: Whenever an affliction spreads to an adjacent target, it deals 1d6 blight damage upon spreading and increases your Virulence by 1.
spell.flavorText: Distance is no cure. Neither is anything else.

rankUpgrades.description: Contagion spreads deal 2d6 blight damage and grant 2 Virulence.
Contagion spreads deal 3d6 blight damage, grant 2 Virulence, and have a 30 points chance to immediately bounce a second time.

spell.name: Airborne Proliferation
spell.description: All your affliction and contagion spread radii are increased by +10 feet. Maximum Virulence increased by 2.
spell.flavorText: Every new host is a dividend.

rankUpgrades.description: Spread radii increased by +20 feet. Maximum Virulence increased by 4 and you begin combat with 2 Virulence.

spell.name: Vector Detonation
spell.description: Spend 2 Virulence: detonate the spores inside an infected target within 45 feet. Deals 3d8 blight damage in a 20-foot radius and forces all victims to gain Stage 1 Seeds.
spell.flavorText: Maturity, in the Peat-Wastes, means leaving home violently.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 3d8 blight damage in a 25-foot radius and applies Stage 2 Seeds to all enemies caught in the blast.
Deals 3d8 blight damage in a 30-foot radius, applies Stage 2 Seeds, and disorients all victims for 1 round.

spell.name: Chain Contagion
spell.description: When an infected target takes damage from any source, there is a 35 points chance they emit a toxic cough dealing 1d6 blight to all adjacent enemies.
spell.flavorText: The guest list grows itself.

rankUpgrades.description: 50 points chance on damaged infected target to emit toxic cough for 2d6 blight damage.
65 points chance on damaged infected target to emit toxic cough for 3d6 blight damage, and each cough restores 1 Virulence to you.

spell.name: Pandemic Gale

spell.flavorText: The wave does not check passports.

rankUpgrades.description: 40-foot cone deals 4d8 blight damage and knocks all affected enemies 10 feet back.
45-foot cone deals 5d8 blight damage, knocks enemies back, and seeds every victim at Stage 2.

spell.name: Infectious Miasma
spell.description: Enemies within 15 feet of any target carrying an affliction take 1d8 blight damage per turn and cannot regain health above 75 points.
spell.flavorText: Proximity is a preexisting condition.

rankUpgrades.description: Aura deals 2d8 blight per turn within 20 feet and caps enemy health at 50 points.
Aura deals 3d8 blight per turn within 25 feet, caps enemy health at 50 points, and automatically seeds uninfected foes entering the aura.

spell.name: Plague Zone
spell.description: Spend 3 Virulence: seed a 25-foot radius on the ground for 1 minute. Enemies inside take 2d8 blight damage per round, are slowed by 15 feet, and gain a new Stage 1 Seed every round.
spell.flavorText: Real estate with a pathogen problem.

rankUpgrades.description: 30-foot zone deals 3d8 blight per round, slows by 20 feet, and reduces enemy durability by -3 while inside.
35-foot zone deals 4d8 blight per round, prevents enemy dash/teleport, and kills inside grant you 3 Virulence.

spell.name: Spore Multiplication
spell.description: Whenever an afflicted enemy dies, they burst: all enemies within 20 feet take 2d8 blight damage and receive all afflictions the dead host had.
spell.flavorText: Blooming is not an ending. It is a distribution event.

rankUpgrades.description: Death burst deals 4d8 blight damage within 25 feet and heals you for 2d8 per enemy struck.

spell.name: Epidemic Surge
spell.description: Spend 4 Virulence: instantly advance every active affliction on ALL enemies within 60 feet by 1 full stage, and trigger their stage damage immediately.

rankUpgrades.description: Advances all afflictions by 2 stages immediately and staggers all infected targets (they lose 1 action point next turn).

spell.name: Pathogen Reservoir
spell.description: Your maximum Virulence increases by 4. Whenever you have 5 or more Virulence, your movement speed is increased by 15 feet and all blight damage you deal is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: The vats never sleep. Neither does the accountant.

rankUpgrades.description: Maximum Virulence +6; +20ft speed and +25 points blight damage while at 5+ Virulence.
Maximum Virulence +8; +25ft speed, +35 points blight damage, and at 8+ Virulence all your spell cooldowns recharge 50 points faster.

spell.name: Global Pandemic
spell.description: Spend 5 Virulence: copy every active affliction on every infected enemy to ALL uninfected enemies within 80 feet, maintaining their highest active stage.
spell.flavorText: The Peat-Wastes have a word for this. The word is 'Tuesday'.

spell.name: Vector Cascade
spell.description: Whenever an enemy takes damage from an affliction while within 10 feet of another infected enemy, both take an additional 2d6 blight crossfire damage.

rankUpgrades.description: Crossfire radius increases to 15 feet, deals 3d6 blight damage, and each crossfire proc restores 1 Virulence (up to 3 per turn).

spell.name: Superbug Mutation

spell.name: Patient Zero
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Designate one enemy as Patient Zero for 1 minute: all afflictions on the battlefield constantly pulse out from Patient Zero in a 40-foot aura every round, dealing 4d8 blight damage to all nearby enemies and seeding all victims at Stage 3. If Patient Zero dies, the aura detonates for 10d8 blight across 50 feet.
spell.flavorText: It began with one. It ends with everyone.

spell.name: Waste Spore Doctrine
spell.description: The Peat-Wastes bloom without boundary. All blight AoE damage and contagion damage you deal is increased by +1d6 damage.

rankUpgrades.description: All blight AoE and contagion damage increased by +1d8 damage.
All blight AoE and contagion damage increased by +1d8 damage, and each contagion spread seeds victims 1 additional Stage.

All blight AoE and contagion damage increased by +2d8 damage, and Spore Volley costs 0 mana.

spell.name: Continuous Blooming
spell.description: Whenever 3 or more enemies are infected simultaneously, you generate 2 Virulence at the start of your turn.
spell.flavorText: The garden feeds the gardener constantly.

rankUpgrades.description: Generate 4 Virulence at the start of your turn while 3+ enemies are infected, and your movement speed increases by +15ft.
Generate 6 Virulence per turn while 3+ enemies are infected. Plague Zone duration is doubled.

spell.name: Pandemic Overdrive
spell.description: All contagion spread procs have their ranges doubled, and contagion spread damage crits on 18+.
spell.flavorText: A wind that leaves nothing untouched.

rankUpgrades.description: Spread ranges doubled, crits on 17+, and contagion crits knock enemies back 5 feet.
Spread ranges tripled, crits on 16+, and each contagion crit refunds 1 Virulence.

spell.name: Living Pathogen
spell.description: You emit a 15-foot passive pathogen aura: all enemies inside take 2d6 blight damage per round and you heal for all damage dealt by the aura.
spell.flavorText: You are the epidemic now.

rankUpgrades.description: Aura radius 20 feet, deals 3d6 blight damage per round, and heals you for 100 points of damage dealt.
Aura radius 25 feet, deals 4d6 blight damage per round, heals you for 100 points, and enemies inside have their damage reduced by 25 points.

spell.name: Agony Tether
spell.description: Shoot a psychic tether binding an enemy within 45 feet to a secondary target within 30 feet of it for 1 minute: whenever the primary target takes damage, the secondary takes 25 points of that damage as wyrd damage.
spell.flavorText: Suffering loves company. You arranged the introduction.

rankUpgrades.description: Tether shares 25 points of all damage and both targets take 1d6 wyrd damage each time the tether echoes.
Tether shares 25 points of all damage, echoes deal 2d6 wyrd damage, and the tether can bind a 3rd target for 25 points shared damage.

spell.name: Resonant Agony

Linked targets take 2d6 additional wyrd damage, and each resonance trigger restores 1 Virulence.

spell.name: Shared Torment

spell.name: Synaptic Siphon
spell.description: Spend 2 Virulence: siphon through the psychic web. Deals 2d8 wyrd damage to ALL currently linked targets simultaneously and heals you for 50 points of the total damage dealt.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 3d8 wyrd damage to all linked targets, heals for 50 points, and restores 5 mana per linked target hit.
Deals 3d8 wyrd damage to all linked targets, heals for 50 points, restores 10 mana per target, and silences linked targets for 1 round.

spell.name: Psychic Vulnerability
spell.description: Linked enemies have their saving throws reduced by -2 and suffer +1d6 bonus damage from all psychic and wyrd sources.

rankUpgrades.description: Linked enemies take -3 on saving throws and take 25 points more wyrd damage.
Linked enemies take -4 on saves, 35 points more wyrd damage, and have their durability reduced by -3.

Traps up to 6 enemies: damage echoes at 25 points among all of them, webbed targets are slowed by 25ft, and the web cannot be dispelled.

rankUpgrades.description: 35-foot storm deals 4d8 wyrd per round, and non-linked enemies entering become automatically linked to the web.
40-foot storm deals 5d8 wyrd per round, links all entrants, and enemies inside cannot take reactions.

spell.name: Searing Retort

Deals 2d8 ember damage, shreds 2 points of Armor, and inflicts Burning (1d4/rd for 2 rounds).

Enemies within 10 feet take 6 ember damage.

rankUpgrades.description: Bonus damage increases to +1d8 ember damage.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 3d10 ember damage and melts 3 points of Armor from all hit enemies.
Deals 4d8 ember damage, melts 3 Armor, and knocks targets Prone.

spell.name: Combustion Spear Resonance

spell.name: Pyrofiend Doctrine

rankUpgrades.description: Abilities increased by +2 flat magnitude.

Abilities increased by +4 flat magnitude.

spell.name: Unquenchable Core

rankUpgrades.description: You have become the surface itself: Reflective Barrier and Mirror Shield cost 10 fewer AEP to cast (minimum 5).

spell.name: Prismatic Shear
spell.description: Counter a spell being cast within 30 feet; when the caster fails their save, the shear lashes them for 2d8 arcane damage in addition to disrupting the spell.
spell.flavorText: The counter is also a blade. Filing paperwork with an edge.

rankUpgrades.description: Counter a spell being cast within 30 feet; when the caster fails their save, the shear lashes them for 4d8 arcane damage in addition to disrupting the spell.

spell.name: Perfect Mirror
spell.description: ULTIMATE: For 1 round, every spell targeting you or allies within 30 feet is reflected at its caster with double damage and full effects.
spell.flavorText: For one round, the enemy army is you.

spell.name: Mirror Mastery
spell.description: Every surface serves the doctrine: all reflected damage you deal is increased by +1d6 damage.
spell.flavorText: Angles within angles.

rankUpgrades.description: Every surface serves the doctrine: all reflected damage you deal is increased by +1d8 damage.
Every surface serves the doctrine: all reflected damage you deal is increased by +1d8 damage, and reflected damage splashes to one other enemy within 15 feet for 50% of the reflected damage.
Every surface serves the doctrine: all reflected damage you deal is increased by +2d8 damage.
Every surface serves the doctrine: all reflected damage you deal is increased by +2d8 damage, and reflected damage is doubled back against its original caster.

spell.name: Arcane Retribution
spell.description: Your wards die loudly: when one of your shields is destroyed, it detonates for 2d6 arcane damage to all enemies within 15 feet.
spell.flavorText: Breaking it was the easy part.

rankUpgrades.description: Your wards die loudly: when one of your shields is destroyed, it detonates for 3d6 arcane damage to all enemies within 15 feet.
Your wards die loudly: when one of your shields is destroyed, it detonates for 4d6 arcane damage to all enemies within 20 feet.

spell.name: Thousand Faces
spell.description: Split into 2 mirror images for 1 minute. Each image automatically dodges one spell targeted at you, then shatters, dealing 1d8 arcane damage to the caster.
spell.flavorText: Which of us cast the counter-spell? Wrong.

rankUpgrades.description: Split into 3 mirror images for 1 minute. Each image automatically dodges one spell targeted at you, then shatters, dealing 1d8 arcane damage to the caster.
Split into 4 mirror images for 1 minute. Each image automatically dodges one spell targeted at you, then shatters, dealing 2d8 arcane damage to the caster.

spell.name: Eternal Vigil
spell.description: You stand watch beyond exhaustion: your maximum AEP increases by 5.
spell.flavorText: Someone must remain facing the door.

rankUpgrades.description: You stand watch beyond exhaustion: your maximum AEP increases by 10.
You stand watch beyond exhaustion: your maximum AEP increases by 15, and your first counter or reflection each combat costs no AEP.

spell.name: Arcane Strike
spell.description: Channel stored AEP into your weapon: your next melee strike this turn deals an additional 1d6 arcane damage.
spell.flavorText: The reservoir also empties through the fist.

rankUpgrades.description: Channel stored AEP into your weapon: your next melee strike this turn deals an additional 2d6 arcane damage.
Channel stored AEP into your weapon: your next melee strike this turn deals an additional 2d6 arcane damage, refunding 2 AEP if it hits.

spell.name: Mana Vampirism
spell.description: Your weapon drinks as it cuts: each melee hit drains 1 mana from the target and heals you for 1 health.
spell.flavorText: Every caster is a wineskin with opinions.

rankUpgrades.description: Your weapon drinks as it cuts: each melee hit drains 2 mana from the target and heals you for 2 health.
Your weapon drinks as it cuts: each melee hit drains 3 mana from the target and heals you for 2 health.

spell.name: Reaver's Edge
spell.description: You know exactly where the magic keeps its purse: you gain +1 to hit on attacks against enemies with a mana pool.
spell.flavorText: Aim for where the spell was going to be.

rankUpgrades.description: You know exactly where the magic keeps its purse: you gain +2 to hit on attacks against enemies with a mana pool.

spell.name: Empowered Strike
spell.description: Dump the reservoir through the blade: spend 10 AEP to empower your next melee strike with an additional 3d6 arcane damage.
spell.flavorText: Overdraft approved.

rankUpgrades.description: Dump the reservoir through the blade: spend 15 AEP to empower your next melee strike with an additional 4d6 arcane damage.
Dump the reservoir through the blade: spend 20 AEP to empower your next melee strike with an additional 4d6 arcane damage.

spell.name: Siphoned Fury
spell.description: Stolen mana makes the blade eager: after you drain 5 or more mana in a turn, your next attack deals an additional 1d4 arcane damage.
