spell.flavorText: It is not anger. It is inventory.

rankUpgrades.description: Stolen mana makes the blade eager: after you drain 5 or more mana in a turn, your next attack deals an additional 1d6 arcane damage.
Stolen mana makes the blade eager: after you drain 5 or more mana in a turn, your next attack deals an additional 1d8 arcane damage.

spell.name: Overcharge
spell.description: Tear the siphon open: your mana drains pull 1 additional mana, but you take 1 arcane damage each time you drain.
spell.flavorText: The engine does not care about the hose.

rankUpgrades.description: Tear the siphon open: your mana drains pull 2 additional mana, but you take 1 arcane damage each time you drain.
Tear the siphon open: your mana drains pull 3 additional mana with no cost to you.

spell.name: Wicked Draft
spell.description: What you take, you spoil: enemies you drain mana from take 1 arcane damage for every 2 mana drained.
spell.flavorText: Drink rudely.

rankUpgrades.description: What you take, you spoil: enemies you drain mana from take 1 arcane damage for every 1 mana drained.
What you take, you spoil: enemies you drain mana from take 2 arcane damage for every 1 mana drained.

spell.name: Energy Surge
spell.description: Crack the reservoir open in reverse: spend 15 AEP to instantly restore 20 mana.
spell.flavorText: Conservation is for people with fewer options.

rankUpgrades.description: Crack the reservoir open in reverse: spend 15 AEP to instantly restore 30 mana.

spell.name: Arcane Combustion
spell.description: Overloaded targets detonate: when you kill an enemy with a melee attack, it erupts for 2d6 arcane damage to all enemies within 10 feet.
spell.flavorText: The last thing it exports is force.

rankUpgrades.description: Overloaded targets detonate: when you kill an enemy with a melee attack, it erupts for 3d6 arcane damage to all enemies within 10 feet.
Overloaded targets detonate: when you kill an enemy with a melee attack, it erupts for 4d6 arcane damage to all enemies within 15 feet.

spell.name: Spell Theft
spell.description: Why learn when you can take: steal 1 prepared spell from a target you have drained this combat. You may cast it once within 1 minute before it dissolves.
spell.flavorText: Signed, unwitnessed, yours.

rankUpgrades.description: Why learn when you can take: steal 2 prepared spells from a target you have drained this combat. You may cast each once within 1 minute before they dissolve.

spell.name: Vampiric Empowerment
spell.description: The drinking sharpens you: after you have drained 10 or more mana this combat, you gain +1 to hit on melee attacks.
spell.flavorText: Fluid in, fangs out.

rankUpgrades.description: The drinking sharpens you: after you have drained 10 or more mana this combat, you gain +1 to hit and +2 damage on melee attacks.
The drinking sharpens you: after you have drained 10 or more mana this combat, you gain +2 to hit and +4 damage on melee attacks.

spell.name: Mana Rend
spell.description: Tear the well out entirely: drain all mana from a target within 30 feet (up to 30), gain 5 AEP for every 10 mana drained, and leave the target unable to cast for 1 minute.
spell.flavorText: Not a wound. A repossession.

spell.name: Leech Ward
spell.description: Sheathe yourself in stolen current for 3 rounds: 25 points of the mana you drain is also converted into an arcane shield absorbing up to 10 damage.
spell.flavorText: The levy flows both ways.

rankUpgrades.description: Sheathe yourself in stolen current for 3 rounds: 40 points of the mana you drain is also converted into an arcane shield absorbing up to 25 damage.

spell.name: Hungering Blade
spell.description: The steel has learned to sip on its own: Arcane Strike and Empowered Strike also drain 2 mana from the target on hit.
spell.flavorText: Feed the weapon and the weapon feeds you.

rankUpgrades.description: The steel has learned to sip on its own: Arcane Strike and Empowered Strike also drain 4 mana from the target on hit.

spell.name: Aether Reaper
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Harvest the field entire: drain 20 mana from every enemy within 30 feet, deal 3d6 arcane damage to each, gain 2 AEP for every 10 mana drained, and gain +2 to hit for 1 minute.
spell.flavorText: The scythe does not distinguish between wells.

spell.name: Deep Siphon
spell.description: The siphon finds deeper veins: all mana you drain is increased by 1.
spell.flavorText: Pump harder. The well is lying about being empty.

rankUpgrades.description: The siphon finds deeper veins: all mana you drain is increased by 2.
The siphon finds deeper veins: all mana you drain is increased by 3.
The siphon finds deeper veins: all mana you drain is increased by 4.
The siphon finds deeper veins: all mana you drain is increased by 5, and each drain also restores 1 health.

spell.name: Arcane Hunger
spell.description: What flows in does not leave: each time you drain mana, you gain 1 AEP.
spell.flavorText: The hunger is a ledger, and it always balances.

rankUpgrades.description: What flows in does not leave: each time you drain mana, you gain 2 AEP.
What flows in does not leave: each time you drain mana, you gain 3 AEP.

spell.name: Reaver's Momentum
spell.description: Drinking puts speed in the blood: after you drain mana, you gain +15 points movement speed for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: Somewhere to be, someone to empty.

rankUpgrades.description: Drinking puts speed in the blood: after you drain mana, you gain +25 points movement speed for 1 round.
Drinking puts speed in the blood: after you drain mana, you gain +25 points movement speed and +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability for 1 round.

spell.name: Reservoir Bloom
spell.description: The well widens to match the thirst: your maximum AEP increases by 5.
spell.flavorText: Capacity is a kind of appetite.

rankUpgrades.description: The well widens to match the thirst: your maximum AEP increases by 10.
The well widens to match the thirst: your maximum AEP increases by 15, and drained mana restores 1 health per 5 mana taken.

spell.name: Envenomed Edge
spell.description: Passive: Your weapon attacks deal +1d4 additional blight damage and apply a mild toxin for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: You stopped needing an apothecary years ago. You are one.

rankUpgrades.description: Weapon attacks deal +1d6 additional blight damage.
Weapon attacks deal +1d8 additional blight damage, and when you take melee damage, your attacker suffers 1d4 blight backlash.

spell.name: Venom Channels
spell.description: Passive: Blight and poison damage-over-time effects you apply deal +1 additional blight damage per tick.
spell.flavorText: Plumbing, but for murder.

rankUpgrades.description: Blight damage-over-time effects deal +2 additional blight damage per tick.
Blight damage-over-time effects deal +3 additional blight damage per tick and last 1 extra round.

spell.name: Paralytic Tincture
spell.description: Passive: Enemies affected by your toxins suffer -1 to their attack rolls and dexterity saving throws.
spell.flavorText: The mind is just another organ with a tolerance threshold.

rankUpgrades.description: Enemies affected by your toxins suffer -2 to attack rolls and dexterity saves.

spell.name: Hemotoxin Needle
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Hurl a venom-coated needle at a target within 40 feet dealing 1d8 blight damage and inflicting Poisoned (1d4 blight/rd for 2 rounds).
spell.flavorText: Why roll dice when the blood does the work?

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d6 initial blight damage; Poisoned deals 1d6 per round.
Deals 2d8 initial blight damage; Poisoned deals 1d8 per round and reduces target healing received by 3.

spell.name: Metabolic Drain
spell.description: Passive: When you hit a poisoned enemy, restore 2 Hit Points and reduce the target's movement speed by 5 feet.
spell.flavorText: Their vital fluids replenish your own stamina.

rankUpgrades.description: Restores 4 Hit Points and reduces target speed by 10 feet.
Restores 6 Hit Points, reduces target speed by 10 feet, and grants you +5 feet movement speed for 1 round.

spell.name: Noxious Cloud
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Shatter a vial creating a 15-foot cloud of toxic vapor within 45 feet for 2 rounds. Enemies inside take 2d6 blight damage upon entering or ending their turn inside.
spell.flavorText: Hold your breath. Not that it will help.

rankUpgrades.description: Cloud deals 2d8 blight damage and obscures vision.
Cloud deals 3d6 blight damage, obscures vision, and enemies inside must succeed on a Fortitude save or become Dazed for 1 round.

spell.name: Virulent Spores
spell.description: Passive: When an enemy dies while affected by your toxins, they release a spore cloud dealing 1d6 blight damage to all enemies within 10 feet.
spell.flavorText: The body expires, but the venom lives on.

rankUpgrades.description: Spore cloud deals 1d8 blight damage and applies Poisoned.
Spore cloud deals 2d6 blight damage, applies Poisoned, and refunds 1 AP if 2 or more enemies are struck.

spell.name: Terminal Dosage
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Strike a poisoned enemy in melee, detonating all toxin stacks within their body for 2d10 blight damage and Staggering them for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The final drop that tips the vial.

rankUpgrades.description: Terminal Dosage gains +1d6 bonus damage and refunds 1 AP on critical hits.

spell.name: Viper Reflexes
spell.description: Passive: Your weapon attacks gain +1 to hit against poisoned enemies, and your Opportunity Attacks inflict Poisoned.
spell.flavorText: Faster than the eye, deadlier than the bite.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +2 to hit against poisoned targets and +10 feet movement speed.
Gain +2 to hit, +10 feet speed, and critical hits with melee weapons inflict Paralysis for 1 round.

spell.name: Immunological Ruin
spell.description: Passive: Enemies affected by your toxins have their Damage Reduction reduced by 2 and cannot benefit from regeneration.
spell.flavorText: Stripping the body's natural defenses cell by cell.

rankUpgrades.description: Enemy Damage Reduction is reduced by 4, and their saving throws against spells are reduced by 1.

spell.name: Plague Mist Eruption
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Release a 25-foot cone of virulent neurotoxin dealing 3d8 blight damage and forcing all enemies hit to roll a Fortitude save or be Blinded for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: A green shroud that rots the senses.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 3d10 blight damage, Blinds for 1 round, and leaves lingering mist for 2 rounds.
Deals 4d8 blight damage, Blinds, and poisoned enemies in the cone take an extra 1d8 blight damage.

spell.name: Terminal Dosage Resonance
spell.description: Passive: Your class abilities deal +1d4 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource when below half health.
spell.flavorText: Focus sharpens under the pressure of battle.

rankUpgrades.description: Class abilities deal +1d6 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource.
Class abilities deal +1d8 bonus damage, cost 1 less resource, and grant +1 to hit.

spell.name: Unyielding Resolve
spell.description: Passive: You gain +1 Damage Reduction against all attacks and advantage on saving throws against stun and fear.
spell.flavorText: Standing immovable against the onslaught.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +2 Damage Reduction against all attacks and immunity to fear.

spell.name: Avatar of the Viper
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 2 AP: For 2 rounds, all your attacks apply maximum toxin stacks, your blight damage ignores all enemy Poison/Blight resistance, and whenever an enemy takes poison damage, you heal for 3 Hit Points.
spell.flavorText: You are the serpent at the root of the world.

spell.name: Toxicologist Doctrine
spell.description: Passive: All damage and healing dealt by your Toxicologist abilities is increased by +1 flat magnitude.
spell.flavorText: The foundational principles of your path, mastered completely.

rankUpgrades.description: Abilities increased by +2 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +3 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +4 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +5 flat magnitude and +1d4 bonus damage on critical hits.

spell.name: Miasma Heart
spell.description: Passive: You are completely immune to Poison, Blight, and Disease, and whenever you are targeted by a healing spell, you gain +3 bonus Hit Points.
spell.flavorText: Your blood is acid. Disease cannot survive inside you.

rankUpgrades.description: Miasma Heart rank 2: resource generation +1 and +5ft speed.
Miasma Heart rank 3: resource generation +2 and +1 to hit.

spell.name: Catalytic Shock
spell.description: Passive: When you score a critical hit on a poisoned target, shockwaves of toxin deal 2d8 blight damage to all other enemies within 15 feet.
spell.flavorText: The reaction accelerates until the surrounding air rots.

rankUpgrades.description: Catalytic Shock rank 2: +2 Damage Reduction and +10 max HP.
Catalytic Shock rank 3: +2 Damage Reduction, +15 max HP, and immunity to prone.

spell.name: Transcendent Precision
spell.description: Passive: All critical strikes deal +1d6 bonus damage and restore 1d4 Hit Points.
spell.flavorText: Striking the exact pressure point between life and death.

rankUpgrades.description: Transcendent Precision rank 2: crits deal +1d8 bonus damage and heal for 1d6.
Transcendent Precision rank 3: crits deal +2d6 bonus damage and heal for 1d8.

spell.name: Spring Snare
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Deploy a concealed spring snare on a space within 30 feet. When an enemy steps on it, deals 1d6 piercing damage and Immobilizes them for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: Some assembly required. Not much.

rankUpgrades.description: Snare deals 1d8 piercing damage and reduces target Armor by 1.
Snare deals 2d6 piercing damage and can be deployed up to 40 feet away.

spell.name: Spring Armature
spell.description: Passive: Your throw range for all grenades, vials, and deployables increases by 10 feet.
spell.flavorText: Mechanical leverage makes every throw effortless.

rankUpgrades.description: Throw range increases by 15 feet.
Throw range increases by 20 feet, and retrieving items from inventory costs 0 AP once per turn.

spell.name: Reinforced Bracing
spell.description: Passive: You gain +1 Armor and 2 Damage Reduction against area hazards and environmental damage.
spell.flavorText: Brass and riveted steel between you and catastrophe.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +2 Armor and 3 Damage Reduction against area hazards.

spell.name: Alchemical Smoke
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Hurl a smoke canister up to 35 feet creating a 15-foot obscured zone for 2 rounds. Creatures inside have +2 Defense against ranged attacks.
spell.flavorText: Opaque zinc clouds to confuse target acquisition.

rankUpgrades.description: Smoke zone expands to 20 feet and allies inside gain +3 Defense against ranged attacks.
Smoke zone also inflicts -2 to hit on enemy attacks originating from inside.

spell.name: Miniature Turret
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Deploy a miniature tripod turret within 25 feet for 2 rounds. At the end of each turn, it fires a needle at the nearest enemy for 1d6 piercing damage.
spell.flavorText: Clockwork vigilance never blinks.

rankUpgrades.description: Turret needles deal 1d8 piercing damage and range increases to 35 feet.
Turret needles deal 2d6 piercing damage and apply a poison dealing 1d4 blight damage.

spell.name: Flashbang Grenade
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Hurl a magnesium concussion bomb up to 35 feet. Deals 2d6 sonic damage in a 15-foot radius and Dazes targets for 1 round on a failed Reflex save.
spell.flavorText: A burst of blinding light and eardrum-splitting force.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d8 sonic damage and forces targets to drop 1 rank of weapon guard on failed save.
Deals 3d6 sonic damage, Blinds targets for 1 round, and interrupts spell channels.

spell.name: Pneumatic Thrusters
spell.description: Passive: Your movement speed increases by 10 feet, and you can Disengage as a free reaction once per combat encounter.
spell.flavorText: Steam-assisted footwork.

rankUpgrades.description: Movement speed increases by 15 feet and jump distance is doubled.
Movement speed increases by 15 feet, and you ignore all non-magical difficult terrain.

spell.name: Grapnel Winch
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Fire a high-tension steel cable up to 40 feet. Pull yourself immediately to an unoccupied location or pull an ally out of danger to your side.
spell.flavorText: Physics, expedited.

rankUpgrades.description: Grapnel Winch gains +1d6 bonus damage and refunds 1 AP on critical hits.

spell.name: Claymore Mine
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Plant a directional claymore trap. When an enemy approaches within 10 feet, it discharges a 15-foot cone dealing 2d8 piercing damage and knocking targets Prone.
spell.flavorText: Front toward enemy.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d10 piercing damage and shreds 2 points of Armor.
Deals 3d8 piercing damage, shreds 3 Armor, and Pins targets to the ground for 1 round.

spell.name: Clockwork Exoskeleton
spell.description: Passive: You gain +2 to Strength checks and saving throws, and your carrying capacity and weapon strike damage increase by +1d4 bludgeoning.
spell.flavorText: Hydro-pneumatic pistons augment every muscle twitch.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +3 to Strength checks/saves and weapon strike damage increases by +1d6 bludgeoning.

spell.name: Deployable Automaton
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Deploy a brass automaton within 15 feet for 3 rounds (25 HP, +2 Armor). It intercepts attacks meant for nearby allies and attacks adjacent foes for 2d6 bludgeoning damage each round.
spell.flavorText: A walking fortress in miniature.

rankUpgrades.description: Automaton has 35 HP, deals 2d8 damage, and Taunts adjacent enemies.
Automaton has 45 HP, deals 3d6 damage, and explodes for 3d8 fire damage upon destruction.

spell.name: Grapnel Winch Resonance
spell.description: Passive: Your class abilities deal +1d4 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource when below half health.
spell.flavorText: Focus sharpens under the pressure of battle.

rankUpgrades.description: Class abilities deal +1d6 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource.
Class abilities deal +1d8 bonus damage, cost 1 less resource, and grant +1 to hit.

spell.name: Unyielding Resolve
spell.description: Passive: You gain +1 Damage Reduction against all attacks and advantage on saving throws against stun and fear.
spell.flavorText: Standing immovable against the onslaught.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +2 Damage Reduction against all attacks and immunity to fear.

spell.name: Grand Mechanist Overdrive
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 2 AP: For 2 rounds, all your traps, turrets, and gadgets cost 0 AP to deploy, trigger immediately upon deployment, and your turrets fire twice per round.
spell.flavorText: Total mechanical synergy. Every gear turns in ruthless precision.

spell.name: Toxicologist Doctrine
spell.description: Passive: All damage and healing dealt by your Toxicologist abilities is increased by +1 flat magnitude.
spell.flavorText: The foundational principles of your path, mastered completely.

rankUpgrades.description: Abilities increased by +2 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +3 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +4 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +5 flat magnitude and +1d4 bonus damage on critical hits.

spell.name: Salvage Protocol
spell.description: Passive: When any trap, turret, or automaton expires or is destroyed, restore 6 Hit Points and gain 1 Action Point on your next turn.
spell.flavorText: No spare part goes to waste.

rankUpgrades.description: Salvage Protocol rank 2: resource generation +1 and +5ft speed.
Salvage Protocol rank 3: resource generation +2 and +1 to hit.

spell.name: Tungsten Munitions
spell.description: Passive: All your gadget, turret, and weapon physical damage bypasses up to 4 points of Armor and ignores physical damage reduction.
spell.flavorText: Dense tungsten cores punched through plate like paper.

rankUpgrades.description: Tungsten Munitions rank 2: +2 Damage Reduction and +10 max HP.
Tungsten Munitions rank 3: +2 Damage Reduction, +15 max HP, and immunity to prone.

spell.name: Transcendent Precision
spell.description: Passive: All critical strikes deal +1d6 bonus damage and restore 1d4 Hit Points.
spell.flavorText: Striking the exact pressure point between life and death.

rankUpgrades.description: Transcendent Precision rank 2: crits deal +1d8 bonus damage and heal for 1d6.
Transcendent Precision rank 3: crits deal +2d6 bonus damage and heal for 1d8.

spell.name: Vitriol Flask
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Hurl a flask of concentrated vitriol up to 40 feet dealing 1d8 acid damage and melting 1 point of enemy Armor for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: It eats through iron, flesh, and stone without prejudice.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d6 acid damage and shreds 2 points of Armor.
Deals 2d8 acid damage, shreds 2 points of Armor, and splashes 1d4 acid damage to adjacent foes.

spell.name: Caustic Coating
spell.description: Passive: Your weapon attacks deal +1d4 acid damage and degrade enemy Armor by 1 for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: A thin film of acid on the blade ensures the cut keeps widening.

rankUpgrades.description: Weapon attacks deal +1d6 acid damage.
Weapon attacks deal +1d8 acid damage and ignore up to 2 points of Armor.

spell.name: Demolition Insight
spell.description: Passive: You gain +1 to hit against armored enemies and constructs, and your attacks deal +2 flat damage to objects and barriers.
spell.flavorText: Find the structural fault, insert the wedge, light the fuse.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +2 to hit against armored targets, and +4 flat damage to objects and barriers.

spell.name: Breaching Charge
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Plant an explosive charge on a foe or structure within 30 feet. Detonates for 2d6 bludgeoning + 1d4 fire damage and knocks targets Prone on a failed Fortitude save.
spell.flavorText: Doors, shields, ribs — everything yields under directional blast.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d8 bludgeoning + 1d6 fire damage and shreds 2 Armor.
Deals 3d6 bludgeoning + 1d8 fire damage, shreds 3 Armor, and destroys partial cover in a 10-foot radius.

spell.name: Acid Trap
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Lay a pressurized acid canister up to 30 feet away. When triggered, sprays a 10-foot radius dealing 1d8 acid damage and reducing enemy movement speed by 10 feet for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Stepping into a puddle that boils your boots.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d6 acid damage and reduces enemy Armor by 2.
Deals 2d8 acid damage, reduces Armor by 3, and acid pools on the ground for 2 rounds.

spell.name: Vitriol Torrent
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Spray a 20-foot cone of boiling acid dealing 2d6 acid damage to all enemies and reducing their Armor by 2 for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: A deluge that strips polish, paint, and flesh.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 2d8 acid damage and melts 3 Armor.
Deals 3d6 acid damage, melts 3 Armor, and inflicts Burning Acid (1d6/rd for 2 rounds).

spell.name: Ablative Slag Plating
spell.description: Passive: When an enemy strikes you with a melee weapon, their weapon is corroded, suffering -1 to hit and -1 damage for 2 rounds (stacks up to 3 times).
spell.flavorText: Every blow they land ruins their own equipment.

rankUpgrades.description: Enemy suffers -2 to hit upon striking you in melee.
Enemy suffers -2 to hit and takes 1d6 acid backlash when striking you.

spell.name: Thermite Core Bomb
spell.description: Spend 1 AP: Hurl a white-hot thermite incendiary within 40 feet. Detonates in a 15-foot radius dealing 2d10 ember + acid damage, completely melting all enemy temporary hit point shields and shredding 3 Armor.
spell.flavorText: Thermite burns underwater, underground, and through dragon scale.

rankUpgrades.description: Thermite Core Bomb gains +1d6 bonus damage and refunds 1 AP on critical hits.

spell.name: Caustic Fumes
spell.description: Passive: All your acid attacks leave lingering toxic fumes. Enemies that take acid damage suffer +1d4 bonus acid damage on the next attack that hits them.
spell.flavorText: The flesh is softened, ready to receive the next strike.

rankUpgrades.description: Bonus damage increases to +1d6 acid.
Bonus damage increases to +1d8 acid, and affects all damage types.

spell.name: Structural Shatter
spell.description: Passive: Critical hits with your weapons or explosives reduce target Armor to 0 for 1 round and inflict Stagger.
spell.flavorText: When the load-bearing pillar crumbles, the whole structure follows.

rankUpgrades.description: Critical hits also knock the target Prone and deal +1d8 bonus damage.

spell.name: Obliteration Payload
spell.description: Spend 2 AP: Launch a massive canister containing dual chambers of acid and explosive nitro up to 45 feet. Deals 3d8 acid + 1d8 fire damage (4d8 total) in a 25-foot radius and shatters all cover.
spell.flavorText: No walls, no barricades, no survivors.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 4d10 total damage and leaves acid pool for 2 rounds.
Deals 5d8 total damage, destroys all terrain obstacles, and knocks all enemies Prone.

spell.name: Thermite Core Bomb Resonance
spell.description: Passive: Your class abilities deal +1d4 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource when below half health.
spell.flavorText: Focus sharpens under the pressure of battle.

rankUpgrades.description: Class abilities deal +1d6 bonus damage and cost 1 less resource.
Class abilities deal +1d8 bonus damage, cost 1 less resource, and grant +1 to hit.

spell.name: Unyielding Resolve
spell.description: Passive: You gain +1 Damage Reduction against all attacks and advantage on saving throws against stun and fear.
spell.flavorText: Standing immovable against the onslaught.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain +2 Damage Reduction against all attacks and immunity to fear.

spell.name: Master of Cataclysm
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Spend 2 AP: For 2 rounds, all your acid and explosive damage completely ignores enemy Armor and Damage Reduction, and 50% of single-target explosive damage splashes to all enemies within 15 feet.
spell.flavorText: Engineering turned entirely to the art of absolute ruin.

spell.name: Toxicologist Doctrine
spell.description: Passive: All damage and healing dealt by your Toxicologist abilities is increased by +1 flat magnitude.
spell.flavorText: The foundational principles of your path, mastered completely.

rankUpgrades.description: Abilities increased by +2 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +3 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +4 flat magnitude.
Abilities increased by +5 flat magnitude and +1d4 bonus damage on critical hits.

spell.name: Chain Detonation
spell.description: Passive: When an enemy dies from acid or explosive damage, they detonate for 2d8 acid damage to all adjacent enemies, shredding 2 Armor.
spell.flavorText: Their own armor supplies the shrapnel.

rankUpgrades.description: Chain Detonation rank 2: resource generation +1 and +5ft speed.
Chain Detonation rank 3: resource generation +2 and +1 to hit.

spell.name: Impervious Hazmat Suit
spell.description: Passive: You are immune to Acid and Fire damage, and you take zero friendly-fire or self-damage from your own explosives.
spell.flavorText: Tested against every chemical known to mortal alchemy.

rankUpgrades.description: Impervious Hazmat Suit rank 2: +2 Damage Reduction and +10 max HP.
Impervious Hazmat Suit rank 3: +2 Damage Reduction, +15 max HP, and immunity to prone.

spell.name: Transcendent Precision
spell.description: Passive: All critical strikes deal +1d6 bonus damage and restore 1d4 Hit Points.
spell.flavorText: Striking the exact pressure point between life and death.

rankUpgrades.description: Transcendent Precision rank 2: crits deal +1d8 bonus damage and heal for 1d6.
Transcendent Precision rank 3: crits deal +2d6 bonus damage and heal for 1d8.

spell.name: Vengeful Pursuit
spell.description: Mark a target within 60 feet for 1 minute: your successful attacks against the marked target generate +1 VP.
spell.flavorText: The mark is a debt. You always collect.

rankUpgrades.description: Mark a target within 60 feet for 1 minute: your attacks against the marked target generate +2 VP.
Mark a target within 90 feet for 1 minute: your attacks against the marked target generate +2 VP, and VP builds 50 points faster against marks.

spell.name: Shadow Stalker
spell.description: You can hide as 1 Action Point even after attacking, and stealth attacks generate +2 VP instead of +1.
spell.flavorText: The shadow was here first. You are just using it.

rankUpgrades.description: You can hide as 1 Action Point even after attacking; stealth attacks generate +2 VP, and marked targets cannot detect you through blindsight or tremorsense.
You can hide as a free action once per turn after attacking; stealth attacks generate +3 VP, and marks cannot detect you through any sense.

spell.name: Precision Strike
spell.description: Spend 1 VP: your crit range expands to 19-20 against your marked target for one attack. On a crit, regain 1 VP.
spell.flavorText: One vein. One window. One strike.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 1 VP: your crit range expands to 18-20 against your marked target for one attack; on a crit, regain 2 VP.

spell.name: Predator Strike
spell.description: Attacks against marked targets crit on 19-20. When you critically strike a marked target, teleport 10 feet to any enemy within 30 feet.
spell.flavorText: The herd never sees the second strike coming.

rankUpgrades.description: Attacks against marked targets crit on 19-20; critical strikes let you teleport 20 feet, and the arrival strike is made with advantage.
Attacks against marks crit on 18-20; crits let you teleport 30 feet, and each teleport strike deals +2d6 slicing damage.

spell.name: Death Mark
spell.description: When your marked target dies, instantly gain 2 VP and mark a new target as a free action. Once per round.
spell.flavorText: The list is never finished. It is only ever current.

rankUpgrades.description: When your marked target dies, gain 3 VP, mark a new target freely, and your first attack on the new mark has advantage. Once per round.
When your marked target dies, gain 3 VP, mark a new target freely with advantage, and gain 5 temporary health. Once per round.

spell.name: Unseen Executioner
spell.description: Marked targets below half health suffer +1d6 bonus damage from your attacks. When you kill a marked target, you may hide as 1 Action Point.
spell.flavorText: Half health is a eulogy in progress.

rankUpgrades.description: Marked targets below half health suffer +1d6 bonus damage from your attacks; killing a marked target lets you hide as a free action.
Marked targets below half health suffer +1d6 bonus damage from your attacks; marked kills grant a free hide and your next stealth attack scores a critical hit on 19-20.

spell.name: Execution Strike
spell.description: Spend 4 VP to attempt an execution on a target below half maximum Hit Points: the target must pass a Constitution save or take triple damage.
spell.flavorText: The paperwork says 'attempt'. The blade says otherwise.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 4 VP to attempt an execution on a target below half maximum Hit Points: Constitution save or take triple damage; a failed save also silences them for 1 round.
Spend 4 VP: execute a target below half maximum Hit Points — Constitution save or take QUADRUPLE damage and be silenced for 1 round. A successful save still takes double damage.

spell.name: Deadly Precision
spell.description: Your attacks against marked targets ignore half and three-quarters cover, and marked targets have disadvantage on saves against your abilities.
spell.flavorText: Cover is a rumor spread by survivors.

rankUpgrades.description: Your attacks against marks ignore ALL cover, and marked targets save against your abilities with disadvantage.
Attacks against marks ignore all cover, marks save with disadvantage AND cannot benefit from durability above 16 against you.

spell.name: Shadow Step
spell.description: Spend 1 VP: teleport 30 feet to a shadowed or dim location you can see. Your next attack within 1 round is made with advantage.
spell.flavorText: Distance is a courtesy you no longer observe.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 1 VP: teleport 60 feet to any shadowed location; your next attack within 1 round has advantage and deals +2d6 blight damage.

spell.name: Hunter's Instinct
spell.description: You always know where the mark is. Your marked target is visible to you through walls, darkness, and invisibility.
spell.flavorText: There is no 'away' to get to.

rankUpgrades.description: You always know where the mark is: visible through walls, darkness, and invisibility, and they cannot benefit from concealment against you.
The mark is laid bare: visible through everything, no concealment, and you gain +2 to attack rolls against marks in dim light or darkness.

spell.name: Apex Hunter
spell.description: While you hold 8 or more VP, your attacks against marked targets deal +1d6 bonus damage, and you may spend 2 VP to make a follow-up attack as a reaction when hit.
spell.flavorText: At the top of the food chain, every meal is a reaction.

rankUpgrades.description: While at 8+ VP, attacks against marks deal +1d8 bonus damage and your follow-up reaction attack costs 1 VP; killing blows below half health refund 2 VP.

spell.name: Quiver of Debts
spell.description: Every arrow remembers a name. Your ranged attacks against unmarked enemies deal +1d6 blight damage, and killing an unmarked enemy grants 1 VP.
spell.flavorText: The unmarked are simply not yet filed.

spell.name: Ghost Protocol
spell.description: Breaking sight is second nature. When an enemy targets you with an attack while you are hidden, you may spend 2 VP to become untargetable until the attack resolves.
spell.flavorText: Attacking a ghost is a scheduling problem.

spell.name: Shadowblade Ascendant
spell.description: Become a shadow entity for 1 minute: all your attacks are silent, you phase through walls and creatures, your attacks deal +4d6 blight damage, and your marked target cannot escape — teleporting with them if they flee. Costs all current VP (minimum 5).
spell.flavorText: The Warden stops walking and starts arriving.

spell.name: Vein Reader
spell.description: You see the anatomy of weakness. Your attacks against marked targets ignore 3 of the target's durability.
spell.flavorText: Everyone has a map. Yours is circled.

rankUpgrades.description: You see the anatomy of weakness. Attacks against marked targets ignore 5 durability, and your critical hits against marks ignore durability entirely.

spell.name: Shadow Requiem
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Mark up to 3 targets simultaneously for 1 minute. While in Shadowblade Ascendant, each attack against a marked target chains to your other marks at 50 points damage, and each mark that dies during the Requiem immediately refunds 3 VP and extends the Ascendant form by 1 round.
spell.flavorText: One requiem, several names, no encores.

spell.name: Eternal Hunt
spell.description: The hunt outlives the hunter's fatigue. Your maximum VP increases by 1.
spell.flavorText: The debt ledger gains a page.

rankUpgrades.description: The hunt outlives the hunter's fatigue. Your maximum VP increases by 2.
The hunt outlives the hunter's fatigue. Your maximum VP increases by 3.
The hunt outlives the hunter's fatigue. Your maximum VP increases by 4.
The hunt outlives the hunter's fatigue. Your maximum VP increases by 5, and VP decays only every other round.

spell.name: Silent Takedown
spell.description: Kills made from stealth leave no trace: no death cry, no body discovery, and witnesses must pass a Perception check to notice anything happened.
spell.flavorText: The room stays polite. The headcount changes.

rankUpgrades.description: Stealth kills are perfectly silent and invisible; witnesses need a Perception check at disadvantage, and failed witnesses cannot raise alarm for 1 round.
Stealth kills erase the victim from notice for 1 full round — allies of the dead simply continue as if nothing happened, then must save to realize.

spell.name: Blood Ledger
spell.description: Every name crossed out pays interest. Each enemy killed by your attacks grants you +5 points damage for 1 minute (stacks up to 5 times).
spell.flavorText: Accounting, aggressive edition.

rankUpgrades.description: Each enemy killed grants +8 points damage for 1 minute (max 6 stacks).
Each kill grants +10 points damage and +1 VP for 1 minute (max 8 stacks); at full stacks your attacks against marks cannot miss.

spell.name: Predator's Memory
spell.description: You have hunted everything once. Your marks never benefit from resistances against your attacks.
spell.flavorText: You remember where each of them keeps their weakness.

rankUpgrades.description: You have hunted everything once. Marks never benefit from resistance, and their immunities count as resistance against you.
You have hunted everything once. Marks get no resistance, immunities degrade to resistance, and your Execution Strike works on creatures immune to execution.

spell.name: Cage of Vengeance
spell.description: Conjure a spectral prison around an enemy within 60 feet for 2 rounds: the caged enemy is restrained, takes +1d6 damage from all sources, and has disadvantage on escape attempts. Costs 6 VP.
spell.flavorText: The sentence is short. The point is made.

rankUpgrades.description: Conjure a spectral prison around an enemy within 60 feet for 3 rounds: restrained, +2d6 damage from all sources, disadvantage on escapes. Costs 6 VP.
Conjure a spectral prison around an enemy within 90 feet for 3 rounds: restrained, +3d6 damage from all sources, disadvantage on escapes, no teleportation. Costs 5 VP.

spell.name: Spectral Warden
spell.description: The prison's architecture improves with use. Cage of Vengeance costs 1 less VP, and your VP decay occurs only every 2 turns instead of every turn.
spell.flavorText: A tidy cell block is a calm mind.

rankUpgrades.description: The prison's architecture improves with use. Cage of Vengeance costs 2 less VP, and VP decays every 3 turns.
The prison's architecture improves with use. Cage of Vengeance costs 3 less VP, VP decays every 3 turns, and caged enemies grant you 1 VP per round.

spell.name: Mass Confinement
spell.description: Spend 8 VP: cage all enemies in a 20-foot radius within 60 feet — each cage lasts 2 rounds at reduced strength (restrained, no damage amplification).
spell.flavorText: Group sentencing. Very efficient.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 8 VP: cage all enemies in a 30-foot radius within 60 feet for 3 rounds — full-strength cages (restrained, +1d6 damage taken).

spell.name: Cage Torment
spell.description: The Ordu ancestor-mounds teach eternal vigilance. Caged enemies take 1d8 blight damage at the start of each of their turns while caged.
spell.flavorText: The bars grind on a schedule.

rankUpgrades.description: The Ordu ancestor-mounds teach eternal vigilance. Caged enemies take 2d8 blight damage at the start of each of their turns.
The Ordu ancestor-mounds teach eternal vigilance. Caged enemies take 3d8 blight damage per turn, and each tick generates 1 VP.

spell.name: Enhanced Caging
spell.description: Your cages are built to last. Cage of Vengeance lasts 1 additional round, caged enemies cannot teleport or plane shift, and you may spend 1 VP to extend any cage by 1 round.
spell.flavorText: Escape is a design flaw. We fixed it.

rankUpgrades.description: Your cages are built to last. Cages last 2 additional rounds, block teleportation, and may be extended by 1 VP per round indefinitely.
Your cages are built to last. Cages last 3 additional rounds, block teleportation, extend freely by VP, and caged enemies cannot be freed by allies.

spell.name: Isolation Protocol
spell.description: The cage cuts both ways. Caged enemies cannot be targeted by their allies' spells or abilities; allies who try take 2d6 arcane backlash damage.
spell.flavorText: Visiting hours are heavily contested.

rankUpgrades.description: The cage cuts both ways. Caged enemies cannot be buffed or healed by allies; would-be rescuers take 3d6 arcane backlash.
The cage cuts both ways. Caged enemies are fully isolated (no targeting, no buffs, no healing); rescuers take 4d6 arcane backlash and are themselves caged on a failed save.

spell.name: Prison Complex
spell.description: You run a full block. You can maintain up to 3 cages simultaneously, and caged enemies within 20 feet of each other share damage — damage to one is split among all caged enemies.
spell.flavorText: The cells are connected. That is the punishment.

rankUpgrades.description: You run a full block. Maintain up to 4 cages; caged enemies within 30 feet share damage, and shared damage counts as damage to each for amplification purposes.
You run a full block. Maintain up to 5 cages; all caged enemies share damage within 40 feet, and when one cage breaks, its remaining torment detonates for 3d6 blight in that cage's space.

spell.name: Execution Chamber
spell.description: Spend 6 VP to convert a cage into an execution chamber for 3 rounds: the caged enemy takes double damage from all sources and cannot be healed.
spell.flavorText: The room's purpose is in the name.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 6 VP to convert a cage into an execution chamber for 3 rounds: double damage from all sources, no healing, no saves.
Spend 6 VP: the execution chamber deals TRIPLE damage, blocks healing and teleportation, and caged enemies' allies who witness it have disadvantage on their next roll.

spell.name: Spectral Overlord
spell.description: Your cages become immune to dispel magic, and caged enemies generate VP for you equal to half the damage they take. You may teleport between your cages as 1 Action Point.
spell.flavorText: Warden of a growing estate.

rankUpgrades.description: Your cages are dispel-proof, caged enemies generate VP equal to ALL damage they take, and teleporting between cages is a free action that refunds 1 VP.

spell.name: Iron Bars
spell.description: The whole prison tightens. Caged enemies have disadvantage on ALL saves, and caged creatures cannot use legendary actions.
spell.flavorText: Legend status revoked at the door.

rankUpgrades.description: The whole prison tightens. Caged enemies save with disadvantage, lose legendary actions, and cannot use reactions.
The whole prison tightens. Caged enemies save with disadvantage, lose legendary actions AND reactions, and deal 20 points less damage while caged.

spell.name: Chain Ward
spell.description: The chains guard their keeper. While at least one enemy is caged, you gain +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability and 2 Damage Reduction to all damage.
spell.flavorText: Someone is always watching the warden. Usually in chains.

rankUpgrades.description: The chains guard their keeper. While any enemy is caged, you gain +3 Durability Steps to equipped durability, 4 Damage Reduction against damage, and immunity to forced movement.

spell.name: Vengeance Unleashed
spell.description: Detonate the prison block: all active cages explode, dealing 4d6 blight damage per caged enemy in a 20-foot radius around each cage, then immediately re-form. Enemies caught in any explosion are caged for 3 rounds. Costs all current VP (minimum 4).
spell.flavorText: The riot ends the way it began: suddenly.

spell.name: Transfer Sentence
spell.description: Prisoners can be moved. When a cage breaks or expires, spend 2 VP to immediately cage the nearest other enemy within 30 feet with the remaining duration.
spell.flavorText: The system never sleeps. It reassigns.

rankUpgrades.description: Prisoners can be moved. When a cage breaks, the nearest enemy within 30 feet is caged free with full duration; this can occur once per round.

spell.name: Warden's Attention
spell.description: Caged enemies are easier to read: you have advantage on attacks against caged enemies, and they have disadvantage on attacks against you.
spell.flavorText: Hard to swing from inside a box.

rankUpgrades.description: Caged enemies are easier to read: advantage on your attacks against them, disadvantage for theirs, and your allies also gain advantage against caged enemies.

spell.name: The Iron City
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Raise a prison fortress in a 60-foot radius for 1 minute: every enemy inside is caged (restrained, +2d6 damage taken, no teleportation, no ally targeting). Cages regenerate each round, every tick of Cage Torment generates 1 VP, and once during the duration you may convert any cage into an Execution Chamber for free.
spell.flavorText: Somewhere in the ancestor-mounds, the first Warden nods.

spell.name: Deep Reserves
spell.description: The warden's ledger deepens. Your maximum VP increases by 1.
spell.flavorText: More grudges, more room.

rankUpgrades.description: The warden's ledger deepens. Your maximum VP increases by 2.
The warden's ledger deepens. Your maximum VP increases by 3.
The warden's ledger deepens. Your maximum VP increases by 4.
The warden's ledger deepens. Your maximum VP increases by 5, and cages generate 1 VP per round by default.

spell.name: Cruel Architecture
spell.description: The blueprints have teeth. All damage caged enemies take from your Cage Torment is increased by +1d8 damage.
spell.flavorText: Built to spec. The spec was unkind.

rankUpgrades.description: The blueprints have teeth. Cage Torment damage is increased by +2d8 damage.
The blueprints have teeth. Cage Torment damage is increased by +2d8 damage, and Torment ticks can critically strike.

spell.name: No Escape
spell.description: There is no door with your name on it. Enemies who escape or break a cage take 4d6 blight damage and are slowed by 15 feet for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Technically they got out. Practically, no.

rankUpgrades.description: There is no door with your name on it. Escapees take 6d6 blight damage, are slowed 15 feet, and cannot hide or turn invisible for 2 rounds.
There is no door with your name on it. Escapees take 8d6 blight damage, are slowed, cannot hide, and are re-marked for the Shadowblade's knife.

spell.name: Panopticon
spell.description: The warden sees every cell. You have truesight against caged enemies, and caged enemies have disadvantage on all rolls.
spell.flavorText: They cannot see you. They know you see them. That is enough.

rankUpgrades.description: The warden sees every cell. Truesight against caged enemies, who roll all dice with disadvantage and cannot benefit from luck effects.
The warden sees every cell. Truesight against caged enemies, all their rolls at disadvantage, no luck effects, and their natural 20s are downgraded to 19s.

spell.name: Vengeful Lash
spell.description: Strike an enemy within 15 feet with a lash of burning shadow: deals 1d8 blight damage and grants 1 Tension (VP). Deals +1d4 bonus blight damage if the target damaged you since your last turn.
spell.flavorText: Every wound is a deposit. This is the first withdrawal.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 1d10 blight damage, grants 1 VP, and deals +1d6 bonus damage if recently damaged by target.
Deals 2d6 blight damage, grants 2 VP, deals +1d8 bonus damage, and pulls the target 5 feet closer.

spell.name: Unyielding Grudge
spell.description: Passive: Your maximum VP capacity increases by 1. Whenever you suffer damage from an enemy attack, you gain 1 VP (max once per round).
spell.flavorText: The grudge holds room for more.

rankUpgrades.description: Maximum VP capacity increases by 2; gain 1 VP whenever damaged by an enemy.
Maximum VP capacity increases by 3; gain 1 VP whenever damaged, and gain +1 to Fortitude saves.

spell.name: Spiteful Resilience
spell.description: Passive: While you have 3 or more VP, you gain +1 Damage Reduction against physical attacks and your melee attacks deal +1d4 bonus blight damage.
spell.flavorText: Full reservoirs overflow violently.

rankUpgrades.description: At 3+ VP: gain +2 Damage Reduction against all attacks and attacks deal +1d6 bonus blight damage.

spell.name: Retaliatory Surge
spell.description: Reaction (spend 1 VP): When struck by a melee attack, immediately counter-strike with dark fire dealing 1d8 blight damage and restoring 1d4 Hit Points.
spell.flavorText: The blow lands twice. Once each direction.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 1d10 blight damage, heals for 1d6 Hit Points, and knocks the attacker back 5 feet.
Deals 2d6 blight damage, heals for 1d8, and forces the attacker to make a Fortitude save (DC 13) or be Staggered for 1 round.

spell.name: Burning Grudge Aura
spell.description: Passive: Whenever an adjacent enemy hits you with a melee attack, they suffer 1d4 blight damage in retribution.
spell.flavorText: Anger sharpens with proximity.

rankUpgrades.description: Retribution aura deals 1d6 blight damage.
Retribution aura deals 1d8 blight damage and applies 1d4 burning blight over 2 rounds.

spell.name: Avatar of Vengeance
spell.description: Spend 2 AP and 3 VP: ignite into the Avatar of Vengeance for 2 rounds. Gain +1 Damage Reduction against all attacks, regenerate 1d4 health per round, and your attacks deal +1d6 bonus blight damage.
spell.flavorText: The mounds send back what they owe.

rankUpgrades.description: Avatar lasts 3 rounds: +2 Damage Reduction, regenerates 1d6 health per round, and +1d8 bonus blight damage.
Avatar lasts 3 rounds: +2 Damage Reduction, regenerates 1d8 health per round, +2d6 bonus blight damage, and advantage on saving throws against fear and charm.

spell.name: Nemesis Resonance
spell.description: Passive: While in Avatar of Vengeance, you generate 1 additional VP at the start of each turn and your attacks gain +1 to hit.
spell.flavorText: The engine idles hot and hungry.

rankUpgrades.description: Generate 1 VP per turn; +2 to hit, and critical hits extend Avatar duration by 1 round (max 1 extension).
Generate 2 VP per turn; +2 to hit, weapon attacks crit on 19-20 during Avatar, and critical hits extend Avatar by 1 round.

spell.name: Grudge Cleave
spell.description: Spend 2 AP and 2 VP: unleash a sweeping arc of dark flame in a 15-foot cone. Deals 2d6 blight damage and reduces enemy Armor by 1 for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: A sweeping statement made in burning steel.

rankUpgrades.description: 20-foot cone deals 2d8 blight damage and reduces enemy Armor by 2 for 2 rounds.
20-foot cone deals 2d10 blight damage, reduces Armor by 2, and forces a Fortitude save (DC 14) or be knocked Prone.

spell.name: Spite Siphon
spell.description: Passive: When you are reduced below half maximum Hit Points, immediately gain 2 VP and 1d8 temporary health for 2 rounds (cooldown: 3 rounds).
spell.flavorText: Wounds only supply the kiln.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain 3 VP and 2d6 temporary health when dropped below half health (cooldown: 2 rounds).

spell.name: Eye for an Eye
spell.description: Spend 1 AP and 3 VP: designate a target within 30 feet for 2 rounds. 25% of all damage you suffer is duplicated directly onto that target as blight damage.
spell.flavorText: What you deal out to us, you receive in full.

rankUpgrades.description: Target receives 40% of damage you suffer for 2 rounds, and duration increases to 3 rounds.

spell.name: Endless Retaliation
spell.description: Passive: Retaliatory Surge refunds 1 AP when triggered, and its damage is increased by +1d4.
spell.flavorText: There is no waiting in line for justice.

rankUpgrades.description: Retaliatory Surge damage +1d6 and you gain +1 to hit on your next turn after triggering a reaction.
Retaliatory Surge damage +1d8 and each counter-attack restores 1 VP if it kills or critically strikes the target.

spell.name: Cataclysmic Retribution
spell.description: Spend 2 AP and 4 VP: detonate stored agony in a 20-foot shockwave. Deals 3d8 blight damage to all nearby enemies, and forces each target to make a Fortitude save (DC 14) or be Staggered for 1 round.
spell.flavorText: The reckoning arrives all at once.

spell.name: Juggernaut Momentum
spell.description: Passive: While in Avatar of Vengeance, you gain advantage on saving throws against forced movement, prone, and displacement, and gain +1 Damage Reduction.
spell.flavorText: An unmovable fury in iron boots.

rankUpgrades.description: Gain immunity to Prone and forced movement while in Avatar, and +2 Damage Reduction against magical attacks.

spell.name: Nemesis Mark
spell.description: Passive: When an enemy scores a critical hit against you or reduces you below 50% HP, they become your Nemesis: your attacks against them deal +1d6 bonus blight damage for 2 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Once written in the ledger, the debt must be paid.

rankUpgrades.description: Bonus damage increases to +1d8 blight damage and your attacks ignore 2 points of their Armor.

spell.name: Avatar of the Nemesis
spell.description: CAPSTONE: Spend 2 AP and 5 VP: ascend into the Colossal Nemesis for 3 rounds. Gain +2 Damage Reduction against all damage, become immune to fear and stun, your melee attacks deal +2d6 bonus blight damage, and 20% of damage you take is reflected to all enemies within 15 feet.
spell.flavorText: The final incarnation of wrath. Nothing that struck it survives.

spell.name: Nemesis Doctrine
spell.description: Passive: Every scar is a weapon. All blight and retaliation damage you deal is increased by +1 flat damage.
spell.flavorText: The flame burns brightest where the wood was deepest scarred.

rankUpgrades.description: All blight and retaliation damage increased by +2 flat damage.
All blight and retaliation damage increased by +3 flat damage.
All blight and retaliation damage increased by +4 flat damage.
All blight and retaliation damage increased by +5 flat damage and +1d4 bonus blight on crits.

spell.name: Bottomless Grudge
spell.description: Passive: Your maximum VP increases by 1, and you generate 1 VP at the start of every combat round.
spell.flavorText: A reservoir that fills itself.

rankUpgrades.description: Maximum VP increases by 2; generate 1 VP per round and gain +5 feet movement speed.
Maximum VP increases by 3; generate 2 VP per round and VP abilities cost 1 fewer VP (minimum 1).

spell.name: Infernal Retribution
spell.description: Passive: Retaliation damage scores critical hits on an attack roll of 19-20 and critical hits restore 1d4 Hit Points.
spell.flavorText: The counter-blow strikes straight through the heart.

rankUpgrades.description: Retaliation crits deal +1d6 bonus blight damage and restore 1d6 Hit Points.
Retaliation crits deal +1d8 bonus blight damage, restore 1d8 Hit Points, and force target to make a Fortitude save (DC 14) or be knocked Prone.

spell.name: Immortal Vengeance
spell.description: Passive: When you would suffer lethal damage while holding at least 2 VP, you instead drop to 1 Hit Point, consume all VP, and gain 1d8 temporary health (once per encounter).
spell.flavorText: Death itself cannot collect until the vengeance is paid.

rankUpgrades.description: Survive lethal damage, gain 2d6 temporary health, and gain 2 VP immediately.
Survive lethal damage, enter Avatar of Vengeance for 2 rounds for free, and gain 2d8 temporary health.

spell.name: Ossified Anchor
spell.description: Passive: Whenever you spend Tension (VP), convert the spent amount into temporary Calcified Armor at a 1:1 ratio (max +5 Damage Reduction). Calcified Armor decays by 2 at the start of each of your turns. While you have any Calcified Armor, you cannot benefit from Dodge.
spell.flavorText: Pain is just ore that hasn't set yet.

rankUpgrades.description: Calcified Armor cap increases to +8 Damage Reduction.
Calcified Armor cap increases to +10 Damage Reduction and decay slows to 1 per turn while a tethered enemy is within 30 feet.

spell.name: Deep Roots
spell.description: Passive: You cannot be pulled or dragged against your will. You gain advantage on saves against forced movement effects.
spell.flavorText: The mountain does not negotiate.

rankUpgrades.description: You are also immune to being knocked Prone while standing on stone, dirt, or metal surfaces.

spell.name: Chain Weight
spell.description: Spend 1 AP and 1 VP: Swing your grafted chain mass in a crushing overhead blow within 15 feet: 1d8+STR smashing damage and the target's movement speed is reduced by 15 feet until the end of its next turn. Gain 2 Tension on hit.
spell.flavorText: Some chains are worn. This one is thrown.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 1d10+STR smashing damage.
Deals 2d6+STR smashing damage and the slow lasts 2 rounds.

spell.name: Iron Brace
spell.description: Reaction — When targeted by an attack, spend 1 Tension (VP) to brace your grafted chains: gain +2 DR against the triggering attack. Whether it hits or misses, gain 1 Tension.
spell.flavorText: Brace. Breathe. Bank.

rankUpgrades.description: DR bonus increases to +3.
DR bonus increases to +4 and gain 2 Tension instead of 1.

spell.name: Sweeping Chains
spell.description: Spend 2 AP and 2 VP: Whirl your heavy chains in a 15-foot cone. Each creature caught takes 2d6 smashing damage and suffers Entangled Slow (-15 ft movement) for 1 round on a failed Reflex save. You may spend up to 3 additional VP to add +1d6 damage per VP spent.
spell.flavorText: A hailstorm of rust and regret.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 3d6 smashing damage; failed saves also drop shields/stances of braced enemies.
Deals 4d6 smashing damage; VP bonuses cap at 5 instead of 3.

spell.name: Gravitational Lock
spell.description: Passive: Your mass becomes law. You absorb 60% of all area damage directed at enemies tethered to you (instead of the standard 50%), and tethered targets can never force you to move toward them.
spell.flavorText: They strain against the leash. The leash strains against you. You do not notice.

rankUpgrades.description: Interception increases to 75% of area damage dealt to tethered enemies.
Interception increases to 85%; intercepted area damage triggers your Ossified Anchor as if you had spent 1 VP (once per round).

spell.name: Penitent Resolve
spell.description: Spend 1 AP, 2 VP: Dig the grafted spine hooks deeper, welcoming the pain. For 1 round you gain 50% damage resistance and +4 DR. These benefits are doubled (+8 DR / 50% resisted again on top) if your tethered target is within 15 feet of you.
spell.flavorText: Every hook placed was a promise. Today he collects interest.

rankUpgrades.description: Duration increases to 2 rounds.

spell.name: Cruel Drag
spell.description: Spend 2 AP, 3 VP: Manually lock your gears and reel in. Dash directly to an enemy tethered to you (any distance up to 60 ft), slamming into them with a colossal body-check for 2d8 smashing damage and knocking them Prone on a failed Fortitude save. If they are lighter than you, they are instead dragged 10 feet back toward your original position.
spell.flavorText: Distance is a rumor he doesn't spread.

rankUpgrades.description: Deals 3d8 smashing damage; the slam also staggers (loses 1 AP next turn).
Drag distance increases to 15 feet and you gain 2 Tension when this ability hits.

spell.name: Enduring Bulwark
spell.description: Spend 1 AP and 1 VP: Plant yourself completely (you cannot move this turn). Gain 50% damage resistance and +4 DR against all incoming smashing damage until the start of your next turn.
spell.flavorText: A wall that chose to be one.

rankUpgrades.description: The +4 DR extends to all physical damage types, not only smashing.

spell.name: Entangling Field
spell.description: Passive: Slack chains drift from your grafts, alive with habit. Enemies adjacent to you have their movement reduced by 10 feet while you have any Calcified Armor.
spell.flavorText: The chains miss being around wrists. They reach.

rankUpgrades.description: Slow increases to 15 feet and affected enemies suffer -1 to hit you.
Affected enemies cannot Disengage or take the Retreat maneuver away from your square.

spell.name: Iron Gaol
spell.description: Spend 3 AP, 6 VP: Erupt spectral iron bars around a creature within 30 feet, trapping it in a brutal cage for 2 rounds. Caged creatures physically cannot leave the cage by any means of movement and cannot teleport. A caged creature takes +1d6 bonus damage from all your attacks while confined.
spell.flavorText: He builds his prisons into the ground so they last.

rankUpgrades.description: Cage duration increases to 3 rounds.
Bonus damage against caged creatures increases to +2d6 and caged creatures cannot take reactions.

spell.name: Unbreakable Mass
spell.description: Passive: While you have 5 or more points of active Calcified Armor, you are immune to being Prone or pushed, and count as one size larger for grapple, shove, and carry-capacity purposes.
spell.flavorText: Part of him has simply stopped being negotiable anatomy.

rankUpgrades.description: Threshold drops to 3 points of Calcified Armor; you additionally count as one size larger for blocking corridors.
Whenever you would lose Calcified Armor to decay while above the threshold, gain 1 Tension instead.

spell.name: Chokepoint Doctrine
spell.description: Passive: You treat your own square and all adjacent squares as blocked terrain for enemies while you have any Calcified Armor. Enemies attempting to move through must succeed on a contested Might check against your Fortitude or stop where they began.
spell.flavorText: 'Around?' There is no around.

rankUpgrades.description: Failed movers take 1d8 smashing damage from the wall of chain as they rebound.

spell.name: Colossal Slam
spell.description: Spend 3 AP, 4 VP: Bring everything you are down on the ground. All creatures within 10 feet take 4d6 smashing damage and are knocked Prone on a failed Reflex save. Any tethered enemy within 30 feet is violently hauled 10 feet closer to you whether they save or not.
spell.flavorText: The earth files a complaint. It is denied.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 5d6 and haul distance increases to 15 feet.
Prone duration doubles on failure and allies adjacent to you gain +2 DR for 1 round from the resulting dust-and-shockwave cover.

spell.name: Avatar of the Monolith
spell.description: CAPSTONE: Spend 2 AP and 8 VP: fuse into living siege architecture for 3 rounds. Gain +5 Damage Reduction against all damage (stacking with Calcified Armor), become immune to fear, stun, Prone, push, and pull, and you always intercept 100% of area damage aimed at your tethered targets. At the end of each of your rounds, all enemies tethered to you are automatically hauled 10 feet into adjacency with you.
spell.flavorText: He asked the mountain what kept it standing through the Shattering. Then he asked harder.

spell.name: Monolith Doctrine
spell.description: Passive: All of your Iron Brace reactions, Penitent Resolve stances, and Enduring Bulwark plants gain +1 DR. Chokepoint Doctrine's blocked terrain now ignores size differences.
spell.flavorText: Doctrine is what remains when options run out. He made sure nothing else remained.

rankUpgrades.description: DR bonus increases to +2.
DR bonus increases to +3 and Iron Gaol no longer costs 3 AP (costs 1 AP).
DR bonus increases to +4; enemies have -2 on checks to move through your Chokepoint Doctrine terrain.
DR bonus increases to +5 and Iron Gaol's cage lasts 1 additional round.

spell.name: Eternal Calcification
spell.description: Passive: Your Calcified Armor cap increases by +2 beyond its current maximum, and attack rolls that hit you while you have 10+ Calcified Armor score a critical hit only on a natural 20.
spell.flavorText: There are layers of him no blade has met yet.

rankUpgrades.description: Cap increases by an additional +2 and blight damage against you loses its +50% vulnerability bonus while any Calcified Armor persists (it still dissolves armor on hit).

spell.name: Judgment of Stillness
spell.description: Passive: Whenever an enemy ends its turn inside your threat radius without having attacked you since your last turn, the Monolith judges its cowardice: 2d6 smashing damage and the Entangled Slow (-15 ft).
spell.flavorText: Running past is its own confession.

rankUpgrades.description: Damage increases to 4d6 and judged enemies also lose their reaction.

spell.name: Immovable Soul
spell.description: Passive: The body calcified first; now the will follows. Gain +2 to all saving throws. You are immune to fear while tethered to at least one living creature — whatever is chained to him cannot abandon him to despair.
spell.flavorText: The paradox of the Monolith: nothing holds him together except everything he holds.

rankUpgrades.description: Saving throw bonus increases to +4 and once per combat you may reduce any calculation of movement-drag or shove distance against you to zero after seeing it.

spell.name: Harmonic Sight
spell.description: You see both the light and the dark in every omen. At the start of each combat, you gain 1 Benediction and 1 Malediction.
spell.flavorText: The gutters of fate reflect the stars. Read both.

rankUpgrades.description: You see both the light and the dark in every omen. At the start of each combat, you gain 2 Benediction and 2 Malediction.
You see both the light and the dark in every omen. At the start of each combat, you gain 3 Benediction and 3 Malediction.

spell.name: Omen Synthesis
spell.description: Fate's ledger balances on demand. Once per round, convert 2 Benediction into 1 Malediction, or 2 Malediction into 1 Benediction.
spell.flavorText: Every debt is just a blessing facing the other way.

rankUpgrades.description: Fate's ledger balances on demand. Once per round, convert 1 Benediction into 1 Malediction, or 1 Malediction into 1 Benediction.
Fate's ledger balances on demand. Once per round, convert 1 Benediction into 1 Malediction or back, and gain 1 additional point of the chosen resource.

spell.name: Balanced Step
spell.description: Equilibrium is durability for the soul. While your Benediction and Malediction are within 2 points of each other, you gain +1 to all saving throws.
spell.flavorText: Stand in the middle of the scale. It is the only quiet place.

rankUpgrades.description: Equilibrium is durability for the soul. While your Benediction and Malediction are within 2 points of each other, you gain +2 to all saving throws and +1 Durability Steps to equipped durability.

spell.name: Dual Reading
spell.description: The Astril Synod reads fate in crystal-lattice refractions. When you generate Benediction or Malediction from a d20, you gain 1 additional point of the same type.
spell.flavorText: One refraction, two readings. The Synod bills accordingly.

rankUpgrades.description: The Astril Synod reads fate in crystal-lattice refractions. When you generate Benediction or Malediction from a d20, you gain 1 additional point of BOTH types.
The Astril Synod reads fate in crystal-lattice refractions. When you generate Benediction or Malediction from a d20, you gain 2 additional points of BOTH types.

spell.name: Harmonic Bolt
spell.description: Light and dark leave the hand as one. Spend 1 Benediction and 1 Malediction: hurl a bolt at a target within 60 feet dealing 2d6 sacred and 2d6 wyrd damage.
spell.flavorText: It argues both sides. Violently.

rankUpgrades.description: Light and dark leave the hand as one. Spend 1 Benediction and 1 Malediction: hurl a bolt at a target within 60 feet dealing 3d6 sacred and 3d6 wyrd damage.
Light and dark leave the hand as one. Spend 1 Benediction and 1 Malediction: hurl a bolt at a target within 60 feet dealing 4d6 sacred and 4d6 wyrd damage.

spell.name: Zone of Balance
spell.description: Draw the scale onto the ground. Spend 2 Benediction and 2 Malediction: create a 15-foot zone for 3 rounds — allies inside gain +1 to all rolls, enemies inside suffer -1 to all rolls.
spell.flavorText: Inside the chalk circle, arithmetic is a weapon.

rankUpgrades.description: Draw the scale onto the ground. Spend 2 Benediction and 2 Malediction: create a 20-foot zone for 3 rounds — allies inside gain +1 to all rolls, enemies inside suffer -2 to all rolls.
Draw the scale onto the ground. Spend 2 Benediction and 2 Malediction: create a 20-foot zone for 4 rounds — allies inside gain +2 to all rolls, enemies inside suffer -2 to all rolls.

spell.name: Resource Flow
spell.description: Balanced spending returns to the source. When you spend both Benediction and Malediction on the same spell, refund 1 of each.
spell.flavorText: Fate rounds down. For you, it rounds up.

rankUpgrades.description: Balanced spending returns to the source. When you spend both Benediction and Malediction on the same spell, refund 1 of each and gain 2 mana.
Balanced spending returns to the source. When you spend both Benediction and Malediction on the same spell, refund 2 of each.

spell.name: Twin Blessing
spell.description: Two fates, one gesture. Spend 3 Benediction and 3 Malediction: bless two allies within 30 feet — the first gains +2 to attack rolls, the second +2 to saving throws, for 3 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Divide the omen, double the goodwill.

rankUpgrades.description: Two fates, one gesture. Spend 3 Benediction and 3 Malediction: bless two allies within 30 feet — the first gains +3 to attack rolls, the second +3 to saving throws, for 3 rounds.
Two fates, one gesture. Spend 3 Benediction and 3 Malediction: bless two allies within 30 feet — both gain +3 to attack rolls AND +3 to saving throws, for 4 rounds.

spell.name: Sign of Equilibrium
spell.description: Extremes feed the center. When an enemy within 30 feet rolls a natural 20, you gain 2 Benediction. When an enemy within 30 feet rolls a natural 1, you gain 2 Malediction.
spell.flavorText: Their best day and their worst are both your paycheck.

rankUpgrades.description: Extremes feed the center. When an enemy within 60 feet rolls a natural 20, you gain 2 Benediction. When an enemy within 60 feet rolls a natural 1, you gain 2 Malediction.

spell.name: Perfect Balance
spell.description: When the scale is level, fate stops arguing. When you cast a spell spending equal Benediction and Malediction, all its dice roll their maximum. Once per short rest.
spell.flavorText: No randomness survives true neutrality.

rankUpgrades.description: When the scale is level, fate stops arguing. When you cast a spell spending equal Benediction and Malediction, all its dice roll their maximum. Twice per short rest.
When the scale is level, fate stops arguing. When you cast a spell spending equal Benediction and Malediction, all its dice roll their maximum. Three times per short rest.

spell.name: Quick Interpret
spell.description: The first reading of a battle is always half price. Your first omen-spell each combat costs 1 less Benediction and 1 less Malediction (minimum 0).
spell.flavorText: Openings are cheap. Endings are not.

rankUpgrades.description: The first reading of a battle is always half price. Your first TWO omen-spells each combat cost 1 less Benediction and 1 less Malediction (minimum 0).

spell.name: Omen Mastery
spell.description: You have read so many omens that they read you back. Your Benediction and Malediction caps each increase by 3, and you gain 1 Benediction and 1 Malediction at the start of each of your turns.
spell.flavorText: The gore no longer startles. It files its reports.

spell.name: Cosmic Echo
spell.description: Balanced works echo back to their author. When a dual-resource spell of yours resolves, regain half the Benediction and Malediction it spent (rounded down).
spell.flavorText: What leaves in balance returns in balance.

rankUpgrades.description: Balanced works echo back to their author. When a dual-resource spell of yours resolves, regain half the Benediction and Malediction it spent (rounded up).

spell.name: Auspice Aura
spell.description: Every die thrown near you lands on your ledger. All d20 rolls by creatures within 30 feet also generate Benediction or Malediction for you as if you had rolled them.
spell.flavorText: The battlefield is one long sentence and you are reading it aloud.

rankUpgrades.description: Every die thrown near you lands on your ledger. All d20 rolls by creatures within 60 feet also generate Benediction or Malediction for you as if you had rolled them.

spell.name: Auspice Supreme
spell.description: ULTIMATE: Rewind the entire exchange. Spend 8 Benediction and 8 Malediction: every enemy within 60 feet must reroll their last action's d20s with disadvantage, while every ally rerolls theirs with advantage. The better result applies for each.
spell.flavorText: Round two. This time fate has been paid.

spell.name: Equilibrium Mastery
spell.description: Your reservoirs widen to hold the whole argument. Your Benediction and Malediction caps each increase by 1.
spell.flavorText: Bigger vessels, same storm.

rankUpgrades.description: Your reservoirs widen to hold the whole argument. Your Benediction and Malediction caps each increase by 2.
Your reservoirs widen to hold the whole argument. Your Benediction and Malediction caps each increase by 3.
Your reservoirs widen to hold the whole argument. Your Benediction and Malediction caps each increase by 4.
Your reservoirs widen to hold the whole argument. Your Benediction and Malediction caps each increase by 6.

spell.name: Harmonic Overload
spell.description: The bolt learns to carry more of both arguments. Harmonic Bolt deals an additional 1d6 sacred and 1d6 wyrd damage.
spell.flavorText: Turn the refraction up until it hums.

rankUpgrades.description: The bolt learns to carry more of both arguments. Harmonic Bolt deals an additional 2d6 sacred and 2d6 wyrd damage.
The bolt learns to carry more of both arguments. Harmonic Bolt deals an additional 3d6 sacred and 3d6 wyrd damage, and its cooldown is reduced by 1 round.

spell.name: Balanced Vitality
spell.description: Equilibrium knits the body closed. While Balanced Step is active, you gain 5 temporary health at the start of each of your turns.
spell.flavorText: The scale heals its keeper.

rankUpgrades.description: Equilibrium knits the body closed. While Balanced Step is active, you gain 10 temporary health at the start of each of your turns.
Equilibrium knits the body closed. While Balanced Step is active, you gain 10 temporary health and +2 Durability Steps to equipped durability.

spell.name: Duality Ward
spell.description: Every balanced cast leaves a shell behind. When you spend both Benediction and Malediction on one spell, gain 4 temporary health.
spell.flavorText: Spending in balance, defended in kind.

rankUpgrades.description: Every balanced cast leaves a shell behind. When you spend both Benediction and Malediction on one spell, gain 8 temporary health.
Every balanced cast leaves a shell behind. When you spend both Benediction and Malediction on one spell, gain 8 temporary health and 1 Benediction.

spell.name: Dark Portent
spell.description: The darker the omen, the stronger you become. Every odd d20 roll you witness generates 1 additional Malediction for you.
spell.flavorText: Bad news arrives first. It has always been good news for you.

rankUpgrades.description: The darker the omen, the stronger you become. Every odd d20 roll you witness generates 2 additional Malediction for you.
The darker the omen, the stronger you become. Every odd d20 roll within 30 feet generates 2 additional Malediction for you, even rolls that are not yours.

spell.name: Ill Omen
spell.description: Spend 2 Malediction to curse a target within 60 feet with ill fortune: -1 to their next d20 roll. Stacks up to 2 times.
spell.flavorText: A small curse. They add up.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 2 Malediction to curse a target within 60 feet with ill fortune: -1 to their next d20 roll. Stacks up to 3 times.
Spend 2 Malediction to curse a target within 60 feet with ill fortune: -2 to their next d20 roll. Stacks up to 3 times.

spell.name: Wasting Portent
spell.description: Ill omens linger longer. Your Malediction-powered debuffs last 1 additional round.
spell.flavorText: A curse that overstays its welcome was well made.

rankUpgrades.description: Ill omens linger longer. Your Malediction-powered debuffs last 2 additional rounds.

spell.name: Sign of Decay
spell.description: Spend 1 Malediction: a target within 60 feet takes 1d8 wyrd damage. Costs no Action Points.
spell.flavorText: A flick of the wrist. A piece of the mind, missing.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 1 Malediction: a target within 60 feet takes 2d8 wyrd damage. Costs no Action Points.
Spend 1 Malediction: a target within 60 feet takes 3d8 wyrd damage. Costs no Action Points.

spell.name: Misfortune Aura
spell.description: The air around you carries your ill opinion. Enemies within 15 feet have -1 to all d20 rolls.
spell.flavorText: Standing near you is statistically inadvisable.

rankUpgrades.description: The air around you carries your ill opinion. Enemies within 25 feet have -1 to all d20 rolls.
The air around you carries your ill opinion. Enemies within 25 feet have -2 to all d20 rolls.

spell.name: Terrain of Decay
spell.description: Spend 4 Malediction: curse a 20-foot zone within 60 feet for 3 rounds — enemies inside take 1d6 wyrd damage at the start of their turn and have -10 feet movement speed.
spell.flavorText: The ground develops opinions about visitors.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 4 Malediction: curse a 20-foot zone within 60 feet for 3 rounds — enemies inside take 2d6 wyrd damage at the start of their turn and have -10 feet movement speed.
Spend 4 Malediction: curse a 25-foot zone within 60 feet for 4 rounds — enemies inside take 2d6 wyrd damage at the start of their turn and have -15 feet movement speed.

spell.name: Curse Stack
spell.description: Spend 3 Malediction: lay a heavy Ill Omen on a target within 60 feet — -1 to ALL their rolls per stack, up to 3 stacks, for 3 rounds.
spell.flavorText: Omens, plural. Delivered at once.

rankUpgrades.description: Spend 3 Malediction: lay a heavy Ill Omen on a target within 60 feet — -1 to ALL their rolls per stack, up to 3 stacks, for 4 rounds.
Spend 3 Malediction: lay a heavy Ill Omen on a target within 60 feet — -2 to ALL their rolls per stack, up to 3 stacks, for 4 rounds.

spell.name: Omen of Frailty
spell.description: Layered curses strip the durability off fate itself. Targets carrying 2 or more of your Malediction debuffs become vulnerable to your wyrd damage.
spell.flavorText: Curse once, they resist. Curse twice, they remember why they shouldn't have.

rankUpgrades.description: Layered curses strip the durability off fate itself. Targets carrying 2 or more of your Malediction debuffs become vulnerable to your wyrd damage and suffer -2 to saving throws.
Layered curses strip the durability off fate itself. Targets carrying 2 or more of your Malediction debuffs become vulnerable to ALL damage you deal and suffer -2 to saving throws.

spell.name: Dark Conviction
spell.description: Their worst moment is your windfall. When a target afflicted by your Malediction debuff rolls a natural 1, you gain 3 Malediction.
spell.flavorText: Disaster, itemized.

rankUpgrades.description: Their worst moment is your windfall. When a target afflicted by your Malediction debuff rolls a natural 1, you gain 5 Malediction.

spell.name: Malediction Overflow
spell.description: A full reservoir bleeds onto the field. While your Malediction is at its cap, every odd d20 roll instead lashes the nearest enemy for 1d4 wyrd damage.
spell.flavorText: Nowhere left to store it. Someone will have to hold it.

rankUpgrades.description: A full reservoir bleeds onto the field. While your Malediction is at its cap, every odd d20 roll instead lashes the nearest enemy for 1d6 wyrd damage.
A full reservoir bleeds onto the field. While your Malediction is at its cap, every odd d20 roll instead lashes the nearest enemy for 1d8 wyrd damage.

spell.name: Void Gaze
